stories.pr: The existing Admin Panel chatbot needed a modern, redesigned interface to support the new ExpoAssistant AI assistant experience.
stories.oc: A redesigned chatbot front end built to the Figma prototype and connected to DS-provided endpoints (v1 excludes like/dislike feedback).

stories.s: Investigation/discovery story defining the Registration microservice within the monolith-to-microservices transition — its domain boundaries, APIs, events, integration points and migration approach.
stories.pr: The monolith tightly couples registration, authentication, profile and billing in one codebase and shared schema, limiting scalability, deployment independence and team autonomy; the Registration domain's boundaries and contracts were not yet defined.
stories.oc: A defined scope for the Registration microservice (responsibilities, APIs, events, data, integration points, observability and migration strategy) to guide extraction from the monolith.

stories.s: The new Global Search page now features a rotating Sponsored Exhibitor block, giving organizers fresh premium sponsorship inventory to sell.
stories.pr: The new Global Search page had no surface to promote paying sponsors, leaving a sponsorship monetisation opportunity untapped and limiting sponsor visibility and ROI.
stories.oc: A Sponsored Exhibitor block on Global Search shows one highlighted, labelled sponsor card at a time with configurable label and bar colour, auto-rotating every 5 seconds with manual paging, ordered by matchmaking, defined order or random, always shown regardless of query, with views and clicks tracked into the existin…

stories.s: The Global Search page gains a rotating Sponsored Products block, giving organizers additional premium sponsorship inventory to sell.
stories.pr: The new Global Search page had no dedicated surface to promote sponsors products, leaving product-level sponsorship monetisation and sponsor product visibility untapped.
stories.oc: A Sponsored Products block on Global Search shows sponsored product cards within a shared highlight border and configurable label, auto-rotating every 5 seconds with manual paging, ordered by matchmaking, defined order or random, always shown regardless of query, with per-card views and clicks tracked into the Marketp…

stories.s: Builds the new Product module on a modular DDD + CQRS hexagonal architecture under /src, establishing the foundation and patterns for migrating further modules off the legacy Phalcon monolith.
stories.pr: Business logic lived in a legacy monolith with no clean modular boundaries, making it hard to evolve, test and scale; there was no established pattern for extracting modules.
stories.oc: A Product module implemented on a three-tier modular architecture with command/query buses, shared kernel value objects, DI over Phalcon, and a Public API v3 base — the reusable template for future module migrations.

stories.s: Updates exhibitor team-member creation rules and adds login uniqueness validation to prevent duplicate or conflicting exhibitor accounts.
stories.pr: Exhibitor team-member creation rules allowed potential login conflicts, with no enforced uniqueness validation on logins.
stories.oc: Revised team-member creation rules for exhibitors plus enforced login uniqueness validation.

stories.s: Enhances the Meetings report and Custom Meeting Wizard report with Business Transaction Likelihood and Meeting Did Not Take Place columns, giving exhibitors and organizers richer meeting outcome data.
stories.pr: Meeting reports lacked columns capturing business-transaction likelihood and whether a meeting actually took place, limiting the insight exhibitors and organizers could draw from meeting data.
stories.oc: Both the Meetings report and Custom Meeting Wizard report now include Business Transaction Likelihood and Meeting Did Not Take Place columns.

stories.s: Attendees who opt out of networking can now privately favourite exhibitors, speakers and products without ever being exposed as leads.
stories.pr: Favouriting was only available to opted-in attendees, which automatically exposed them to third parties, so privacy-conscious or opted-out attendees, critical under German GDPR, could not engage at all without sacrificing their privacy.
stories.oc: Opted-out users can favourite and unfavourite on web and app with the action kept fully private (excluded from notifications, dashboards, downloaded leads, lead counts and the public API), privacy preserved retrospectively if they later opt in, plus a GDPR-safe tooltip on favourites counters.

stories.s: Adds per-language storage for the predefined 'Other locations' list in Sessions/Events so each locale keeps its own value, fixing a multi-tenant translation defect raised by client K5.
stories.pr: The predefined 'Other locations' list stored a single shared value, so editing a location in one language (e.g. German) overwrote it for all languages — a defect (EP-53662) reported by client K5 that the original feature never scoped for translation.
stories.oc: Per-locale storage for 'Other locations' so each language holds independent values, with existing values migrated as the fallback and locale-aware display in admin and front end.

stories.s: The mobile app now promotes ExpoPlatform branding, turning attendee usage into organic platform awareness.
stories.pr: The mobile app carried no platform branding, missing an organic awareness and inbound channel.
stories.oc: ExpoPlatform branding is surfaced within the mobile app experience.

stories.s: Adds a Superadmin-only toggle in the Website Builder to show or hide the 'Powered by ExpoPlatform' footer branding per event across the event lifecycle.
stories.pr: Platform branding in the website footer could not be controlled per event, so there was no governed way to remove or retain the 'Powered by ExpoPlatform' mark for specific clients.
stories.oc: A Superadmin-only Website Builder setting that toggles the 'Powered by ExpoPlatform' footer logo and text per event, hidden from non-Superadmins.

stories.s: The ExpoFP floorplan integration was migrated onto the Integration Hub's auto-update framework, gaining self-healing sync and a logs viewer.
stories.pr: The legacy ExpoFP integration was opaque and fragile: its most common failure was exhibitors deleted on the ExpoFP side but still held in our system, which previously required developer or operations effort to reconcile, and the sync process offered little visibility.
stories.oc: ExpoFP now runs on the Hub's auto-update schema: removed exhibitors are recreated automatically, exhibitor changes batch into a dedicated five-minute sync run, one month of sync history is retained, and the integration inherits the Hub logs viewer.

stories.s: AI semantic search can now be constrained to an allowed list of entity IDs, so applied filters and search relevance work together instead of conflicting.
stories.pr: Marketplace users applying filters did not see those filters reflected in AI search results — semantic ranking ignored the active filter criteria, returning items that should have been excluded.
stories.oc: The AI search API accepts an optional allowed_ids parameter and applies it as a pre-search constraint in Qdrant, so results satisfy both semantic relevance and the active filters, with no regression when the list is absent.

stories.s: AI search results are now paginated, letting users browse beyond the first page of semantic results without re-running the whole search.
stories.pr: AI search returned only an initial result set with no way to page through additional matches, limiting how much of the relevant catalogue a user could reach.
stories.oc: The AI search API accepts offset and frame_size parameters and returns the correct Qdrant ranking window, combining correctly with allowed_ids filtering.

stories.s: Exhibitor events now display even when no team member is assigned, so exhibitor presence is never hidden from attendees.
stories.pr: Events with no associated exhibitor team member failed to show, leaving gaps in exhibitor visibility.
stories.oc: Exhibitor events render regardless of team-member association.

stories.s: Obsolete Lead Capture Pro global settings were removed from the Admin Panel and the QR codes export was adjusted, simplifying organiser configuration as the LCP settings model is reworked.
stories.pr: The Admin Panel still exposed global settings tied to the old Lead Capture Pro model and a QR codes export that no longer matched the intended configuration approach, creating confusing or redundant controls.
stories.oc: The LCP-related global settings were removed from the Admin Panel and the QR codes export behaviour was adjusted accordingly.

stories.s: The mobile session calendar now shows exhibitor-run events alongside organiser sessions in one unified day/week view, when enabled.
stories.pr: Exhibitor events lived apart from organiser sessions, forcing attendees to hunt across separate areas and risking them missing relevant exhibitor-run sessions.
stories.oc: When 'Include Exhibitor Events in Sessions' is enabled, exhibitor events render in both Week Glance and Day Detail views, visually badged, honouring the same overlap/overflow and tap-to-detail behaviour as regular sessions.

stories.s: A new dedicated endpoint returns an entire calendar window in one lightweight, timezone-correct call, powering the session calendar view.
stories.pr: The calendar view had no purpose-built data source; the paginated general sessions search could not cheaply return a whole day or week with server-resolved boundaries and event timezone.
stories.oc: Shipped POST /api/v1/search/sessionsCalendarView returning a single non-paginated day/week envelope with server-owned window and timezone and the same optional filters; the legacy sessions search endpoint is left untouched.

stories.s: The Lead Capture Pro purchase page now marks features already granted via Category or Profile settings as 'Purchased,' preventing double charges.
stories.pr: Exhibitors could be charged again on the Lead Capture Pro purchase page for features (Lead Capture, Custom Questions, Product QR) that were already active for them through Category or Profile settings, risking redundant transactions and confusion among team members.
stories.oc: The purchase page now detects features granted via Category or Profile settings and marks them as Purchased, so exhibitors and their team members are not offered items they already hold.

stories.s: Every Speed Networking run now posts results-and-metrics to the Data Science alerts chat, so successful, empty, or anomalous runs are visible.
stories.pr: Speed Networking calculations completed silently, so the team had to manually check outcomes and zero-output runs (no meetings generated) could pass unnoticed.
stories.oc: On every calculation completion, including zero-output runs, a message with generation metrics (meetings/matches created) and validation results is posted to the DS alerts chat.

stories.s: Speed Networking now preserves per-participant matching analytics, so the team can explain after the fact why any attendee did or didn't get meetings.
stories.pr: When participants queried their matchmaking results, no stored data existed to explain the algorithm's decisions.
stories.oc: Per-participant, per-slot inclusion/exclusion data with reasons is captured and stored for post-fact analysis.

stories.s: The AI Search API was adapted to the unified multi-entity request contract proposed by the Exhibitors team, so filtered, paginated semantic search can be called consistently from the platform backend.
stories.pr: The AI Search service did not accept a standard request shape: filtering (EP-54178) and pagination (EP-54179) existed as separate capabilities, but there was no agreed contract for the backend to call them uniformly across multiple entity types.
stories.oc: The AI Search API now accepts the agreed contract (client, event_id, account_id, query, languages, entities[] with allowed IDs, relevance_order, pagination), returning per-entity results restricted to the supplied ID lists, building on the filtering and pagination work.

stories.s: The recommendation service's cache was reworked with incremental updates, async pulls, and compression, removing the production bottleneck.
stories.pr: Production analysis (EP-54048) found the cache to be the main bottleneck of the inference service: full data collection on each request and on-request data pulls were limiting performance and reliability under load.
stories.oc: Phase one caching improvements: incremental row updates instead of full collection, asynchronous data pulls, cache data compression, and SLO/SLI instrumentation for the service.

stories.s: The recommendation service is being re-architected to cut running cost by roughly 86% (about $538 to $74/month) and remove the cache bottleneck.
stories.pr: The existing recommendation architecture was expensive to run 24/7 and its oversized, slow-syncing cache was the primary bottleneck preventing expansion to more events and tenants.
stories.oc: In progress: cache improvements (incremental/async sync, scored-entity filtering, event-end deactivation, SLOs), merged Listener+Calculation, an on-demand router/cold-standby inference topology, and a UI tenant old/new toggle, targeting ~86% cost reduction while preserving existing functionality.

stories.s: The Event Setup admin page is restyled to the modern Untitled UI design language via CSS only, giving organisers a cleaner, more contemporary interface with no change to existing functionality.
stories.pr: The admin panel's Event Setup page used dated styling inconsistent with a modern design language, making the organiser experience feel legacy.
stories.oc: New Untitled UI CSS applied to the Event Setup page with markup and PHP untouched, matching the modern design language and passing QA before individual release.

stories.s: The Categories Setup admin page was restyled to the modern Untitled UI design via CSS only, with no functional changes.
stories.pr: The Categories Setup admin page, used to configure networking and matchmaking categories, used dated styling inconsistent with the target modern design language.
stories.oc: New Untitled UI CSS applied to the Categories Setup page with markup and PHP untouched, preserving category and networking/matchmaking configuration, and passing QA before release.

stories.s: The Exhibitor List admin page is restyled to the modern Untitled UI design language via CSS only, giving organisers a cleaner interface with no change to existing functionality.
stories.pr: The admin panel's Exhibitor List page used dated styling inconsistent with a modern design language.
stories.oc: New Untitled UI CSS applied to the Exhibitor List page with markup and PHP untouched, matching the modern design language and passing QA before individual release.

stories.s: The Participants List admin page is restyled to the modern Untitled UI design language via CSS only, giving organisers a cleaner interface with no change to existing functionality.
stories.pr: The admin panel's Participants List page used dated styling inconsistent with a modern design language.
stories.oc: New Untitled UI CSS applied to the Participants List page with markup and PHP untouched, matching the modern design language and passing QA before individual release.

stories.s: The Sessions List admin page is restyled to the modern Untitled UI design language via CSS only, giving organisers a cleaner interface with no change to existing functionality.
stories.pr: The admin panel's Sessions List page used dated styling inconsistent with a modern design language.
stories.oc: New Untitled UI CSS applied to the Sessions List page with markup and PHP untouched, matching the modern design language and passing QA before individual release.

stories.s: The admin Event List page is being restyled to the modern Untitled UI design language as part of the Phase 1 admin redesign.
stories.pr: The admin Event List page used dated styling inconsistent with the modern design language targeted by the redesign (inferred, as no description was provided).
stories.oc: Untitled UI CSS restyling of the Event List admin page, consistent with the other Phase 1 pages; specific details are not documented in the ticket.

stories.s: Six more automated Event Reporting dashboards (Exhibitor Analytics, Platform Performance, Mobile App, and more) were added as an Analytics sub-section.
stories.pr: Organisers lacked consolidated, self-serve event reporting inside the admin panel; analytics were limited to the existing pages and these richer dashboards were not yet available to them.
stories.oc: Six additional Embeddable.com dashboards were embedded as a new sub-section under the existing Analytics module, sitting alongside (not replacing) the current analytics pages in the organiser admin navigation.

stories.s: The Integration team's trial test plans for Event Statistics and Session Program were migrated from teststone into the e2e testing repository.
stories.pr: Test plans for these bounded contexts lived in the legacy teststone repository, splitting test assets across repositories and complicating maintenance, review and classification.
stories.oc: Trial test plans and supporting docs for Event Statistics and Session Program were moved into the e2e repository, with updates now made only there and tests re-classified and re-levelled.

stories.s: During mobile registration, tapping Terms of Use now opens it in the device's external browser instead of hijacking the registration web-view.
stories.pr: Tapping Terms of Use replaced the registration web-view, so mobile users lost their in-progress registration when they viewed the terms and came back.
stories.oc: On both iOS and Android, the Terms of Use link opens in an external browser without disturbing the current registration screen, and returning users find their progress intact.

stories.s: A new inbound Swoogo integration automatically syncs registrants, speakers, and exhibitors, deduplicated by company, including cancellations.
stories.pr: Clients using Swoogo for registration had no automated way to flow registrants and exhibitors into ExpoPlatform, forcing manual data transfer and blocking EP adoption alongside Swoogo.
stories.oc: In progress: a polled, OAuth2, external-ID-matched inbound integration with four flows (account and exhibitor set/delete), team-member matching, delta cursors, and full field mappings, running on the Integration Hub AutoUpdate engine.

stories.s: Organisers can now brand the Participant Registration welcome page (hero image, title, description, per language) via a visual constructor.
stories.pr: Organisers could not customise the participant registration welcome page, so every event's registration entry point looked generic and off-brand.
stories.oc: In progress: an Admin Panel constructor with a toggleable hero image (upload/default/delete), title (max 50) and description (max 120) fields, flip-sides layout, per-language entry, and save/cancel with unsaved-changes protection.

stories.s: Organisers can now brand the Buyer Registration welcome page (hero image, title, description, per language) via a visual constructor.
stories.pr: Organisers could not customise the buyer registration welcome page, leaving the buyer entry point generic and off-brand.
stories.oc: In progress: an Admin Panel constructor with a toggleable hero image, title (max 50) and description (max 120), flip-sides layout, per-language entry, and save/cancel with unsaved-changes protection for the Buyer registration page.

stories.s: Event admins can now search the Transaction Dashboard and Invoice Payments pages by payer name, surname, or email, replacing manual scrolling.
stories.pr: Neither the Transaction Dashboard nor the Invoice Payments page had search, so admins had to scroll paginated lists to find a payer's record, which was painfully slow on large events.
stories.oc: A search field (name, surname, email) was added above pagination on both the Transaction Dashboard and Invoice Payments pages, querying the Account Name column to locate payment records instantly.

stories.s: Interaction Dashboards now show each participant's Company name, truncated with a hover tooltip, so viewers can see which organisation it was.
stories.pr: In the Interaction Dashboard (Participant and Exhibitor profiles → Dashboard), listed users showed no company, so viewers could not tell which organisation each interaction belonged to.
stories.oc: Company name is being added to every participant row in the Interaction Dashboard for both Participant and Exhibitor profiles, truncated with a full-name tooltip (in progress).

stories.s: A new public API endpoint now exposes sponsor interaction analytics, views, clicks, favourites, meetings and messages, previously invisible.
stories.pr: Clients querying the existing accountsInteractions endpoint for sponsors (object=19) received empty data because sponsor interactions live in a separate ClickHouse table that was never surfaced through the public API, leaving no programmatic way to retrieve sponsor engagement.
stories.oc: New GET /api/v2/statistics/sponsorInteractions endpoint returning paginated, filterable sponsor interaction rows (account, action, object, time) sourced from the sponsor statistics store under its own contract.

stories.s: The deprecated 'Seated Meetings' feature has been removed from the Hosted Buyer module and Module Management, decluttering the organizer Admin Panel and preventing accidental use of a redundant tool.
stories.pr: The Admin Panel still exposed the deprecated Seated Meetings page within Hosted Buyer Management, cluttering the organizer UI and risking accidental use of an obsolete, redundant feature.
stories.oc: The Seated Meetings sub-item and its module toggles were removed, direct URLs now redirect or return an access-denied state, and other Hosted Buyer functions (Meeting Wizard, Buyer/Exhibitor lists) are unaffected; historical meeting data is retained.

stories.s: A new sponsor-interactions report class extracts paginated sponsor engagement rows from the dedicated sponsor statistics store.
stories.pr: Sponsor interaction data lived in a separate ClickHouse table with no report-layer class in the standard statistics-reports framework, so it could not be queried, paginated, or surfaced through reporting or the API.
stories.oc: New SponsorAccountsInteractionsReport class (prepare/validate/prepareQuery/resolvePaginated) hardwired to the sponsor object type, registered in ReportsList, returning sponsor interaction rows with a defined input/output contract.

stories.s: Organizers can now configure OTP sign-in independently for company and individual profiles, tailoring event authentication.
stories.pr: OTP authentication could not be set separately for company vs individual profiles, forcing a one-size setup.
stories.oc: Independent OTP authentication configuration for company and individual profiles per event.

stories.s: Attendees can now discover exhibition Pavilions through AI Search, indexed as a distinct entity showing their grouped child exhibitors.
stories.pr: Pavilions had no dedicated representation in the AI Search index; searching a pavilion name returned generic exhibitor results with no sense of the pavilion's hierarchical role or its child exhibitors, a missed discovery opportunity for one of the most prominent physical-event structures.
stories.oc: Pavilion records are indexed as a distinct entity type with parent-child awareness and relevance boosting, appearing in Top Results and a dedicated Pavilions section while leaving regular exhibitor search unchanged.

stories.s: Attendees can now find Community Groups through AI Search using both exact names and topic-based intent, opening a search-driven path to the platform's community-building features.
stories.pr: Community Groups were not discoverable via AI Search, so attendees who knew a group name or wanted groups around a topic had no search path, limiting engagement with the platform's community features.
stories.oc: Community Group records (name and description) are indexed as a distinct entity with semantic/intent matching, relevance ranking, and a dedicated Groups section; topic-tag indexing and member-count ranking were descoped pending data-model changes.

stories.s: Attendees can now search the on-demand content library by title, speaker, or topic through AI Search, with speaker-aware matching.
stories.pr: On-Demand Sessions were not indexed or discoverable via AI Search, so attendees could not find recorded talks by topic, speaker, or title, reducing the value of the on-demand content library.
stories.oc: On-Demand Session records are indexed (title, description, speakers, topics) with speaker-aware matching, weighted relevance ranking, and a dedicated On-Demand section distinct from live sessions; live-session search is unaffected.

stories.s: Organizers can now edit the name and destination URL of existing Marketing Tracking Links in place, without recreating and re-distributing them.
stories.pr: Organizers could not edit existing Tracking Links; correcting a link's name or landing page meant recreating the link and replacing every reference in the Website Builder and external campaigns, which was tedious and error-prone.
stories.oc: An Edit action on each Tracking Link lets organizers update the name and landing page URL with validation, while the external tracked/short URL stays unchanged so existing campaign references keep working.

stories.s: TAM-sourced feedback on the Embedded Analytics dashboards was consolidated into prioritised fixes: better date-range defaults, decluttering, filter totals.
stories.pr: The Embedded Analytics dashboards had usability and data-clarity gaps surfaced through client interactions — unhelpful default date ranges spanning 2021-2026, cluttered high-volume views, noisy 3-decimal percentages, missing filter totals, combined App-login metrics, ambiguous labels, and missing Meetings/Messages sec…
stories.oc: A documented, prioritised set of improvement requests fed into the dashboard components — date-range defaults, decluttering, 2-decimal percentages, filter totals, Sessions simplification, Android/iOS login split, clearer labels, and new Meetings/Messages sections — with noted product-alignment items such as the date-r…

stories.s: The global AI Notetaker setting is restored in the App Builder, giving organizers back the centralized control the app team relies on.
stories.pr: A previously removed global AI Notetaker setting left teams without centralized control.
stories.oc: The global AI Notetaker setting is back in the App Builder.

stories.s: Organizers can now whitelist trusted external domains so authenticated content, like On-Demand Sessions, plays correctly when embedded on partner sites.
stories.pr: When Sessions were embedded via iframe on external partner sites, modern browsers blocked the ExpoPlatform authentication cookie (CORS/SameSite), redirecting logged-in attendees to the homepage instead of playing the video and breaking embedded authenticated content.
stories.oc: A new 'Security settings / Trusted embed domains' section in Event Setup lets organizers add and remove whitelisted domains; for those origins the auth cookie is issued SameSite=None; Secure so embedded authenticated Sessions play seamlessly.

stories.s: A new Public API v3 endpoint lets integrators upload images to a global product, with a main-image flag and preserved image ordering.
stories.pr: The v3 product API had no way to upload product images; image handling was intentionally excluded from the core product create/update endpoints, leaving a gap in the new global-product media capabilities.
stories.oc: POST /api/v3/products/{productId}/uploadImage uploads PNG/JPEG images to a global product, using a main flag to replace or append, preserving image order, with standard validations and response envelope (in progress).

stories.s: A new Public API v3 endpoint lets integrators remove an image from a global product, correctly nulling the main-image reference when needed.
stories.pr: The v3 product API could upload images but had no counterpart to remove one, leaving integrators unable to fully manage global-product imagery through v3.
stories.oc: DELETE /api/v3/products/{productId}/images/{imageId} removes an image — nulling the product's main-image id if it was the main image, else dropping it from the list — while preserving remaining order, with 404 validations and standard response envelope (in progress).

stories.s: A new Public API v3 endpoint lets integrators upload a hosted video file to a global product, switching the product's video type to uploaded, as part of the v3 product media architecture.
stories.pr: The v3 product API supported only embed-URL videos via the core endpoints; there was no way to upload a hosted video file to a global product, leaving the uploaded-video path unimplemented.
stories.oc: POST /api/v3/products/{productId}/uploadVideo stores an uploaded video, sets the product's hosted video URL, and switches its video type to uploaded, with validations and standard response envelope (in progress).

stories.s: A new Public API v3 endpoint lets integrators unset a global product's uploaded video, clearing the video URL and association as the counterpart to the video-upload endpoint.
stories.pr: The v3 product API could upload a product video but had no way to unset or remove it, leaving video lifecycle management incomplete for global products.
stories.oc: DELETE /api/v3/products/{productId}/removeVideo clears the product's video URL and uploaded-video association, with 404 validation and standard response envelope; the post-unset video-type behaviour remains an open item pending core PATCH alignment (in progress).

stories.s: Establishes the Products API media module in Public API v3 — the container for global-product image and video management endpoints — as part of the v3 endpoint migration.
stories.pr: The new v3 product API needed a dedicated media module to house global-product image and video handling that was intentionally excluded from the core product endpoints.
stories.oc: The Products API media module scaffolding that groups the dedicated image and video upload/removal endpoints (in progress; the ticket body is a placeholder, so scope is inferred from the epic and sibling endpoints).

stories.s: A new backend endpoint powers the Admin Panel Integrations page with a single catalog of every integration, tagged by category with per-event status.
stories.pr: There was no unified backend catalog of platform integrations for the Admin Panel; organizers had no single view of which integrations exist and which are active for their event, and integration metadata was scattered rather than centrally maintained.
stories.oc: GET /api/v1/integrations returns the full integrations catalog (hub + legacy) with names, descriptions, category tags, icons, and a per-event derived active flag; the catalog is maintained in code with a Confluence registry mirror and responses cached 10 minutes per event and language.

stories.s: A second round of Informa-requested analytics fixes sharpens the reporting dashboards organizers use to prove event value.
stories.pr: Informa flagged empty charts and gaps across the exhibitor, attendee and platform analytics tabs.
stories.oc: Graph-level fixes and additions across the analytics display (exhibitor, attendee, app/platform).

stories.s: Global search gains quick links, a Show-all view and reliable back navigation, making unified search results easy to explore.
stories.pr: The unified search results page lacked quick links and clean back navigation, making it hard to explore.
stories.oc: Quick links, Show-all, and back navigation added to the global search results page.

stories.s: Free (100%-discount) bookings now complete in one step, skipping a redundant payment form for a frictionless checkout.
stories.pr: A 100%-discount basket still forced attendees through a payment form asking for details not needed for a 0 transaction.
stories.oc: When the total is 0 the booking completes directly to the success page; the payment form is skipped with server-side price re-checks.

stories.s: A new Claude-based tool lets the team query Speed Networking exclusion data in plain language, answering missed-pair questions without manual digging.
stories.pr: Investigating why specific pairs were missed meant slow, manual digging through raw analytics data.
stories.oc: A Claude skill queries per-participant, per-slot exclusion data (from EP-54401) to answer ad-hoc missed-pair questions.

stories.s: Upgraded iOS CI/CD to a new macOS/Xcode-compatible build machine, keeping app releases unblocked.
stories.pr: The iOS CI/CD machine needed replacing, and the new macOS/Xcode versions on it broke the existing build process.
stories.oc: New CI/CD machine set up and macOS/Xcode compatibility issues resolved, restoring the iOS build/release pipeline.

stories.s: Fixed an iOS memory leak in user/session/exhibitor data that caused the app to slow down the longer it ran.
stories.pr: iOS app memory usage grew continuously during use due to a leak in the relationships between user, session, and exhibitor entities.
stories.oc: Leak fixed so the app no longer accumulates unbounded memory during use.

stories.s: Refactored iOS session/exhibitor event lists to remove in-memory filtering, likely a performance cleanup with no further detail available.
stories.pr: Not clearly specified beyond the ticket title; likely session/exhibitor event lists were filtered client-side, which does not scale well with large data sets.
stories.oc: In-memory filters removed from Session/ExhibitorEvents as an implementation-level refactor.

stories.s: Moved Public API v3 logs to CloudWatch and added an admin browse/filter/export UI, cutting the time to investigate incidents and support cases.
stories.pr: Public API v3 traffic logs sat in DynamoDB and weren't easily browsable or exportable, slowing incident investigation and customer-support requests.
stories.oc: Logs now stream to a dedicated CloudWatch group with event_id and error stack traces; new admin endpoints and a "Dynamic logs" UI tab let admins browse, filter, paginate, and export logs to a downloadable file, with duplicate-export protection.

stories.s: Fixed broken automated tests for the Basket feature to restore reliable CI coverage.
stories.pr: Not clearly specified beyond the ticket title; likely failing/broken automated tests for the Basket feature.
stories.oc: Basket test suite fixed so CI passes reliably.

stories.s: Fixed broken event links that appeared when paginating listings on the corporate site.
stories.pr: Not clearly specified beyond the ticket title; event links broke when paginating on the corporate site.
stories.oc: Pagination links for events on the corp site now resolve correctly.

stories.s: Tested a new ExpoFP floor-plan source URL live at Agritechnica 2025 to see if web and mobile can stay in sync on future SDK updates.
stories.pr: A prior ExpoFP SDK update was applied on mobile but the web source URL was left unchanged to avoid live-event risk, causing bus routes to display only in the mobile app and creating a mismatch between mobile and web floor plans.
stories.oc: An investigation into whether switching the floor-plan source URL on the live event causes display or functionality issues, informing whether web can be kept in sync going forward.

stories.s: Built a new backend service to detect anomalies, though the ticket does not specify what data or behavior it monitors.
stories.pr: Not clearly specified beyond the ticket title; no further detail on what data or behavior needed anomaly detection.
stories.oc: A new backend anomaly detection service was created, per the ticket title.

stories.s: Refactored the exhibitor profile's team members page for maintainability; no further detail specified in the ticket.
stories.pr: Not clearly specified beyond the ticket title.
stories.oc: The team members page in the exhibitor profile was refactored.

stories.s: Audited the AI Search service and catalogued key gaps (lost index updates, no chat memory, English-only, untested load, no schema versioning) to plan its next phase.
stories.pr: The AI Search service has multiple known gaps: index updates are silently lost on SQS failures, chat history is stored but never used (no bot memory), semantic search only embeds the categories field (missing name/description matches), the single-node Typesense IP is hardcoded and breaks on restart, load behavior is untested, only English is supported, and there is no schema versioning or migration strategy.
stories.oc: Produced a catalogue of the service's technical debt and improvement areas (Typesense access management, Bedrock region migration, chat history, load testing, search quality, multi-lingual support, schema versioning), setting up scoped follow-on work.

stories.s: Fixed portal code that used array indexes as React keys, a common source of subtle UI rendering bugs.
stories.pr: Not clearly specified beyond the ticket title; portal code used array-index keys, a known anti-pattern that risks incorrect UI rendering when lists change.
stories.oc: Array-index keys replaced with stable keys across the flagged portal components.

stories.s: Removed a circular dependency in the portal's StandsInfo component to keep the codebase maintainable.
stories.pr: Not clearly specified beyond the ticket title; the StandsInfo component had a circular (cyclic) dependency in its code.
stories.oc: The circular dependency in the StandsInfo component was removed.

stories.s: Used AI to find every legacy admin panel text missing translation hooks, paving the way for full localization.
stories.pr: Developers had missed adding translation-service hooks to some admin panel text, leaving strings that could not be translated.
stories.oc: An AI-assisted audit identified admin panel views/texts missing translation wiring, to be fixed and translated in follow-up work.

stories.s: Enabled TypeScript's noImplicitReturns compiler check to catch functions with inconsistent return paths.
stories.pr: Not clearly specified beyond the ticket title; the noImplicitReturns compiler option was not enforced, allowing functions with inconsistent return paths.
stories.oc: noImplicitReturns enabled in the TypeScript config, catching functions with missing return statements.

stories.s: Fixed admin panel code using array indexes as React keys, a common source of rendering bugs.
stories.pr: Not clearly specified beyond the ticket title; admin panel code used array-index keys, a known anti-pattern that risks incorrect UI rendering.
stories.oc: Array-index keys replaced with stable keys in the flagged admin panel components.

stories.s: Fixed the check-in admin list to handle the unsupported 'ssn' action type instead of erroring.
stories.pr: Not clearly specified beyond the ticket title and screenshot; the check-in list admin screen encountered an action type ('ssn') it didn't know how to render.
stories.oc: Support added for the 'ssn' action type in the check-in list admin UI, per the ticket title.

stories.s: Added a per-Lambda cache for routing data in ValidateUser, cutting database connections and reducing RDS exhaustion risk under load.
stories.pr: The expoplatform-ws-ValidateUser Lambda opened a new db_route database connection on every invocation for largely static data, causing RDS connection spikes and unnecessary latency.
stories.oc: The Lambda now caches db_route data per warm container with a configurable TTL, falling back to the database only when the cache is empty or expired, with no functional change to routing behavior.

stories.s: Fixed failing tests in the portal release-candidate branch to keep the CI pipeline reliable.
stories.pr: Not clearly specified beyond the ticket title; the portal release-candidate test suite had failing tests.
stories.oc: Portal RC tests fixed so the pipeline passes reliably.

stories.s: Fixed failing tests in the admin panel release-candidate branch to keep the CI pipeline reliable.
stories.pr: Not clearly specified beyond the ticket title; the admin panel release-candidate test suite had failing tests.
stories.oc: Admin RC tests fixed so the pipeline passes reliably.

stories.s: Moved adminUI/portalUI dev-server deploys to a Docker build done on the pipeline, for more consistent deployments.
stories.pr: Not clearly specified beyond the ticket title; deploys for adminUI/portalUI likely built directly on the dev server, an inefficient or inconsistent process.
stories.oc: The deploy process was changed so building happens on the pipeline and the dev server runs the resulting Docker container.

stories.s: Investigated Sentry dropping portal error data due to a quota limit, to restore reliable error monitoring.
stories.pr: Sentry was dropping error data on the portal after hitting a quota or internal rate limit, leaving gaps in production error visibility.
stories.oc: The Sentry quota issue on portalUI was investigated and addressed (e.g. via sampling/quota adjustment).

stories.s: Fixed an exception that broke login-event statistics tracking.
stories.pr: Not clearly specified beyond the ticket title and screenshot; login-event statistics tracking was throwing an exception.
stories.oc: The exception in login-event statistics was fixed, restoring correct tracking.

stories.s: Refactored the schedule agenda XLS/PDF generator into a universal, reusable render library to cut future export-feature dev time.
stories.pr: ScheduleAgendaGeneratorService mixed XLS and PDF generation logic in an inconsistent, non-universal way, making it hard to maintain, extend, or reuse for other export needs.
stories.oc: The service was split into separate XLS and PDF data generators plus a universal PDF-render library, with consistent data structures between renderers and related bugs fixed.

stories.s: Fixed incorrect frontend handling of the OTP resend/activation flow.
stories.pr: Not clearly specified beyond the ticket title; the frontend mishandled the OTP resend/activation flow.
stories.oc: Frontend OTP resend/activation handling was fixed.

stories.s: Added a clear error message when clipboard copy fails due to browser/iframe permission restrictions, instead of failing silently.
stories.pr: Copy-to-clipboard actions failed silently, as flagged by a Sentry error, when browsers or an iframe's Permissions Policy restricted clipboard access, leaving users confused.
stories.oc: Users now see an explicit error message when clipboard access is denied, rather than a silent or unclear failure.

stories.s: Fixed a null-reference JavaScript error ('offsetTop') flagged in production error monitoring.
stories.pr: Not clearly specified beyond the ticket title and a linked Sentry report; a null-reference error ('offsetTop' on null) was occurring for visitors.
stories.oc: The null-reference bug was fixed, per the ticket title, preventing the error.

stories.s: Fixed handling of invalid color values so they are safely skipped instead of causing errors.
stories.pr: Not clearly specified beyond the ticket title and a screenshot; an invalid color value was being processed somewhere in styling logic.
stories.oc: Invalid color values are now safely skipped instead of causing errors, per the ticket title.

stories.s: Fixed a memory leak in the portal's dev mode that was affecting deployments.
stories.pr: Not clearly specified beyond the ticket title and a screenshot; the portal's dev mode had a memory leak affecting deployments.
stories.oc: The memory leak in portal dev mode was fixed, improving dev server/deployment stability.

stories.s: Cleaned up the builder's global color settings to use a single colors object, removing redundant code in the portal's helpers reducer.
stories.pr: Not clearly specified beyond the ticket title; the builder's global settings allowed color values outside a single standardized colors object, plus an unnecessary object-type check in helpers.reducer.js.
stories.oc: Global settings color handling was consolidated to a single colors object, and the unneeded object check was removed from helpers.reducer.js in the portal.

stories.s: Fixed a broken portal/alpha Docker build on Bitbucket's CI pipeline.
stories.pr: Not clearly specified beyond the ticket title; the portal/alpha Docker build was failing on Bitbucket's CI.
stories.oc: The portal/alpha Docker build issue on Bitbucket was fixed, restoring the CI pipeline.

stories.s: Fixed approval-process totals to correctly account for the schedule table and warned organizers before disabling a booked session.
stories.pr: When a session was set to Inactive, it was removed from participants' schedules, but approval-process totals and queries did not join against the schedule table, producing incorrect participant counts and lists.
stories.oc: Queries now join the schedule table so totals and participant lists are accurate, and the "disable session" confirmation message now warns that doing so removes it from all booked participants' schedules.

stories.s: Fixed 57 failing frontend test files (109 cases) surfaced after the Next14 migration, restoring a trustworthy CI test suite.
stories.pr: After migrating to Next14 (and from Jest to Vitest), 57 of 519 test files (109 test cases) were failing due to pre-existing component/test logic issues such as missing context providers, style-assertion mismatches, and async/mock configuration problems — not the migration itself.
stories.oc: Failing tests across auth, comments, documents, events, filters, lead capture, mixed cards, and meeting program components were fixed by adding missing context providers, correcting style assertions, and fixing async/mock handling.

stories.s: Changed the logic behind the Tour button; the ticket does not specify further detail.
stories.pr: Not clearly specified beyond the ticket title; the "Tour" button's behavior needed changing.
stories.oc: Tour button logic was changed, per the ticket title.

stories.s: Fixed a DOM 'appendChild' error on the portal main page reported on mobile Android devices.
stories.pr: The portal main page threw a DOM error ("Only one element on document allowed") on mobile Android/Chrome, likely from duplicate script or widget injection into the page.
stories.oc: The appendChild/DOM-injection bug on the main page was fixed, per the ticket title.

stories.s: Fixed the 'copy filter link' feature returning a stale URL after the search filter was changed more than once.
stories.pr: After copying a filter link once and then changing the search filter again, subsequent "copy link" actions produced an outdated link because no new request/state update was triggered.
stories.oc: The "copy filter link" feature now reflects the current filter state correctly on repeated use.

stories.s: Exhibitors who buy Custom Questions in Lead Capture Pro now get unlimited lead-capture questions automatically, strengthening the paid upsell.
stories.pr: Exhibitors wanting extensive lead-capture forms were capped by Organizer-configured limits on Standard/Additional questions, even after purchasing Custom Questions as part of Lead Capture Pro.
stories.oc: Purchasing Custom Questions now automatically sets Standard and Additional Lead Capture Questions to unlimited (overriding any Organizer limit, non-revertible) and enables all Standard questions by default with no manual admin configuration.

stories.s: Fixed a missing layout gap on the exhibitor page design, applied consistently across Next14 and Next12.
stories.pr: Not clearly specified beyond the ticket title and screenshot; a spacing/gap was missing in the exhibitor page layout on Next14.
stories.oc: The missing gap/spacing was added to the exhibitor page design, applied as a hotfix on Next12 as well since it had the same issue.

stories.s: Fixed Android search results not scrolling into view at the top of the page, an unexpected UX issue raised internally.
stories.pr: On Android, applying a search on various pages could leave results positioned off the top of the screen, an unexpected and confusing UX.
stories.oc: Search list scroll/positioning behavior was investigated and fixed so results display starting at the top of the page.

stories.s: Added a hover color state to sign-in page buttons for visual consistency.
stories.pr: Not clearly specified beyond the ticket title and screenshot; sign-in page buttons lacked a hover color state.
stories.oc: A hover color was added to the sign-in page buttons.

stories.s: Quantified how often the old AI meeting-summarizer misassigned action points, validating the new logic ahead of MTT's move to production.
stories.pr: The original AI meeting-notes summarization logic sometimes mis-mapped action points to the wrong participant due to participant recognition/mapping errors.
stories.oc: An analysis quantifying participant/action-point mismatch patterns in the old logic, used as evidence for the improvement delivered by the new summarization approach.

stories.s: Investigated the current ExpoAssistant AI Agent implementation to lay groundwork for planned improvements.
stories.pr: Not clearly specified beyond the ticket title and epic; understanding the current ExpoAssistant AI Agent implementation was needed before improving it.
stories.oc: The current ExpoAssistant implementation was investigated to inform planned improvements.

stories.s: Added a loading spinner to the Tickets page update flow so users no longer think the app is frozen when updating.
stories.pr: Tapping "update" on the Tickets page left the screen looking frozen with no visual feedback, and a designed loading spinner for this flow had never been implemented, confusing users into thinking the app was stuck.
stories.oc: Loading/updating behavior on the Tickets page was improved with proper spinner feedback matching the original design, across iOS and Android.

stories.s: Applied performance optimizations to the Next14 frontend; the ticket does not specify which metrics or areas.
stories.pr: Not clearly specified beyond the ticket title; the Next14 frontend needed performance optimization.
stories.oc: Performance optimizations were applied to the Next14 frontend, per the ticket title.

stories.s: Integrated Claude Code into the Playwright test repo so it can analyze the project and suggest improvements.
stories.pr: The Playwright test repository lacked AI-assisted tooling to help analyze and improve its structure and coverage.
stories.oc: Claude Code was installed and initialized in the Playwright test repository, with an initial project analysis and improvement pass.

stories.s: Integration team defined measurable Availability and Latency SLOs for its owned endpoints, per the company-wide reliability framework.
stories.pr: Engineering lacked documented, measurable reliability targets (SLOs) per endpoint/service, limiting visibility into platform health and accountability for reliability.
stories.oc: The Integration team inventoried its owned endpoints/services and documented Availability and Latency SLOs (plus any needed application-specific SLOs) in Confluence following the standard template, based on real Grafana performance data.

stories.s: Updated the meeting-generation backend logic and payload ahead of the Shoptalk Spring event, verifying account limits, connections, and role visibility data.
stories.pr: The meeting-generation/matching backend needed its API payload changed per a suggested design, and several related data structures (account connections, limits, role visibility, timeslot blocks) needed verifying ahead of a major client event.
stories.oc: Backend payload/logic was updated and confirmed against a checklist of core meeting-generation data (accounts, limits, connections, role access/visibility, timeslot blocks), with two related items spun off into follow-up tickets.

stories.s: Replaced the AdminUI's TextField component, likely as part of a UI library modernization; no further detail specified.
stories.pr: Not clearly specified beyond the ticket title; the AdminUI's TextField component needed replacing, likely an outdated or deprecated UI library component.
stories.oc: The TextField component was replaced in AdminUI, per the ticket title.

stories.pr: Not clearly specified beyond the ticket title; Reach5 authentication likely did not work properly for developers running the app on localhost.
stories.oc: A useReach5DevProxy hook was added to handle Reach5 auth in local development.

stories.s: Fixed a regression where HTML-formatted description text rendered incorrectly on iOS/Android compared to admin content.
stories.pr: Not clearly specified beyond the ticket title and screenshots; HTML-formatted description text was rendering inconsistently in the mobile apps compared to the admin panel source, flagged during regression testing.
stories.oc: The HTML description rendering issue was fixed on iOS/Android to match the intended admin-panel content.

stories.pr: The Next.js 14 migration left authentication integration work (Reach5) incomplete or broken and needing to be finished/fixed.
stories.oc: Reach5 auth integration implemented/fixed on next14.

stories.oc: LocationAndTime.jsx rewritten as a typed TS/TSX component.

stories.pr: The component was written in untyped JS, adding to technical debt in the admin codebase.

stories.s: Set up Claude/AI tooling infrastructure for the portal-ui project to enable AI-assisted development.
stories.pr: portal-ui lacked the infrastructure needed to use Claude/AI-assisted development tooling.
stories.oc: Claude-related infrastructure set up for portal-ui.

stories.pr: The server was making a request to get user/auth data even when the token was null, an unnecessary round-trip.
stories.oc: Server no longer issues the /auth request when the token is null.

stories.s: Documented the Docker build process for the DevOps team to reduce reliance on tribal knowledge.
stories.pr: The Docker build process was not documented, making it harder for DevOps to maintain and understand.
stories.oc: Documentation on the Docker build process was produced.

stories.s: Moved sign-in redirect logic to the server as part of adapting the auth flow to the next14 architecture.
stories.pr: Sign-in redirect logic needed to move server-side to align with the next14 architecture.
stories.oc: Sign-in redirect logic now runs on the server.

stories.s: Added a Redis GUI to the next14 environment so developers can inspect cache data more easily.
stories.pr: No visual tool existed for developers to inspect Redis data in the next14 setup.
stories.oc: A Redis GUI was added to the next14 dev environment.

stories.s: Migrated the not-found (404) page to server components to complete the next14 architecture migration.
stories.pr: The not-found page still needed to be migrated to the server-component pattern used elsewhere in next14.
stories.oc: Not-found page now implemented as a server component.

stories.s: Optimized dynamic imports on the profile page in next14 to improve page load performance.
stories.pr: Profile page's dynamic imports were not optimized, likely hurting load performance.
stories.oc: Dynamic imports on the profile page were optimized.

stories.s: Set up separate alpha/RC/hotfix release channels for next14 to enable safer, more controlled releases.
stories.pr: next14 lacked a structured release process with separate alpha, release-candidate, and hotfix channels.
stories.oc: Alpha/RC/hotfix release channels were established for next14.

stories.s: Fixed the messages feature in next14 to restore parity with how it worked in next12.
stories.pr: Messages UI/behavior in next14 didn't match next12, based on the before/after comparison attached to the ticket.
stories.oc: Messages feature fixed in next14.

stories.s: Switched translations to load dynamically in next14, reducing what needs to be bundled upfront.
stories.pr: Translations were likely bundled statically, which is inefficient for the next14 architecture.
stories.oc: Translations now load dynamically in next14.

stories.s: Restored the missing language selector on widgets in next14 so multi-language support works again.
stories.pr: Widgets in next14 were missing the language selector control.
stories.oc: Language selector restored on widgets.

stories.s: Fixed a layout-shift bug where a slider visibly jumped on mount in the next14 frontend.
stories.pr: A slider visibly shifted on mount, a layout-shift bug in the next14 frontend.
stories.oc: Slider no longer shifts on mount.

stories.s: Fixed Android so an organizer's custom name for the Sponsors section also shows correctly inside Round Table topics.
stories.pr: Organizers' custom naming for the 'Sponsors' section wasn't applied inside Round Table (RT) topic screens, breaking branding consistency.
stories.oc: Custom translation for the Sponsors section now applies inside RT topics on Android.

stories.s: Fixed article sharing in next14 which was generating the wrong URL when shared to social platforms like Facebook.
stories.pr: Sharing a news article via social channels generated an incorrect link, undermining content distribution.
stories.oc: Article sharing now produces the correct URL.

stories.s: Added backend test coverage for the Exhibitor Manual feature to reduce regression risk.
stories.pr: The Exhibitor Manual backend lacked test coverage.
stories.oc: New backend tests created for manuals.

stories.s: Rewrote the admin panel's EventForm to TypeScript as part of the ongoing JS-to-TS migration.
stories.pr: The component was written in untyped JS, adding to technical debt in the admin codebase.
stories.oc: EventForm rewritten in TypeScript.

stories.s: Rewrote the admin panel's Tabs component to TypeScript as part of the ongoing JS-to-TS migration.
stories.pr: The component was written in untyped JS, adding to technical debt in the admin codebase.
stories.oc: Tabs.jsx rewritten in TypeScript.

stories.s: Rewrote the admin panel's ShowObject component to TypeScript as part of the ongoing JS-to-TS migration.
stories.pr: The component was written in untyped JS, adding to technical debt in the admin codebase.
stories.oc: ShowObject.jsx rewritten in TypeScript.

stories.s: Rewrote the admin panel's shared /UI folder components to TypeScript as part of the ongoing JS-to-TS migration.
stories.pr: Shared UI components were written in untyped JS, adding to technical debt in the admin codebase.
stories.oc: Files inside /UI rewritten in TypeScript.

stories.s: Rewrote the admin panel's ProfileCard component to TypeScript as part of the ongoing JS-to-TS migration.
stories.pr: The component was written in untyped JS, adding to technical debt in the admin codebase.
stories.oc: ProfileCard.jsx rewritten in TypeScript.

stories.s: Fixed the site builder to clear its cache after save so organizers immediately see their changes take effect.
stories.pr: Saved changes in the builder weren't reflected because stale cache wasn't cleared.
stories.oc: Builder cache is now cleared automatically after save.

stories.s: Fixed inconsistent button HTML markup between admin, next12 and next14 so buttons behave and render consistently.
stories.pr: The same buttons produced different HTML markup (e.g. button-in-anchor vs plain anchor) across admin, next12, and next14, causing inconsistent behavior/styling.
stories.oc: Button markup made consistent across the platforms as part of next14 fix-up.

stories.s: Restored the missing data-styleid attribute on sitebuilder buttons in next14 so organizers can style them again.
stories.pr: The data-styleid attribute, used by the site builder to target elements for custom styling, was missing from buttons in next14.
stories.oc: data-styleid attribute restored on sitebuilder buttons.

stories.s: Rewrote files inside the admin panel's /pages folder to TypeScript as part of the ongoing JS-to-TS migration.
stories.pr: Page-level components were written in untyped JS, adding to technical debt in the admin codebase.
stories.oc: Files inside /pages rewritten in TypeScript.

stories.s: Backported the EP-32657 fix to NEXT12 to keep that version consistent with other platform versions.
stories.pr: A fix already applied elsewhere hadn't yet been applied to NEXT12, leaving that version inconsistent.
stories.oc: The EP-32657 fix was applied to NEXT12.

stories.s: Rewrote files inside the admin panel's /plugins folder to TypeScript as part of the ongoing JS-to-TS migration.
stories.pr: Plugin-related components were written in untyped JS, adding to technical debt in the admin codebase.
stories.oc: Files inside /plugins rewritten in TypeScript.

stories.s: Rewrote files inside the admin panel's /utils folder to TypeScript as part of the ongoing JS-to-TS migration.
stories.pr: Utility code was written in untyped JS, adding to technical debt in the admin codebase.
stories.oc: Files inside /utils rewritten in TypeScript.

stories.s: Rewrote files inside the admin panel's /hooks folder to TypeScript as part of the ongoing JS-to-TS migration.
stories.pr: Hook code was written in untyped JS, adding to technical debt in the admin codebase.
stories.oc: Files inside /hooks rewritten in TypeScript.

stories.s: Made Sponsorship statistics export generation reliable for large datasets, fixing failures reported in EP-46119.
stories.pr: Generating the Sponsorship statistics export could fail, especially for events with a lot of data (per bug EP-46119).
stories.oc: Sponsorship export generation improved to reliably complete even with large amounts of data.

stories.s: Wired adminUI's unit test reports into SonarQube so coverage, bugs and code issues are visible for that project.
stories.pr: adminUI's code quality (test coverage, bugs, issues) wasn't visible in SonarQube.
stories.oc: adminUI unit test coverage now tracked in SonarQube.

stories.s: Fixed Integration Hub to keep account username in sync with email changes, and added tests/docs so login/matching doesn't break.
stories.pr: When an account's email changed via Integration Hub, the EP username wasn't updated, causing email/username mismatches that could break login and matching.
stories.oc: Username now updates in sync with email changes (when username was email-derived), conflicts are handled safely, and the behavior is documented and covered by tests.

stories.s: Investigated whether getUserRole's handling of multi-role arrays was correct, following a reviewer's concern on a related PR.
stories.pr: A user can have multiple roles returned as an array, and code may depend on array order from the backend; a reviewer flagged this as potentially incorrect.
stories.oc: Current getUserRole behavior investigated and clarified.

stories.s: Migrated the Android download screen to WorkManager for more reliable background download handling, keeping all existing features.
stories.pr: The download screen's background task handling wasn't using WorkManager, Android's recommended approach for reliable background work.
stories.oc: Download screen now fully functional on WorkManager with all existing download features retained.

stories.s: Fixed the Android lead capture screen where Contact details (phone/email) were missing entirely instead of following the configured show/hide setting.
stories.pr: The Contact details section was entirely missing from the lead capture scan screen, instead of being conditionally shown/hidden based on settings as intended.
stories.oc: Contact details field restored on the lead capture screen, respecting the show/hide setting.

stories.s: Fixed the community page's recommendation slider so its appearance matches the approved Figma design.
stories.pr: The recommendation slider's appearance on the community page didn't match its design spec.
stories.oc: Recommendation slider now matches the design.

stories.s: Refactored the event cloning system from an 800-line god class into a handler-registry pipeline, adding logging, partial-failure resilience, and easy extensibility.
stories.pr: Event cloning logic had become an ~800-line 'god class' with copy-paste handlers, no retry/partial recovery, no observability, implicit ordering, and no idempotency guarantee, making it hard to extend or debug and blocking team scalability.
stories.oc: Cloning now uses a handler-registry + pipeline model: a new clone handler is a single new file with zero core changes, a single handler failure no longer halts the whole clone, every handler execution is logged with status/duration/error, clone logic was removed from the Events model, and the orchestrator shrank to ~50 lines.

stories.s: Migrated the Android OCR scan screen to Jetpack Compose as part of modernizing the app's UI toolkit.
stories.pr: The OCR scan screen was built with the older Android UI toolkit, adding to technical debt as the app moves to Jetpack Compose.
stories.oc: OCR scan feature migrated to Jetpack Compose.

stories.s: Fixed a basket validation bug that wrongly rejected valid equipment/event/ticket item IDs, which could have blocked legitimate purchases.
stories.pr: Adding a valid, existing item (equipment/event/ticket) to the basket was being wrongly blocked by an 'Invalid itemId' validation error.
stories.oc: Basket 'add' validation now correctly accepts valid item IDs across equipment, event, and ticket types.

stories.s: Fixed the payment checkout API to return a proper 400 validation error, instead of a misleading 403, when paymentTo is missing.
stories.pr: Submitting an individual payment without the required paymentTo field returned a misleading 403 Forbidden instead of a 400 validation error.
stories.oc: Missing paymentTo now correctly returns a 400 validation error.

stories.s: Fixed a fatal OOM crash caused by infinite recursion in error-notification handling when the SQS queue is unavailable.
stories.pr: When an error occurred and SQS (the queue used for Discord error notifications) was unavailable, the error-handling code recursively re-triggered itself, exhausting server memory and crashing the request instead of returning a clean error.
stories.oc: Error handling no longer recurses infinitely when SQS fails; endpoints return proper error responses instead of crashing.

stories.s: Fixed the auth endpoint to correctly return a user's resolved country and isCountryFixed flag instead of blank/false values.
stories.pr: The auth response returned an empty country field and isCountryFixed:false even when a country/fixed-country setting was set on the account.
stories.oc: Auth endpoint now correctly resolves and returns country and isCountryFixed.

stories.s: Fixed the basket update endpoint so it returns only the correct validation error, not a duplicate unexpected one, for a non-existent item.
stories.pr: Updating a basket with a non-existent item ID returned two validation errors (one extra, unexpected 'Invalid id value') instead of just the expected itemId error.
stories.oc: Basket update now returns only the expected single validation error for a non-existent item.

stories.s: Built a reusable ExpoButton SwiftUI component for iOS, matching the Figma design system spec.
stories.pr: The iOS app lacked a standardized, reusable button component built in SwiftUI.
stories.oc: ExpoButton component created in SwiftUI per the Figma spec.

stories.s: Fixed an infinite-recursion bug in the shared error-notification utility (Utils::addToQueue) that could crash the server with an OOM error whenever the queue was unavailable.
stories.pr: When Utils::addToQueue() failed, its own error-handling path (sendException -> sendDiscordNotify -> addToQueue) called back into addToQueue with no recursion guard, causing memory to grow until the server hit its 512MB limit and crashed.
stories.oc: A recursion guard was added so addToQueue/sendException no longer re-enter each other, eliminating the OOM crash.

stories.s: Fixed a type mismatch (null passed where an int was required) in the round-table-invitation test factory that was breaking three filter tests.
stories.pr: The test factory for OfflineEventTopicsRequests passed table_id: null into a setter typed to require an int, causing a TypeError and failing three round-table invitation filter tests.
stories.oc: Factory/type-hint mismatch resolved so the affected tests pass.

stories.s: Fixed notification filters that wrongly returned 0 results for speed-networking and rejected-meeting segments, restoring accurate audience targeting.
stories.pr: Multiple notification filter types (no meeting requests sent/responded to, rejected meetings, sessions not booked) returned 0 results even when matching accounts existed, and some triggered out-of-memory errors.
stories.oc: Notification list filters now correctly join the underlying speed-networking/meeting tables and return the expected matching accounts.

stories.s: Fixed a null exhibitor-category bug that broke exhibitor creation across Genesis, MapYourShow, and Visit integrations.
stories.pr: Exhibitor category lookups returned null/false instead of a category object, crashing exhibitor creation/update flows in three separate third-party integrations.
stories.oc: Exhibitor category lookups now return valid objects so exhibitor creation and category mapping succeed across all three integrations.

stories.s: Fixed a silent null failure in the Visit integration's visitor creation pipeline that was breaking account, GDPR, and role handling.
stories.pr: Visit-integration visitor creation failed silently, cascading into failures for account status, team roles, GDPR acceptance, and deletion checks.
stories.oc: Visit integration visitor/account creation now returns a valid account object, restoring downstream role, GDPR, and deletion handling.

stories.s: Fixed CDS integration so visitor fields from CDS payloads are actually saved to accounts instead of being silently dropped.
stories.pr: Fields sent in CDS integration payloads were not being written to the account or AccountAttr tables, affecting visitor creation, updates, and GDPR data preservation.
stories.oc: CDS-sourced visitor fields are now correctly persisted on account creation and update.

stories.s: Fixed Aditus integration account creation, which was returning null and breaking team-member role preservation.
stories.pr: Aditus integration account creation failed, causing team member condition and role preservation checks to fail across 6 test methods.
stories.oc: Aditus account creation now succeeds, restoring correct team-member condition and role handling.

stories.s: Fixed a SQL syntax error and two data-mapping bugs (custom questions, product categories) in the A2Z integration.
stories.pr: A2Z integration processing had a SQL syntax error (dangling OR), failed to store custom question answers as AccountInfo, and failed to map product categories to ExhibitorBusinessArea.
stories.oc: A2Z integration now runs valid SQL, stores custom question answers, and correctly maps product categories.

stories.s: Fixed N200 integration visitor creation, which returned null and crashed downstream custom-question mapping.
stories.pr: N200 integration failed to create the visitor account and then called getAccountEvent() on the null result, breaking custom question mapping.
stories.oc: N200 visitor account creation now succeeds, allowing custom question mapping to proceed without crashing.

stories.s: Fixed Visit integration username-sync failures caused by the same null-account bug affecting visitor creation.
stories.pr: SyncUsernameWithEmail behavior (updating username on email change) could not be verified because account creation upstream in the Visit integration returned null.
stories.oc: Visit integration username-sync now works against a valid account, and the 4 related test methods pass.

stories.s: Registered a missing DI service in the CLI test environment so campaign-processing tests can run again.
stories.pr: The configStatistics service was not registered in the DI container for the CLI test environment, breaking the campaign processing test.
stories.oc: The configStatistics service is now available in the CLI test DI container, unblocking the campaign processing test.

stories.s: Mocked an unreliable external VAT-validation service so the CompanyPayment test suite can run offline instead of being skipped.
stories.pr: A VAT-number validation test was permanently skipped because it called an unreliable external VAT-validation service during CI/test runs.
stories.oc: The VAT validation test is expected to run reliably offline via a mocked service instead of being permanently skipped.

stories.s: Added a manual input field for OCR scan debugging on Android, matching the existing simple-scan debug tool.
stories.pr: The debug-mode OCR scan flow lacked a manual input field that the equivalent 'simply scan' flow already has, making it harder to test/debug OCR scanning.
stories.oc: Android debug builds now expose a manual input field for OCR scans, matching the simple-scan debug experience.

stories.s: Fixed the Speakers search filter to return a missing 'country' key, completing country-based speaker filtering.
stories.pr: The Speakers search filter endpoint did not return a 'country' key in its filter values, failing an automated test and leaving country filtering incomplete for speakers.
stories.oc: Speakers search filters now return a 'country' key with correct values.

stories.s: Fixed stale search-index data between test runs that was causing 12 search-filter tests to report wrong result counts.
stories.pr: Search query filters across Brands, Exhibitors, Products, and Exhibitor-in-Halls returned extra or wrongly-ordered results because the search index carried stale data from previous test runs.
stories.oc: Search filter tests are expected to see only their own data, giving correct counts and ordering.

stories.s: Fixed basket item deletion so it stops leaving orphaned equipment and manual-submission records behind.
stories.pr: Deleting a basket item left leftover ManualsEquipments and ManualsSubmits records instead of removing/restoring them, risking inconsistent order and equipment data.
stories.oc: Deleting a basket item now correctly restores equipment quantity and removes associated manual submission records.

stories.s: Fixed the round-table 'no response' filter, which was missing a JOIN and returning zero non-responding accounts.
stories.pr: The filter meant to surface accounts with pending/rejected round-table invitation responses failed to add its required table JOIN, so it returned no matches in both builder and non-builder modes.
stories.oc: The no-response filter now adds the correct JOIN and returns accounts with pending or rejected round-table invitation responses.

stories.s: Fixed test data leakage that made EventsReadRepository tests report inflated event counts across 8 test methods.
stories.pr: All 8 EventsReadRepository tests reported inflated event counts because events created by earlier tests leaked into later queries.
stories.oc: EventsReadRepository tests are expected to see only their own event data, matching expected counts.

stories.s: Fixed Lead Capture Pro payments so VAT calculates correctly instead of returning 0.00, alongside a test-environment payment config gap.
stories.pr: Lead capture payment creation failed due to an unconfigured payment integration in the test environment, and lead-capture VAT amounts calculated as 0.00 instead of the expected values.
stories.oc: Payment integration is configured for tests, and lead-capture VAT now calculates the expected non-zero amounts.

stories.s: Fixed foreign-key violations in functional tests caused by DB triggers not seeing events created inside the same test transaction.
stories.pr: Postgres triggers that write to cache_keys and permission_relations failed with FK violations because the event row created within a test's transaction wasn't visible to the trigger's FK check.
stories.oc: Functional tests affected by this FK violation are expected to pass once the trigger/transaction handling is adjusted.

stories.s: Fixed ticket-service bugs in country list ordering and country-lock validation, including a missing exception that let a fixed country be changed.
stories.pr: The countries dictionary returned in the wrong order, an undefined attr_key property caused errors in SetCountry, and the system failed to throw CountryIsAlreadySetException when a visitor's country was already fixed.
stories.oc: Countries list order is corrected, the attr_key error is resolved, and the country-already-set validation now throws the expected exception.

stories.s: Fixed a source-code bug that made every basket discount type (absolute, multi-buy, code) calculate as 0 instead of the correct amount.
stories.pr: Every discount type on the basket — absolute discounts, multi-buy discounts, and discount codes — calculated as 0, meaning discounted checkout totals were wrong across 7 functional tests.
stories.oc: Basket discount calculations now return the correct non-zero amounts for absolute, multi-buy, and code-based discounts.

stories.s: Fixed two basket-availability tests that used wrong test dates and timezone-sensitive date math rather than reflecting a real defect.
stories.pr: AddUnavailableCest set ticket sale-end dates in the future while testing an 'ended' scenario, and ItemsAvailabilityCest's date-of-day precision was lost to timezone-sensitive Carbon date formatting.
stories.oc: The two tests are corrected to use appropriate dates and timezone-safe comparisons.

stories.s: Fixed disabled database cleanup that let stale records pile up across test runs and inflate counts in 3 test suites.
stories.pr: With database cleanup disabled in functional.suite.yml, DataFactory-created records persisted across runs, inflating counts in EventsReadRepositoryCest, DeleteBasketItemCest, and ActualTicketsCest.
stories.oc: Restoring database cleanup between test runs is expected to eliminate cross-test data leakage.

stories.s: Investigating why RegisterPricing basket operations throw an unexpected item-unavailable error in 8 test cases.
stories.pr: Adding a RegisterPricing item to the basket or fetching its order threw ItemUnavailableException in 8 test cases, likely due to missing configuration or prerequisite test data.
stories.oc: Investigation is expected to identify whether the availability check itself is broken or the test environment is missing required setup.

stories.s: Fixed a timezone bug that made valid tickets appear expired at check-in before the correct zone/date rules could even run.
stories.pr: Tickets::isExpired() checked expiration using the server's timezone instead of the event's timezone (unlike the correctly-implemented isActiveToday()), so the expiration handler fired first and masked 16 check-in tests' actual zone/date checks.
stories.oc: Tickets::isExpired() now uses the event timezone consistently, so check-in expiration checks no longer incorrectly block valid tickets.

stories.s: Fixed a ticket-validation test using stale hardcoded 2024 dates that no longer matched the event fixture.
stories.pr: A ticket date-validation test asserted a specific error message tied to hardcoded 2024 dates, but the event fixture's dates had shifted, so a different validation error fired first.
stories.oc: The test now aligns with current event fixture date boundaries and asserts the correct validation message.

stories.s: Fixed an incomplete Checkin model test factory that was failing to save records needed for check-in export tests.
stories.pr: The Checkin model factory used by UniquenessMapCest failed to save, likely due to missing required fields or a constraint violation in the factory definition.
stories.oc: The Checkin factory is expected to save successfully once its definition is corrected.
