stories.s: Fixed the manual sections API to return admin-configured default values for conditional-logic fields even before a user has saved anything.
stories.pr: The /api/v1/manuals/sections endpoint did not return conditional-logic default field values (selectedConditions) until a user had first saved their own selection via /api/v1/manuals/sectionSave, leaving the frontend without defaults for untouched fields.
stories.oc: The manual sections API now returns the admin-configured default conditional-logic values in the expected format, even without a prior save.

stories.s: Fixed the Android app so background sync no longer force-closes the burger menu mid-navigation.
stories.pr: When the app received a background sync while the burger menu was open, the menu closed unexpectedly, causing navigation failures and flaky UI during active sync.
stories.oc: The burger menu now stays open during background sync, with menu-related updates applied the next time it's opened.

stories.s: Root-caused a Phalcon/PDO bug where 10+ column models (including Payments) generate ambiguous bind parameters and fail to save.
stories.pr: Phalcon 4's ORM generates numbered bind placeholders like :10title that PDO misinterprets as a prefix match for :1, causing 'invalid parameter number' errors on models with 10+ columns.
stories.oc: The root cause is documented with concrete fix options, informing the emulated-prepares fix later applied in EP-51409.

stories.s: Fixed 6 tests that only failed in the full suite due to shared Phalcon model-manager and config state leaking between tests.
stories.pr: Phalcon's model-manager relationship cache, the config DI singleton, and model hook state persisted across tests, causing 6 tests to fail in the full suite despite passing in isolation.
stories.oc: Resetting the model manager (and config singleton where needed) between tests is expected to resolve all 6 affected tests.

stories.s: Fixed an array-to-string conversion notice in the ticket dictionaries service caused by a JSON field being handled as a raw array.
stories.pr: ManageTicketsService::getDictionaries() triggers an array-to-string conversion notice, likely from a JSON/multi-lang field (colors or title) being handled as a raw array.
stories.oc: The dictionary field causing the conversion is expected to be JSON-encoded correctly before string operations, eliminating the notice.

stories.s: Fixed exhibitor ADMIN basket retrieval, which was wrongly restricted to manual-only items like regular exhibitor accounts.
stories.pr: getBasket()->getItems() returned only 1 item instead of 2 for an exhibitor account with the ADMIN role, incorrectly applying the same manual-items-only restriction meant for non-admin exhibitors.
stories.oc: Exhibitor ADMIN team members' baskets now correctly include both manual and regular items.

stories.s: Investigating why the Account model test factory fails to save, blocking 12 integer-filter test cases.
stories.pr: Account::class test factory saves fail in IntegerFilterWrongTypesDelegatesCest, possibly due to a missing required field or a new NOT NULL schema constraint.
stories.oc: Investigation is expected to identify and correct the missing field or constraint blocking Account factory saves in tests.

stories.s: Fixed a test/resource ordering mismatch where a participant's event registrations came back in a different (but complete) order than expected.
stories.pr: The resource returns 3 event registrations in a non-insertion order (e.g., by id/timestamp), while the test assumed ascending creation order — no data was missing, only the order differed.
stories.oc: Either the resource's ordering is made deterministic and documented, or the test is fixed to not assume insertion order.

stories.s: Reworked the bySession report export to run via SQS, making it faster and more stable for admins downloading session data.
stories.pr: The bySession report export under Sessions → Reports was slow and unstable for admins to download.
stories.oc: The bySession export now runs via SQS, with the downloaded report containing all the expected session information.

stories.s: Migrated the Android app to Gradle 9 to keep the build system current and avoid future compatibility breakage.
stories.pr: The Android app was on an older Gradle version, risking incompatibility with newer plugins/dependencies and eventual build failures.
stories.oc: The Gradle wrapper, build.gradle files, and any deprecated plugins/dependencies are updated to build successfully on Gradle 9.

stories.s: Added a unique constraint to stop new duplicate item tags, while safely preserving existing duplicates via a legacy-flag migration.
stories.pr: The item_tags table allowed duplicate tag names per type/event, with no unique constraint enforcing the application's own case-sensitive uniqueness rule.
stories.oc: A unique index now prevents new duplicate tags, while existing duplicates are preserved and marked legacy so they're exempt from the constraint.

stories.s: Added a Default Language field to the Native Integration Hub's Exhibitor Create/Update mappings.
stories.pr: The Native Integration Hub's Exhibitor mappings lacked a Default Language field needed for exhibitor data mapping.
stories.oc: The Default Language field is now available in the Exhibitor Create and Update mappings.

stories.s: Hardened DS pipeline validation and fixed several Hive matchmaking bugs (meeting limits, sponsor limits, blocked slots) ahead of Shoptalk's hard deadline.
stories.pr: The system previously used a 'swallow and ignore' approach to bad data feeding the DS scheduling pipeline — a known piece of technical debt risking corrupted meeting schedules.
stories.oc: DS-pipeline validation now mirrors the DS team's rules, plus fixes for max meetings between companies, exhibitor-ID-based company identity, blocked timeslots, and buyer/team-member sponsor limits — all rechecked by QA.

stories.s: Checked/fixed iOS Crashlytics DSYM upload so crash reports can be properly symbolicated (ticket had no further detail).
stories.pr: Not clearly specified beyond the ticket title — no description was provided.
stories.oc: Not clearly specified beyond the ticket title; presumed to ensure DSYM files upload correctly for crash symbolication.

stories.s: Investigated and fixed missing sponsor/banner statistics tracking and rebuilt the ClickHouse tool used to monitor it.
stories.pr: Sponsor/banner impression statistics were not being recorded through the banners/get request, undermining confidence in banner performance data, and the existing ClickHouse monitoring tool needed rework.
stories.oc: The banners/get stats-recording gap is investigated and resolved (fixed or intentionally removed), and the ClickHouse monitoring tool is rewritten.

stories.s: Fixed the Default Language field to pull from the platform's real list of available languages instead of a hardcoded set.
stories.pr: The Default Language field's language list wasn't using the platform's real list of available languages, unlike a pattern already used for the N200 integration.
stories.oc: The Default Language field now derives its options from the platform's actual list of available languages.

stories.s: Closed a permission gap that let restricted or guest users see/interact with an Exhibitor's Products even when the Exhibitor itself was restricted.
stories.pr: Visibility and interaction (Message/Meeting) restrictions configured for Exhibitors in the Permission Matrix did not extend to their Products, so restricted or guest users could still see and interact with Products even when the parent Exhibitor was restricted — a gap flagged by prior bug reports (EP-39330, EP-50064).
stories.oc: Products now inherit their Exhibitor's resolved visibility and Message/Meeting interaction restrictions, consistently across web and mobile, including for users with multiple roles/categories.

stories.s: Documented 10 Exhibitor analytics/check-in APIs in Swagger as part of a broader initiative to cut tech debt and speed up API testing.
stories.pr: 10 Exhibitor APIs (analyticsCheckIn/analyticsCheckinList endpoints) lacked up-to-date Swagger documentation, slowing API testing and integration work.
stories.oc: The 10 listed Exhibitor Analytics/Check-in endpoints are documented and verified working from the Swagger page, with tracking status marked Done.

stories.s: Investigated an ExpoFP floorplan loading error on a Next.js 14 event site (ticket had only a link and screenshot, no further detail).
stories.pr: Not clearly specified beyond a linked event URL and a screenshot showing an ExpoFP error during loading on a Next.js 14 site.
stories.oc: Not clearly specified beyond the ticket title; presumed to fix the floorplan loading error on the affected site.

stories.s: Fixed the meeting scheduling API to stop returning already-booked or blocked time slots as available.
stories.pr: The scheduling API could return time slots that had pre-existing bookings or were otherwise blocked, letting users attempt to book unavailable times.
stories.oc: The API now filters out blocked/booked time slots, returning only availability for booking.

stories.s: Built a dedicated XML-parsing service for manual_blocks forms as a follow-up to bug EP-45192 (ticket had no further detail).
stories.pr: Not clearly specified beyond the ticket title and its link to bug EP-45192.
stories.oc: Not clearly specified beyond the ticket title; presumed to deliver a dedicated XML-parsing service for manual_blocks forms.

stories.s: Fixed iOS schedule search so results scroll to the top of the list instead of staying at the user's prior scroll position.
stories.pr: After applying a search from partway down the schedule list, results still rendered starting from that same scroll position, forcing users to scroll up to see the full result set.
stories.oc: Search results now scroll to the top of the list after a search is applied, while highlighted-sessions scroll behavior is preserved unchanged.

stories.s: Fixed the functional test suite's root causes — Phalcon's digit-prefixed bind parameters and missing per-test transaction isolation — in one change.
stories.pr: Functional tests suffered from Phalcon-generated digit-prefixed bind parameters causing PDO errors, and from tests not being isolated in transactions, causing widespread test-suite instability and stale-data failures across many other tickets.
stories.oc: PDO emulated prepares are enabled in the bootstrap, and functional.suite.yml now runs every test in its own isolated, rolled-back transaction with savepoints, without materially slowing the full suite.

stories.s: Fixed a visual gap between the header and chat body in the mobile chat popup for a cleaner look.
stories.pr: The mobile chat popup showed a visible gap between the header and the chat content, degrading the visual quality of the chat UI.
stories.oc: The gap between header and chat body was removed so the mobile chat popup renders cleanly.

stories.s: Fixed a session-save error found during RC testing for a specific event and session.
stories.pr: Saving a specific session failed with an error during RC testing, blocking verification of session-management functionality.
stories.oc: Not clearly specified beyond the ticket title; presumed the session-save error was resolved.

stories.s: Optimized an exhibitor-related migration script; ticket has no further detail beyond the title.
stories.pr: Not clearly specified beyond the ticket title.
stories.oc: Not clearly specified beyond the ticket title.

stories.s: Fixed iOS lead scans showing only a company name instead of the full exhibitor card, restoring accurate lead info.
stories.pr: On the iOS Scans page, scanning a team member showed only the company name instead of the expected exhibitor company card, hiding useful lead information from exhibitor staff.
stories.oc: The exhibitor company card now displays correctly inside lead scans on iOS.

stories.s: Swapped out the deep-diff library dependency; ticket has no further detail on the underlying issue.
stories.pr: Not clearly specified beyond the ticket title.
stories.oc: Not clearly specified beyond the ticket title.

stories.s: Fixed CustomHTML blocks running embedded JavaScript twice during the Next.js 14 migration.
stories.pr: CustomHTML blocks were invoking their embedded JS twice, risking duplicate side effects such as double-firing scripts or trackers.
stories.oc: Not clearly specified beyond the ticket title; presumed the block now runs its JS once.

stories.s: Fixed a regex bug that mishandled CSS comments and broke custom CSS rendering.
stories.pr: The regex used to process custom CSS broke when the CSS contained comment-like syntax, causing incorrect CSS output.
stories.oc: Not clearly specified beyond the ticket title; presumed the regex now handles comments correctly.

stories.s: Refactored Exhibitor Settings CRUD into one source of truth, unblocking the upcoming Lead Capture Pro settings feature.
stories.pr: Exhibitor Settings and Exhibitor Category Settings had duplicated or inconsistent CRUD logic with no single source of truth for working with settings.
stories.oc: Consolidated CRUD logic for exhibitor settings into one source of truth, per the ticket's stated goal.

stories.s: Corrected Swagger documentation across all Exhibitor APIs so consumers can rely on accurate specs.
stories.pr: Exhibitor API documentation was inaccurate or incomplete, tracked against a status spreadsheet of endpoints.
stories.oc: Swagger docs corrected and the tracking spreadsheet's status column updated.

stories.s: Added a mobile Calendar View for browsing Sessions by day/time slot, giving attendees a visual alternative to the flat session list.
stories.pr: Mobile users could only browse sessions in a flat List View, making it hard to see overlapping sessions or plan a day visually by time slot.
stories.oc: Shipped a full Calendar View with 1-day/3-day grids, a week-glance strip, overlapping-session overflow handling, track quick-filters, calendar-mode search, and an admin-controlled default view, fully specified for iOS and Android.

stories.s: Standardised the CSS variable used for sticky sidebars/headers and flagged redundant layout code for removal.
stories.pr: Sticky elements (profile sidebar, dashboard table header, marketplace sidebar) likely used inconsistent CSS variables for their sticky offset, causing layout inconsistencies.
stories.oc: Not clearly specified beyond the ticket's investigative notes; the description itself is exploratory ('probably', 'I think').

stories.s: Added a standard offline-connection toast when Android users tap Favourite while disconnected, replacing silent no-op behaviour.
stories.pr: Tapping favourite/unfavourite while offline produced no feedback at all, leaving users unsure whether their action registered.
stories.oc: Tapping favourite while offline now shows the app's standard connection-lost toast across lists, profiles, and recommendations on Android.

stories.s: Added a standard offline-connection toast when iOS users tap Favourite while disconnected, replacing silent no-op behaviour.
stories.pr: Tapping favourite/unfavourite while offline produced no feedback at all, leaving users unsure whether their action registered.
stories.oc: Tapping favourite while offline now shows the app's standard connection-lost toast across lists, profiles, and recommendations on iOS.

stories.s: Assessed ClickHouse data readiness for the new Embeddable.com reporting dashboards to plan the pipelines needed to build them.
stories.pr: It was unknown whether existing ClickHouse tables could support the planned automated event-reporting dashboards, risking wasted build effort or data-granularity gaps.
stories.oc: Produced an inventory of usable ClickHouse tables, missing datasets with their PostgreSQL sources, proposed new ClickHouse tables/pipelines, and a granularity-compatibility assessment.

stories.s: Closed data-leakage and auth-bypass gaps in the schedule/note API, removing internal server details from error responses.
stories.pr: The schedule/note endpoints leaked internal file paths, line numbers, and internal server IPs in error responses, and had auth/input-validation gaps including an auth bypass on PUT and crashes from malformed tokens.
stories.oc: Removed sensitive data leakage from error responses and an undocumented internal IP field, enforced auth-token validation and input bounds; API contract alignment work continuing.

stories.s: Fixed a dynamic-import bug in the manual manager; details were only in an external recording link, not available here.
stories.pr: Not clearly specified beyond the ticket title; details lived only in an external Jam.dev recording not accessible for this analysis.
stories.oc: Not clearly specified beyond the ticket title.

stories.s: Added validation to the color picker so invalid color values can no longer be entered.
stories.pr: Not clearly specified beyond the ticket title.
stories.oc: Not clearly specified beyond the ticket title.

stories.s: Fixed the news page's site URL breaking on direct load or refresh in the Next.js 14 rebuild.
stories.pr: Navigating directly to a specific news article page, or refreshing it, showed a broken or absent domain in the URL, while navigating there from the news list worked fine.
stories.oc: Not clearly specified beyond the ticket title; presumed the siteUrl now resolves correctly on direct load and refresh.

stories.s: Fixed portal-ui content width to match the 1416px design spec, correcting a visual layout inconsistency.
stories.pr: The live content width did not match the design (1416px), causing a visual inconsistency versus the intended layout.
stories.oc: Content width fixed to 1416px per design.

stories.s: Unified 401/403 handling into one reliable logout flow, fixing stale sessions left behind in background browser tabs.
stories.pr: 401/403 handling was inconsistent across the portal (API errors, error pages, manual summary submit), and after a logout in one tab, sibling tabs could silently swallow their first 403 instead of redirecting to login, leaving stale sessions.
stories.oc: All 401/403 responses now trigger a single clear-and-redirect flow, the 'Not paid' modal no longer wrongly triggers on 403, logout analytics ordering was fixed, and every tab now reliably redirects on its own first 403 with debouncing to prevent redirect storms.

stories.s: Removed a logger call from the Next.js server fetch helper; ticket has no further detail on the motivation.
stories.pr: Not clearly specified beyond the ticket title.
stories.oc: Not clearly specified beyond the ticket title.

stories.s: Added rate limiting to /api/v1/resend after a real attack sent 1,116 requests in 15 minutes to flood participant inboxes.
stories.pr: On 28 April 2026, an attacker sent 1,116 requests in ~15 minutes from a single IP to /api/v1/resend, triggering registration emails to 69 participants, because the endpoint had no rate limiting.
stories.oc: The endpoint now allows 5 requests per minute per IP, blocks abusive IPs for 5 minutes with a 429 response, while legitimate single requests keep working.

stories.s: Added internal request/response logging to the resend endpoint so future abuse is caught without relying on external AWS logs.
stories.pr: The 28 April 2026 attack on /api/v1/resend was only discovered via external AWS ALB logs because the platform had no internal logging for this endpoint.
stories.oc: Each call to /api/v1/resend now logs timestamp, IP, submitted email, and response, with sensitive fields redacted.

stories.s: Deduplicated header-building and response-handling logic shared between apiCall and apiSendForm to cut maintenance risk.
stories.pr: Header-construction and response-handling code was duplicated, with slight divergence, between apiCall and apiSendForm, increasing maintenance risk.
stories.oc: Extracted shared buildDefaultHeaders() and processResponse() functions used by both apiCall and apiSendForm.

stories.s: Investigated recurring mobile-app data loss for finished events to define a permanent fix and retention policy.
stories.pr: Clients accessing finished events on the mobile app experienced missing data, with at least two prior incidents worked around only by manually regenerating a 'zero sync file,' with no root-cause fix in place.
stories.oc: Investigation to document the root cause, propose fix options (longer retention, resync rule changes, a separate archived-event sync path), and define retention/resync SLAs.

stories.s: Added a V3 API endpoint listing all products globally across events, decoupling the product entity from any single event.
stories.pr: The legacy API tied products to specific events, with no way to list all products globally or see which events each one belongs to.
stories.oc: New GET /api/v3/products endpoint returns each product's global identity plus the eventIds it is bound to, with pagination.

stories.s: Added a V3 API endpoint to bind an existing global product to a specific event with its own categories and custom fields.
stories.pr: Under the new global product model, there was no endpoint to attach a global product to a given event with event-specific categories and custom fields, or to enforce related validation.
stories.oc: New POST endpoint binds a product to an event, resetting event-scoped data on each bind and enforcing all-or-nothing validation plus duplicate/cap checks.

stories.s: Added a V3 API endpoint to partially update a product's event-specific categories and custom fields.
stories.pr: Once a product was bound to an event, there was no way to update just its event-scoped data without resetting the whole binding.
stories.oc: New PATCH endpoint supports partial updates (tri-state category replace, custom-field merge-by-name) with full validation.

stories.s: Added a V3 API endpoint to unbind a product from one event only, leaving the product and other bindings intact.
stories.pr: There was no clean way to remove a product from a single event only, as opposed to deleting the product entirely.
stories.oc: New DELETE endpoint removes the event binding non-destructively (event-scoped data preserved for future re-binding), leaving the global product and its other event bindings untouched.

stories.s: Restored cross-tab logout sync lost in the Next.js 14 migration so logging out clears session state in every open tab.
stories.pr: After migrating to Next.js 14, logging out in one browser tab no longer cleared in-memory Redux state, sessionStorage, or open subscriptions in sibling tabs, leaving them appearing logged in until their next failed API call.
stories.oc: setBroadcastChannel() is dispatched again on auth initialisation, so logging out in one tab now clears state in all other tabs immediately.

stories.s: Removed the duplicated clsx dependency and its 8 trivial usages, shrinking the bundle and lint-guarding against regressions.
stories.pr: Pinning clsx to an older major version while MUI and other libraries required a newer one prevented deduplication, shipping two copies of clsx into production for functionality trivial enough to write inline.
stories.oc: All 8 call sites rewritten in native JS, clsx removed from package.json, and an ESLint rule added to prevent it creeping back in.

stories.s: Removed the unused, 21MB country-flag-icons dependency, which had zero imports anywhere in the codebase.
stories.pr: country-flag-icons was declared as a dependency but never actually imported anywhere; flags are loaded from CloudFront/S3 instead, leaving it as dead weight.
stories.oc: Dependency removed from package.json and lockfile with confirmed zero functional or bundle impact.

stories.s: Reclassified the build-only ignore-loader package as a devDependency instead of shipping it in production installs.
stories.pr: ignore-loader is used only in the webpack config to strip test files at build time, but was misclassified as a production dependency, bloating the production install.
stories.oc: Package moved to devDependencies with build and test file exclusion verified unaffected.

stories.s: Replaced linkify-react/linkifyjs with an internal regex helper, shrinking the messenger bundle by about 14KB.
stories.pr: The messenger's URL/email auto-linking pulled in roughly 14KB gzipped of linkifyjs/linkify-react for a single use case, when an internal, already-tested regex utility existed for the same purpose.
stories.oc: New linkifyText() helper using existing regex constants replaces the Linkify component in chat messages, with unit tests for edge cases; both packages removed.

stories.s: Removed the unused next-absolute-url dependency, which had no imports anywhere in the codebase.
stories.pr: next-absolute-url was declared in package.json but never imported or called anywhere in the codebase.
stories.oc: Dependency removed from package.json and lockfile; build and tests verified to pass.

stories.s: Removed the unused next-redux-wrapper dependency and corrected stale docs that still referenced it.
stories.pr: next-redux-wrapper was declared as a dependency and mentioned in CLAUDE.md, but the app no longer uses SSR hydration through it; the Redux store is built with plain legacy_createStore, leaving it as dead weight and stale documentation.
stories.oc: Dependency removed and CLAUDE.md corrected; build and tests verified to pass.

stories.s: Removed the vestigial punycode production dependency, unused outside of dev-only tooling.
stories.pr: punycode was declared as a direct dependency since a 2023 cleanup but is never imported by application code, only appearing transitively via dev-only tools (eslint, jsdom, storybook).
stories.oc: Dependency removed from production dependencies; dev-only transitive copies left unaffected; build and tests verified.

stories.s: Removed the unused, ~1.5MB react-dnd dependency since drag-and-drop actually runs on @dnd-kit.
stories.pr: react-dnd was declared as a dependency but never imported anywhere; the codebase's actual drag-and-drop features use @dnd-kit instead, leaving dead weight and a risk of accidental reuse of an outdated API.
stories.oc: Dependency removed from package.json; build and tests verified to pass.

stories.s: Consolidated two competing infinite-scroll libraries into one, migrating the last 3 components and shrinking the bundle.
stories.pr: The codebase carried two libraries doing the same job (infinite scroll), with only 3 files (Participants, Marketplace, Schedule lists) still on the legacy, less-maintained one.
stories.oc: All 3 components migrated to react-infinite-scroll-component; the legacy library and its types removed, saving about 2.8KB gzipped.

stories.s: Removed an abandoned, empty placeholder package (redux-wrapper) carrying a typosquat-style supply-chain risk.
stories.pr: redux-wrapper@0.0.1, an unrelated, unmaintained placeholder package with no executable code, was still declared as a dependency, creating lockfile noise and a typosquat-style supply-chain risk.
stories.oc: Dependency removed from package.json and lockfile; build and tests verified to pass.

stories.s: Removed the unused xml2js dependency, eliminating an associated prototype-pollution CVE from the dependency tree.
stories.pr: xml2js was declared as a dependency but never imported anywhere (look-alike call sites actually use the unrelated xml-js package), and the installed version was flagged by npm audit for a known prototype-pollution vulnerability (CVE-2023-0842).
stories.oc: Dependency removed, eliminating the CVE and audit noise, with xml-js-dependent features (formBuilderV2, edit profile) confirmed unaffected.

stories.s: Added an on-demand bundle-analyzer build script, giving the team repeatable visibility into bundle composition.
stories.pr: There was no easy, repeatable way to inspect production client/server bundle composition on demand.
stories.oc: New build:analyze npm script added, running a production build with the Next.js bundle analyzer enabled, without affecting existing build/dev scripts.

stories.s: Fixed a production Redis cache leak (21MB to 12.44GB in 5 weeks) from per-IP cache fragmentation and a broken tag-cleanup mechanism.
stories.pr: An earlier change began attaching each visitor's IP to every anonymous cacheable server fetch, fragmenting the Next.js fetch cache into one entry per IP, while a separate tag-set redesign never removed expired keys and kept resetting its own TTL, together causing unbounded Redis memory growth, a falling cache hit rate, and rising swap usage in production.
stories.oc: Removed automatic IP-injection from generic anonymous fetches (kept only for login/getAuth), fixed the tag-set lifecycle to drop dead members and stop resetting TTL forever, cleaned up already-accumulated Redis keys, and added monitoring alarms to catch recurrence.

stories.s: Catalogued ~170 Android Maestro test identifiers for iOS to implement, enabling cross-platform automated E2E test coverage.
stories.pr: iOS lacked the accessibility identifiers needed to run the same automated Maestro E2E test suite that already exists for Android, blocking cross-platform test automation.
stories.oc: Produced a verified list of roughly 170 identifiers (164 confirmed against Android resources, 1 needing explicit iOS implementation, 2 skipped as work-in-progress) for iOS to implement.

stories.s: Fixed exhibitor-scoped participant imports silently reporting success even when accounts failed to save.
stories.pr: When an organiser imports a participant list scoped to one exhibitor, the inline import path never checked whether each account save actually succeeded, so the API returned a green 'N imported' response even when some or all rows were never persisted.
stories.oc: Fix identified to check each save's return value and aggregate per-row failures into the response so the reported count reflects only actually-persisted participants.

stories.s: Fixed a bad participant row crashing the import worker and leaving the job stuck re-failing forever instead of being skipped.
stories.pr: When a participant save failed during background import, the worker still used the (nonexistent) new participant's ID in its next query, producing an invalid database query that crashed the job; because the job was never removed from the queue, cron kept re-running and re-failing it indefinitely, flooding logs.
stories.oc: Fix identified to log the failed row, skip it, and continue processing rather than crashing and leaving a stale queued job.

stories.s: Fixed one misconfigured custom field crashing the entire participant-import batch instead of just the affected row.
stories.pr: When a checkbox-group custom field's country-state-city chain could not be resolved due to missing form-block configuration, an internal helper returned null where an array was expected, throwing a fatal error that aborted the entire import run and left all remaining participants unprocessed.
stories.oc: Fix identified to default the unresolved block to an empty array so only the affected row is impacted, not the whole batch.

stories.s: Fixed a production crash in Android WebViews where disabled DOM storage caused the app to throw on every storage write.
stories.pr: A production error crashed the app in Android WebViews where DOM storage is disabled by default, because the existing storage guard only checked whether the window object existed, not whether storage itself was actually usable.
stories.oc: New storage-availability checks correctly detect SSR, null storage, and SecurityError cases across all 8 affected storage methods, with 3 call sites that bypassed the shared helper migrated to use it, preserving existing null/no-op behaviour.

stories.s: Gave admin notifications their own SQS queue so they no longer wait behind unrelated jobs, fixing a delay bug traced to shared-queue contention.
stories.pr: Admin notifications were processed through a shared queue and competed with other workloads for workers, causing significant, unpredictable delivery delays for time-sensitive notifications.
stories.oc: A dedicated SQS queue with its own worker concurrency/scaling and monitoring now handles admin notification dispatch, isolating it from general workload contention.

stories.s: Added full CloudWatch observability to campaign sender-list generation so the next stuck-campaign incident can be diagnosed instead of guessed at.
stories.pr: A prior incident (campaign email stuck at 'Generating Sender List') could not be root-caused because the pipeline lacked sufficient logging.
stories.oc: CloudWatch now captures job start/completion, recipient counts per step, errors/unexpected states, and duration/performance metrics for sender-list generation.

stories.s: Closes a gap where campaign recipients could still receive a duplicate email after more than 24 hours, protecting sender trust and recipient experience.
stories.pr: The existing 24-hour duplicate-send safeguard does not cover re-sends that happen after a longer interval, so recipients can still receive the same campaign email twice.
stories.oc: A deduplication strategy is being designed and implemented to guarantee no duplicate send regardless of elapsed time, covering resend and recipient-group-change edge cases.

stories.s: Mapped the platform's existing category/networking-permission rules onto global search so an opted-out or restricted user never shows up in someone else's results.
stories.pr: The new global search page has no defined logic for excluding entities a user isn't permitted to see (by category access or networking opt-out), risking a privacy/permission leak.
stories.oc: Documented how the layered visibility model (permission matrix, networking opt-in/GDPR, connection settings, module toggles) must be applied when filtering global search results.

stories.s: Scoped which of the platform's 13+ content types (exhibitors, sessions, products, news, groups and more) the new search feature needs to eventually cover.
stories.pr: Search currently only covers a few entity types from an early prototype, leaving most platform content (exhibitors, sessions, products, news, groups, etc.) unsearchable.
stories.oc: Defined the target list of 13+ entity types (Exhibitors, Visitors, Hosted Buyers, Speakers, Sessions, Products, News, Brands, Pavilions, Round Tables, On-Demand, Groups, etc.) search must eventually cover.

stories.s: Connected marketplace's existing filter system to the new AI search backend so applying a filter actually narrows the AI-powered results shown.
stories.pr: Applying marketplace filters currently has no effect on the new DS-side search results — filters and search are not yet connected.
stories.oc: Filters used across web listings (per the platform's Display Filters system) are implemented on the DS/search side so applying a filter narrows AI search results accordingly.

stories.s: Fixed toast notification colors to use the design system's static CSS variables instead of ad hoc theme values, per the official Figma spec.
stories.pr: Notistack toast colors in admin and front don't follow the design system's static color tokens, creating visual inconsistency.
stories.oc: Notistack styling is updated to use static, CSS-variable-based colors matching the design system (e.g. Functional/Focus tokens).

stories.s: Migrated the front-end i18n stack to a unified ICU MessageFormat with stable dotted keys, laying the foundation for reliable translation tooling across all repos.
stories.pr: The i18n stack used inconsistent interpolation syntax, suffix-based pluralization, and numeric rich-text tags, making translations fragile and hard to tool around.
stories.oc: Migrated to i18next-icu with single-brace ICU placeholders, ICU plural/select blocks, named Trans tags, and stable dotted-ID keys, with lint tooling and a CI gate.

stories.s: Replaced 30+ scattered, duplicated places that create Exhibitor records with one tested, documented CREATE module, reducing risk across the whole codebase.
stories.pr: Exhibitor creation logic is duplicated across 30+ call sites (admin, API v1/v2, imports, frontend, CLI tasks), each with its own side effects, making the codebase risky to change and hard to reason about.
stories.oc: A unified Exhibitor CREATE command with documentation, Swagger, unit test coverage, and performance/security/penetration review.

stories.s: Unified admin-ui's Docker images onto a single Node 24 version across every build stage, removing a latent source of ABI/runtime mismatches.
stories.pr: Different Dockerfile stages used Node 24 for the build stage but Node 23 for the modules/final stages, risking native-module ABI mismatches and inconsistent runtime behaviour.
stories.oc: All three admin-ui Dockerfiles now use node:24-alpine consistently across every build stage, verified to build and run correctly.

stories.s: Refactored the Android app's menu module (parsing, display, prep logic) for better maintainability; ticket gives no further detail on scope.
stories.pr: Not clearly specified beyond the ticket title; the menu module's existing parsing/display/preparation logic is described only as needing maintainability improvements.
stories.oc: Not clearly specified beyond the ticket title.

stories.s: Removed a leftover email template from a retired Hosted Buyer meeting feature that had no remaining use, decluttering the admin templates screen.
stories.pr: The 'Unconfirmed Appointment' email template belongs to the old Seated Meetings feature under Hosted Buyer, is no longer used, and clutters the Email Templates admin screen.
stories.oc: The unused email template is removed from Networking & Matchmaking > Meetings > Email Templates.

stories.s: Cleaned out dead legacy assets and a whole unused SEO/error-page component chain left behind by the App Router migration, verified file-by-file for safety.
stories.pr: portal-ui carries a sizable set of legacy static assets and a 'controller + plug' component chain that predate the App Router migration and are no longer referenced anywhere in production code.
stories.oc: Removes a defined list of unused public assets (icons, demo images, unused SVGs) and the dead Meta/PagePlug/ErrorsPageControl/HomePageController component chain, including associated Redux entries and tests.

stories.s: Benchmarked merging AI search results against permission-allowed ID lists at scale, to prove out one candidate approach for secure AI search.
stories.pr: It's unknown whether merging Qdrant vector-search results against large allowed-ID lists (post-filtering) can perform acceptably at production scale, rather than embedding permission logic directly into Qdrant queries.
stories.oc: A prototype measuring merge latency across allowed-ID-vector sizes (1k-100k) and result-set sizes (10-99% of records), with documented performance thresholds and a production recommendation.

stories.s: Tested passing permission-allowed IDs as a Qdrant pre-filter versus post-filtering, to settle which approach AI search should use in production.
stories.pr: It's unclear whether filtering permitted entity IDs before the vector search (pre-filtering) performs better or worse than merging them after search (post-filtering), for enforcing per-user visibility in AI search.
stories.oc: Pre-filtering implemented and benchmarked across allowed-ID-vector sizes (1k-100k), producing a latency comparison table and a production recommendation vs post-filtering.

stories.s: Designed the Exhibitor-backend API that will supply AI search with the exact set of entity IDs each user is permitted to see, per category.
stories.pr: AI Search needs a sorted list of entity IDs a user may see for a given search category, reflecting both the permission matrix and the user's applied filters, but no such API exists yet.
stories.oc: A proposed API design (endpoint, request/response schema, expected max size per category, V1-scoped security/filter rules) documented and shared with the DS team for review.

stories.s: Nailed down the exact request/response contract between AI Search and the Exhibitor backend for fetching a user's allowed entity IDs, unblocking both teams.
stories.pr: AI Search has no session/UI context of its own, so there is no agreed protocol for what it sends the Exhibitor backend to request an allowed-ID vector, or what the backend returns.
stories.oc: Agreed and documented request/response schema, edge-case behaviour (no filters, full access, unauthenticated), published in Confluence with sign-off from both teams.

stories.s: Replaced five separate implementations of exhibitor-read logic (Integrations, API, Import, Admin, Frontend) with one unified, tested READ module.
stories.pr: Exhibitor read/fetch logic is implemented separately in five different places, increasing maintenance cost and inconsistency risk.
stories.oc: A unified Exhibitor READ command replacing existing read logic across all five implementations, with documentation, Swagger, unit tests, and security/performance review.

stories.s: Replaced five separate implementations of exhibitor-update logic with one unified, tested UPDATE module, cutting maintenance risk across the platform.
stories.pr: Exhibitor update logic is implemented separately in five places, increasing maintenance cost and the risk of inconsistent behaviour.
stories.oc: A unified Exhibitor UPDATE command replacing all current update logic, with documentation, Swagger, unit tests, and security/performance review.

stories.s: Replaced five separate implementations of exhibitor-delete logic with one unified, tested DELETE module, reducing the risk of unsafe deletions.
stories.pr: Exhibitor delete logic is implemented separately in five places, increasing maintenance cost and the risk of inconsistent or unsafe deletions.
stories.oc: A unified Exhibitor DELETE command replacing all current delete logic, with documentation, Swagger, unit tests, and security/performance review.

stories.s: Made iOS CI/CD post real build status to Jira and addressed Apple warnings flagged on the Shoptalk Europe build; ticket gives little further detail.
stories.pr: Jira comments don't reflect the real iOS build status, and a specific build (Shoptalk Europe) surfaced unresolved Apple warnings.
stories.oc: Not clearly specified beyond the ticket title.

stories.s: Fixed the community page so it no longer displays a visibly empty, broken-looking group block when there are no groups to show.
stories.pr: The community page displays a visibly empty group section/block, which looks broken to visitors.
stories.oc: The empty group block is hidden from the community page when there is no content to show.

stories.s: Stopped the frontend from re-firing the same empty banner request on every navigation, cutting wasted API calls for placements with no banners configured.
stories.pr: Banners were re-requested on every navigation, producing repeated identical `POST /banners/get` calls that always return empty for placements with no banners configured, wasting requests.
stories.oc: Empty-result caching stops re-requesting banners for empty placements within a session, while still picking up newly-added banners via TTL/reload, without affecting placements that do have banners.

stories.s: Renamed thousands of admin-panel translation keys to snake_case across two languages and ~921 files, fixing broken vendor tooling caused by mixed key styles.
stories.pr: Admin-ui's translation keys mix lowercase feature segments with camelCase descriptors, which breaks translation-vendor tooling and duplicate-key detection when key styles differ across repos.
stories.oc: ~2,631 English and ~1,158 Russian keys across 47 namespaces renamed to snake_case, with all ~921 referencing source files updated in the same change; ICU values stay byte-identical.

stories.s: Brought mobile in line with web by blocking meeting/message requests to exhibitors with no team members, removing a manual pre-launch organizer check.
stories.pr: The 'restrict meetings/messages for exhibitors with no team members' setting works on web but was never enforced on mobile, so attendees could still contact exhibitors who have nobody to respond; organizers had to manually check every exhibitor before launch as a workaround.
stories.oc: Meet/Message buttons on mobile are greyed out with an explanatory toast and accessibility labels when an exhibitor has zero eligible team members, applied consistently across profile, listing, matchmaking, and chat-initiation surfaces.

stories.s: Created a Postman collection of the next.js frontend's server-side requests; ticket has no description beyond the title.
stories.pr: Not clearly specified beyond the ticket title.
stories.oc: Not clearly specified beyond the ticket title.

stories.s: Removed a locally-duplicated LoaderPlug component in favor of the shared one from expo-react-components; ticket has no further detail.
stories.pr: Not clearly specified beyond the ticket title; the app maintains its own LoaderPlug.tsx alongside an equivalent shared-library component.
stories.oc: Not clearly specified beyond the ticket title.

stories.s: Turned a successful first-event pilot of the new AI recommendation service into a plan for rolling it out to other tenants.
stories.pr: The new recommendation service has only run at one live production event; there is no plan yet for rolling it out more broadly.
stories.oc: A roll-out plan is produced based on the documented findings from the first live event, to guide improvements and expansion to other tenants.

stories.s: Exposed the 'restrict meetings for exhibitors with no team' setting to mobile via one flag on an existing API, instead of building a new endpoint.
stories.pr: The setting was functional on web but the mobile app had no way to read it, since no API exposed it and a dedicated endpoint was initially planned but not yet built.
stories.oc: GET /app/getexhibitions now returns a `disable_meetings_without_team_members` boolean, additive-only and fail-open, which the mobile app uses to enforce the restriction client-side.

stories.s: Fixed an N+1 query loop in the By Booking report that ran thousands of queries per page on large events, replacing it with a fixed-cost batched query.
stories.pr: The By Booking admin report ran thousands of individual queries per page view on large events, because it loaded every order in the event and queried related data row-by-row before filtering down to the requested page.
stories.oc: The report now runs a fixed, batched set of queries scoped to just the requested page's payment IDs, regardless of how many orders exist in the event, with identical output.

stories.s: Produced the detailed project plan and C4 architecture diagrams needed to build Phase 2 of the AI Event Assistant, a conversational assistant for attendees.
stories.pr: Phase 2 of the AI Event Assistant (a LangGraph-based orchestrator that classifies attendee intent and routes to recommendation, SQL, RAG, and calendar tools) needs a project plan and architecture diagrams before implementation can proceed.
stories.oc: A detailed Phase 2 project plan (state model, orchestrator flow, SQL module contract, access validation, API, open questions, milestones) and C4 architecture diagrams were produced.

stories.s: Fixed the shared Button component's types so rendering it as a link no longer requires `as any` workarounds, with zero breaking changes for existing callers.
stories.pr: Consumers rendering the shared Button as an anchor (`component="a"`) get spurious TypeScript errors on valid anchor props like `target` and `rel`, forcing `as any` casts or prop-spread workarounds even though runtime behaviour is correct.
stories.oc: Button is re-typed as an OverridableComponent so anchor props are only allowed (and type-checked) when `component="a""` is used, removing the need for type workarounds with no breaking changes to existing usage.

stories.s: Fixed Android so a globally-deleted account stops showing up in participant lists promptly instead of lingering until the next background sync.
stories.pr: After a user deletes their account, they remain visible in the participants list on Android until a sync with the deletion arrives, which is confusing to other users.
stories.oc: The app is updated to request or reflect the sync sooner (or otherwise remove the account from view) after deletion, so deleted accounts stop appearing promptly.

stories.s: Optimized the ExportTask process and removed its trash-handling logic; ticket has no description beyond the title.
stories.pr: Not clearly specified beyond the ticket title.
stories.oc: Not clearly specified beyond the ticket title.

stories.s: Rewrote ~15 test files to assert on stable translation IDs instead of English copy, so future wording changes stop breaking the test suite.
stories.pr: Roughly 15 test files assert on resolved English strings, so any copy edit — even with unchanged behaviour — breaks tests; the suite also boots a real i18next instance, adding setup overhead.
stories.oc: setupTests.js now mocks react-i18next with an identity `t`, and affected tests assert on dotted translation IDs instead of English text.

stories.s: Designed the backend API that will sit between the Global Search page and the AI Search service, handling permissions, filters, and result enrichment.
stories.pr: The Global Search page needs a backend endpoint that authenticates the request, resolves permissions/allowed entity IDs, calls the AI Search API correctly, and returns an enriched, frontend-ready response — none of which exists yet.
stories.oc: A documented API design covering the frontend contract, permission/filter rules, the AI Search request/response integration, result enrichment, and edge cases, published in Confluence and ready for implementation hand-off.

stories.s: Added an 'Email First' matching strategy for native integrations so an attendee's profile and history no longer fragment when their email changes upstream.
stories.pr: Source systems (e.g. GES/VISIT) that don't enforce email uniqueness and allow attendees to change their email cause the current Email-matching strategy to create a duplicate account, fragmenting the attendee's identity and engagement history across two profiles.
stories.oc: A new 'Email First' matching strategy falls back to External ID when email matching would create a duplicate, and the existing 'Both' option is renamed to 'External ID First' with no behaviour change for current users.

stories.s: Fixed validation gaps and inconsistent error handling in Exhibitor Settings endpoints uncovered during a prior code review, closing silent-failure risks.
stories.pr: A prior review (EP-51999) of Exhibitor Settings CRUD found silent no-ops, type coercion issues, incorrect HTTP status codes, and missing field validation.
stories.oc: The Exhibitor Settings endpoints get corrected validation, proper HTTP status codes, and elimination of silent no-op/type-coercion bugs.

stories.s: Built a locale-aware navigation layer that removes an extra redirect on every non-English page view and fixes ~8 broken locale-naive comparisons across the app.
stories.pr: Almost all client-side navigation code pushes internal paths without a locale prefix, causing an extra redirect on every non-default-locale navigation, and roughly eight separate `pathname` comparisons across the app silently break (or loop) on non-English locales because they don't account for the locale segment.
stories.oc: A drop-in locale-aware router and link wrapper (with lint guards banning the raw APIs) eliminate the extra redirect on non-default locales, and a locale-neutral route-matching utility fixes the ~8 broken comparisons (scroll control, header search, auth modal, nav highlighting, etc.).

stories.s: Investigated and removed an unused sign-in component that carried a latent infinite-redirect-loop bug, before it could ever resurface in production.
stories.pr: SignInPageController appears to be dead code, and it contains the same locale-naive pathname comparison bug (fixed elsewhere in EP-54331) that would cause an infinite redirect loop if it were ever re-mounted.
stories.oc: The component is confirmed unused and removed entirely, or — if still required — re-wired with a locale-safe guard, verified not to loop on non-default locales.

stories.s: Renamed the shared component library's translation keys to snake_case, closing the last inconsistency in the platform's unified i18n key convention.
stories.pr: expo-react-components was the last repo in the shared i18n stack still using camelCase key segments, creating a deliberate but awkward exception in an otherwise-unified naming convention (EP-54167).
stories.oc: ~103 keys across 16 locale files renamed to snake_case, all ~42 call sites and the docs/skill files updated, with ICU values left byte-identical.

stories.s: Load-tested whether the database can generate 100k-ID permission lists across 16 categories at once without buckling, de-risking AI search before full build-out.
stories.pr: AI search will need up to 100k allowed entity IDs per category across 16 categories per request; it's unverified whether generating these ID lists under GDPR/permission rules will overload the database or connection pool at that scale.
stories.oc: A PHP test endpoint applies GDPR/permission logic to fetch IDs from a prod-like database, measuring DB connection time and Redis footprint to validate the approach can handle production scale.

stories.s: Fixed flaky unit tests caused by asserting on content before it finished rendering asynchronously, restoring trust in the CI test suite.
stories.pr: The full Vitest suite intermittently fails a small, non-deterministic set of tests (different files each run), most of which pass in isolation, undermining trust in CI results.
stories.oc: Synchronous assertions on asynchronously-rendered content are replaced with findBy/waitFor, and affected post/feed tests are audited for missing awaits and test isolation issues.

stories.s: Fixed the Android app so it stops showing the ExpoFP floor plan after an organizer disables it, instead of only reacting to a separate dynamic-linking toggle.
stories.pr: After an organizer disables the ExpoFP floor plan for an event, the Android app keeps displaying it until the user also turns off dynamic linking, which is unexpected and confusing.
stories.oc: App behaviour is updated so the floor plan display correctly reflects the organizer's current ExpoFP setting.

stories.s: Catalogued every API endpoint whose access rules silently changed during the security hardening story and defined a consistent 401/403/404 convention going forward.
stories.pr: Security hardening (e.g. EP-46843) silently changed access control on public frontend API endpoints (like `products/images`), breaking frontend caching assumptions without frontend being informed; error-code usage across the API is also inconsistent (403 vs 401 vs 404 used interchangeably for similar cases).
stories.oc: A complete list of endpoints with changed access/contract (path, what changed, condition, originating ticket) handed to the frontend team, plus an agreed and documented 401/403/404 convention applied consistently and reflected in Swagger.

stories.s: Fixed the Android app so a background data sync no longer silently clears a user's selected filters on pages like Sessions.
stories.pr: After a user selects filters and sees results, an incoming background sync unexpectedly clears the selected filters, losing the user's work.
stories.oc: App behaviour is updated to preserve selected filters across a background sync event.

stories.s: Gave organizers full self-service control over the branded Confirmation page Participants see after registering, as part of the New Registration platform rebuild.
stories.pr: As part of the New Registration platform rebuild, organizers had no way to customize what Participants see immediately after registering, limiting how branded and informative that moment could be.
stories.oc: Organizers can toggle a custom Website Builder page or configure image, title/description (with merge variables and rich text), an optional script, flip-sides layout, full multilanguage support, and unsaved-changes protection for the Participant confirmation experience.

stories.s: Extended the self-service branded Confirmation page capability to the Buyer registration flow, as part of the New Registration platform rebuild.
stories.pr: As part of the New Registration platform rebuild, organizers had no way to customize what Buyers see immediately after registering, limiting how branded and informative that moment could be.
stories.oc: Organizers can toggle a custom Website Builder page or configure image, title/description (with merge variables and rich text), an optional script, flip-sides layout, full multilanguage support, and unsaved-changes protection for the Buyer confirmation experience.

stories.s: Let organizers configure a branded 'Sold Out' page with a customizable call-to-action button, so a fully-booked event no longer dead-ends registrants.
stories.pr: When all tickets for an event sell out, there was no defined branded experience to show Participants attempting to register, only an ad hoc or generic dead end.
stories.oc: Organizers can configure an image, title/description text, and a customizable-destination call-to-action button for the Sold Out page, with flip-sides layout and multilanguage support.

stories.s: New Registration adds a branded, organizer-configurable Sold Out page so attendees get clear guidance instead of a confusing dead end when tickets run out.
stories.pr: When all tickets visible to a participant (by category/country) were sold out, the old registration flow had no dedicated, organizer-brandable page to explain this and redirect the visitor.
stories.oc: A configurable Sold Out page (organizer-set image/title/description/button, default copy, flip-sides layout, multilanguage) that appears before or after email validation whenever no visible tickets remain.

stories.s: New Registration reliably routes paid bookings to payment (or a deferred Basket in two exception cases) so ticket and session revenue is actually collected.
stories.pr: The new registration flow needed defined, consistent logic for when a paid booking triggers immediate payment versus deferred Basket payment, across normal, private-with-public-access, and registration-limit-reached cases.
stories.oc: Attendees with paid items are redirected to the existing Payment page on submit, except Private Events with public access or where the registration limit is reached, where items go to the Basket instead; an item-availability check runs before payment.

stories.s: A new email-verification landing page catches duplicate and unfinished registrations before an attendee even starts the form.
stories.pr: Without an email-first landing step, visitors could start registering with duplicate, already-used, or previously-abandoned emails, creating messy or duplicate registration data.
stories.oc: A new landing page with email verification that blocks duplicates, triggers Repeated Registration or Continue Unfinished Registration flows as appropriate, and is multilingual.

stories.s: Buyer Registration gets its own email-verification landing page, with identity checks so only valid, unique emails reach the Buyer flow.
stories.pr: Buyer registration (reached via Agent-shared links) had no equivalent email-first gate, so duplicate Buyers or unverified Participant-to-Buyer upgrades were possible.
stories.oc: A Buyer Registration Landing Page with email verification, duplicate-Buyer blocking, identity verification for existing Participants, and routing to Repeated/Unfinished Registration flows; skipped entirely for logged-in Participant-to-Buyer upgrades.

stories.s: Simple Registration, unused by any customer for years, is removed so the platform keeps a single consistent registration flow.
stories.pr: Simple Registration (a legacy flow that skipped the Summary page) had not been used by any customer for years but remained in the codebase and Admin Panel, adding maintenance surface and inconsistent behaviour.
stories.oc: Simple Registration settings, its custom-script hook, and all related UI/logic are removed; every event always goes through the standard Summary-page flow.

stories.s: Ticket selection and purchase is rebuilt as a mandatory, category-aware registration step with reservation holds, directly powering ticket revenue.
stories.pr: Ticket purchasing needed to be rebuilt as a mandatory, category-aware step inside the new registration pipeline, replicating and improving legacy ticketing behaviour.
stories.oc: A mandatory Tickets tab with category-based filtering, multi-ticket purchases, a 1-hour reservation hold, sold-out handling, and pre-selected-category URL support.

stories.s: Registration forms now show or hide grids and fields based on category or prior answers, so attendees only see what applies to them.
stories.pr: The new registration UI lacked the conditional-visibility logic (by category or by answer) that the legacy registration and the new Edit Profile already supported, so forms could not adapt to different attendee types.
stories.oc: Grids and their fields show/hide based on Participant Category or conditional-question answers, hidden tabs disappear entirely, and requiredness on hidden fields is ignored until they become visible again.

stories.s: A new side navigation menu with tab navigation and a live order summary gives attendees clear progress and pricing visibility during registration.
stories.pr: The new registration UI needed navigation between tabs (buttons and tab clicks) with required-field gating and a visible summary of what's being purchased, matching the legacy behaviour and new design.
stories.oc: A side navigation menu (event image/logo, tab list, Order Summary of paid items) with Previous/Next buttons, tab-click navigation restricted to visited tabs, and required-field gating; Order Summary hidden on mobile widths.

stories.s: Registration's form fields now render and auto-populate exactly like the new Edit Profile, with full support for required, hidden and disabled attributes.
stories.pr: The new registration UI needed its form rendering (fields, attributes like required/hidden/disabled, and system-field pre-population) to match legacy Registration and the new Edit Profile visually and functionally.
stories.oc: Grids/Fields/Info Frames render with full attribute support (required, sensitive, hidden, disabled, not editable, conditional, timestamp capture); Email/Country/Category system fields auto-populate and lock; data pre-saves across tab navigation.

stories.s: Sessions can now be searched, filtered and booked (paid or free) directly during registration, capturing session revenue earlier in the funnel.
stories.pr: Session booking needed to move from a post-registration profile action into the registration pipeline itself, with support for organizer rules requiring at least one or all sessions to be selected.
stories.oc: A Sessions tab with search/filters, paid and free session booking, seat-availability enforcement, and organizer-configured "at least one" or "all sessions" required rules.

stories.s: A consolidated Summary page with discount codes, pricing, and validation is the final review step before registration payment or submission.
stories.pr: The new registration flow needed a final review step that shows all submitted data and paid items, supports discount codes, and gives a clear next action (submit vs. pay), matching the legacy Basket discount logic.
stories.oc: A Summary page showing all in-scope tab data with Edit links, paid items with discount-code support, unavailable-item warnings, T&Cs/reCAPTCHA, and a context-aware "Proceed to payment"/"Submit" button.

stories.s: Registration now enforces Terms and Conditions agreement before completion, giving organizers the legal compliance step the old flow had.
stories.pr: The new registration UI lacked a Terms and Conditions gate, needed for organizers who legally require attendee agreement before completing sign-up.
stories.oc: A Terms and Conditions step with a detail pop-up, required-agreement enforcement with a blocking snackbar, and a confirmation snackbar on acceptance.

stories.s: All legacy registration emails (confirmation, waitlist, pending-approval) are replicated in the new flow so no attendee or organizer communication is lost.
stories.pr: Migrating to New Registration risked silently dropping or changing email notifications participants and organizers rely on.
stories.oc: Confirmation, waitlist, pending-approval and other Registration-triggered emails fire with the same content, recipients and trigger conditions as the legacy flow, using existing organizer-configured templates.

stories.s: The legacy Self Registration feature is fully removed, leaving one supported registration flow and less code to maintain.
stories.pr: Self Registration was a redundant legacy feature adding maintenance overhead and complexity alongside the new consolidated registration flow.
stories.oc: Self Registration's Admin Panel settings, frontend pages, and backend logic are removed; legacy URLs redirect appropriately, with no impact to standard, Buyer, or other registration flows.

stories.s: Category-specific registration links now pre-filter tickets and lock the category field, streamlining targeted registration for attendees.
stories.pr: Organizers sending category-specific registration links had no way to make the URL pre-filter tickets and lock the category field, forcing attendees to re-select what the link already implied.
stories.oc: A category embedded in the Registration URL filters the Ticketing page to that category (plus "available for all") and pre-fills/locks the Category field on Contact Details, falling back to standard behaviour on invalid category IDs.

stories.s: A personalised Confirmation page with dynamic badge/QR/name variables and organizer scripts closes out the new registration flow.
stories.pr: The new registration flow needed a post-completion confirmation page supporting the same dynamic variables, custom scripts and multilanguage content as legacy Registration.
stories.oc: A Confirmation page rendering organizer-configured image/text with dynamic variables (name, email, barcode, QR code, badge link, etc.), executing organizer scripts, supporting a full custom-page override, and multilanguage switching.

stories.s: Buyers now get their own personalised Confirmation page with dynamic details, mirroring the Participant confirmation experience.
stories.pr: Buyer Registration needed its own confirmation page with the same dynamic-variable and custom-script support as the Participant flow, rather than sharing an inconsistent or missing experience.
stories.oc: A Buyer-specific Confirmation page with organizer-configured image/text, dynamic variables (name, email, barcode, QR code, badge link), script execution, custom-page override, and multilanguage support.

stories.s: The default, highest-volume Public Event registration path — signup, activation and payment — is fully rebuilt in the new registration pipeline.
stories.pr: The New Registration pipeline needed to fully support the most common case, Public Events, including email verification, activation, and payment for paid items, without regressing existing behaviour.
stories.oc: Visitors on Public Events complete registration and self-activate via an emailed activation link, with registration-limit, repeated-registration, unfinished-registration and payment flows all wired in.

stories.s: Private Events with public access now get an approval-then-pay flow, with items reserved and paid via a forced Basket after organizer approval.
stories.pr: Private Events that allow public registration need an approval gate before activation and must defer payment until after that approval, which the new pipeline had not yet implemented.
stories.oc: Participants submit registration pending organizer approval; paid items are reserved and payment is deferred to a forced, un-closable Basket shown after activation, on web and mobile.

stories.s: Agent-distributed Buyer Registration is rebuilt with approval-gated activation and a forced post-approval Basket payment step.
stories.pr: The new pipeline needed a distinct Buyer registration path (distinct from Participants) that agents distribute, gated by organizer approval and deferred payment.
stories.oc: Buyers register via an Agent link, submit through the Summary page without immediate payment, and pay via a forced Basket after organizer approval activates their account.

stories.s: Participants can upgrade to Buyer via an Agent link with pre-filled data, turning existing attendees into paying Buyers with minimal friction.
stories.pr: Participants wanting to become Buyers had no streamlined upgrade path in the new pipeline that reused their existing profile data and handled approval correctly.
stories.oc: Both logged-in and unlogged Participants can upgrade to Buyer via an Agent link, with fields pre-filled from their existing profile, the Buyer category hidden until Summary, and Organizer approval required to complete the upgrade.

stories.s: Registrations past an event's capacity limit now flow into a proper Waiting list with its own email and approval, instead of failing silently.
stories.pr: The new registration pipeline needed to correctly handle capacity limits, including the race condition where spots fill while someone is mid-registration.
stories.oc: Registrations past the limit go to Waiting list status with a dedicated email (no activation link) and require organizer approval; a modal offers "Join Waiting List" if spots fill while the user is on the Summary page; paid items still reserve and defer to a forced Basket.

stories.s: Unfinished registrations can now be resumed with all prior data intact via an emailed link, cutting abandonment from repeated form starts.
stories.pr: Visitors who started but didn't finish registering had to start over from scratch if they returned later, likely contributing to lost/abandoned registrations.
stories.oc: Re-entering an email tied to an unfinished registration offers a confirmation-email link that resumes the form with all previously entered data pre-filled, consistent across Public and Private-with-public-access flows; organizers can disable this behaviour.

stories.s: Attendees with an account on another event now get their profile fields pre-filled after email verification, speeding up repeat registrations.
stories.pr: Repeat attendees across multiple events had to re-enter all their profile information each time, with no reuse of previously captured data.
stories.oc: Entering an email tied to an account on another event offers an emailed confirmation link that pre-fills system profile fields (name, company, position, etc.) into the new event's registration form, editable by the visitor.

stories.s: Test plans are migrated from the legacy teststone repo into the standardized e2e-testing docs structure, one bounded context per PR.
stories.pr: Test plans and supporting docs still lived in the old `teststone` repository and format, inconsistent with the house standard already adopted elsewhere (business/product/testing docs structure).
stories.oc: Each bounded context's test plans are migrated (plans only, not implementations) into `docs/tests/bounded-contexts/<context>/` with business.md/product.md/testing.md, removing teststone references, one PR per context.

stories.s: A same-exhibitor bypass fixes a permission-matrix bug that was blocking exhibitor team members from viewing their own company page and colleagues.
stories.pr: The permission matrix, designed to block cross-company visibility, was also unintentionally blocking members of the same exhibitor from viewing each other or their own shared company page/products when restrictive rules were configured.
stories.oc: A same-exhibitor bypass is introduced in the permission-check layer so team members and exhibitor owners can never be blocked from viewing each other or their own company resources, regardless of matrix configuration.

stories.s: Android now shows type-hidden sessions and exhibitor events in My Schedule and reminders, fixing an itinerary gap that iOS never had (IMEX use case).
stories.pr: IMEX hides certain session types from public listings but pushes specific sessions into attendees' schedules via API; Android was incorrectly hiding those same items from My Schedule, deep links, reminders, and calendar export, unlike iOS.
stories.oc: Type-level-only hidden Sessions/Exhibitor Events now appear in My Schedule, their detail views, deep links, push notifications/reminders, and calendar export on Android, while item-level hiding and general discovery surfaces remain unchanged.

stories.s: A malformed language cookie value is now validated and defaulted to English instead of crashing server-side requests, per Grafana error reports.
stories.pr: The `i18n` cookie was forwarded verbatim as a request header, so a malformed value (e.g. from scanner probes) made the HTTP client throw, surfacing as server errors in Grafana.
stories.oc: Language values are validated against the supported list on both client and server before use, with any unknown value degrading gracefully to English instead of crashing the request.

stories.s: Switch component styling is centralized into the shared component library, removing three duplicated copies across frontend repos.
stories.pr: Three separate repositories each maintained their own copy of Switch styling, causing drift and duplicated maintenance effort.
stories.oc: Switch styles are centralized in `expo-react-components`, reused across repositories with default-prop overrides in admin-ui, and removed from the individual repos.

stories.s: A meeting-export job that wrote one database row at a time now batches inserts into a single query, cutting write load on large exports.
stories.pr: A dead accumulate-then-implode pattern in the export buffering code meant `MeetingExportTask` executed one INSERT per row instead of a single batched multi-row INSERT, wasting database writes on large meeting exports.
stories.oc: The SQL accumulation now happens correctly across the whole loop before a single batched INSERT executes, reducing write count from N to 1 per export batch with identical resulting data.

stories.s: A new Claude Code skill scaffolds FE Tech Debt tickets with the correct fixed fields automatically, eliminating recurring manual-entry mistakes.
stories.pr: FE tech debt tickets followed a fixed but easy-to-get-wrong convention (issue type, team, RGT+O, mandatory label, structured description), and manual creation regularly missed a field or the required sections.
stories.oc: A `create-fe-tech-debt` Claude Code skill creates Tech Debt tickets via the Atlassian MCP with the correct team/label/RGT+O fields and structured description, always showing a preview before creation.

stories.s: CI pipeline cleanup removes dead legacy branches and a leaked Discord token in clear text, while de-duplicating repeated build/deploy steps.
stories.pr: The pipeline still carried legacy (pre-next14) branch pipelines as dead weight, a Discord webhook token hardcoded in clear text, and near-identical ECR/SSM steps copy-pasted three times.
stories.oc: Legacy branch pipelines and SonarQube steps are removed, the leaked Discord token is deleted and rotated, and the duplicated ECR/SSM build-deploy logic is consolidated into shared YAML anchors.

stories.s: Barrel imports across ~2,600 files are converted to deep imports and guarded by a lint rule, improving bundle size and dev build speed.
stories.pr: Importing from package barrels (`@mui/material`, `@mui/icons-material`, `expo-react-components`) across roughly 2,600 files pulls whole packages into the module graph, hurting tree-shaking, dev cold-start/HMR, and production bundle size, with no lint rule preventing new barrel imports.
stories.oc: Barrel imports are codemod-converted to deep imports, a `no-restricted-imports` ESLint rule is added to prevent regressions, and the convention doc is ported into admin-ui.

stories.s: Android's app-signing process is audited and standardized so release builds stay consistent and secure without exposed credentials.
stories.pr: The current Android signing configuration for debug/staging/release builds was not documented or fully verified as secure and consistent, flagged as tech debt.
stories.oc: Signing configuration is audited, Gradle/CI updated to read credentials from secure storage, signed APK/AAB generation validated in CI, and troubleshooting steps documented for developers.

stories.s: SonarQube analysis, unused and unreviewed, is removed from three frontend repos, cutting CI cost and dead configuration.
stories.pr: SonarQube ran on every build across three repos, burning CI minutes and maintaining dead config/secrets, for a tool no one reviews or acts on.
stories.oc: `sonar-project.properties`, pipeline steps, and related config/doc references are removed from next14, admin-ui and expo-react-components; associated Bitbucket variables and server projects are slated for decommission.

stories.s: Android push-notification handling code was refactored; the ticket gives no further detail on the specific problem or outcome.
stories.pr: Not clearly specified beyond the ticket title.
stories.oc: Push-notification handling code on Android was refactored; no further detail is documented on this ticket.

stories.s: The page Builder now uses current typography from the shared component library, fixing a visual mismatch with an outdated source.
stories.pr: The Builder was rendering an outdated typography set instead of the current one defined in `expo-react-component`.
stories.oc: The Builder now sources its typography from `expo-react-component` instead of the old, outdated source.

stories.s: A hash-comparison bug that silently deleted every offline floor plan download is fixed, so offline floor plans actually load for attendees.
stories.pr: The offline ExpoFP flow verified downloaded archives by comparing a file's MD5 to the API's `fileHash`, which is documented as an S3 ETag (not guaranteed to equal MD5), so the integrity check could fail every time and the downloaded archive was deleted, leaving offline floor plans permanently unavailable.
stories.oc: The integrity check is fixed to treat `fileHash` as an ETag (skipping/adapting strict MD5 comparison for multipart or malformed values), the primary-download gate is fixed so a clean install still triggers the first download, and failures no longer report false success.

stories.s: An opt-in setting lets Exhibitor Events map to any live Floor Plan location, not just the exhibitor's booth, closing a gap flagged in a feature-intake request.
stories.pr: Exhibitor Events could only be linked to the exhibitor's own assigned booth on the Floor Plan, so events held elsewhere (e.g. conference rooms) could not be properly mapped, even though the underlying capability already existed for Sessions.
stories.oc: A new admin checkbox lets Exhibitor Events select any live Floor Plan location (grouped as Your Stands / Floor Plan Locations / Predefined / free-text), with deduplication, while defaulting to today's booth-only behaviour when disabled.

stories.s: Organizers can now set List, Grid, or Calendar as the default Sessions page view, without engineering involvement, for content-dense schedules.
stories.pr: The Sessions page always rendered in a fixed Grid/card layout, which becomes hard to scan for events with a large number of concurrent sessions, and organizers had no way to change it without a custom-code workaround.
