stories.oc: Edit profile is to show submitted values, highlight moderated fields and show a banner; the organiser's visitor card highlights them too.

musthave.feature: All Day Session in the calendar view
musthave.why: For DLG Agritechnica: 6-hour-plus sessions such as the daily Robotics Live Arena take a grid column and squeeze shorter sessions.
musthave.impact: Attendees: clear distinction between ongoing all-day activities and time-specific presentations. Organizers: flexibility to schedule all-day events without disrupting standard speaker tracks.
musthave.deps: Child of EP-57118. Shares the session card component with the time-grid card (EP-57015); decisions of 14 Sep fixed the threshold at 6 hours and titles at 3 lines, and the page was swept from 8 to 6 hours. Still open: whether on-demand sessions appear in the All Day banner ('decision pending separately'). Risk: a contradictory specification would mislead QA on 6 to 8 hour sessions.
musthave.notes: Deployed under parent EP-57118; FE by Oleksandr Zakablukov, QA by Olena Khromei.

musthave.feature: Global Search. Blocks, Labels, Order and Availability Control
musthave.why: Raised for IMEX: closes Global Search gaps left by EP-47675 (block order, labels, availability) and fixes Delegates not showing.
musthave.impact: Important for IMEX decision on whether they will use Global Search for their target event
musthave.deps: Was done as hotfix in tight deadlines, testing continues after the release
musthave.notes: Labels edit for Search selector moved to Translation manager and TAMs were notified about that

musthave.feature: Multi-day Session Calendar View Enhancements
musthave.why: DLG: turn the session Week View into a 3-column Multi-day View that hides empty days and time slots and loads days in chunks.
musthave.impact: Attendees: fast, frictionless browsing between days with clear visual cues showing which dates have scheduled content. Organizers: higher session discovery and agenda engagement across multi-day schedules.
musthave.deps: Needs the backend API in EP-57107 (split from this story, Exhibitor team, Oleksii Tur): a new days-with-sessions endpoint and a day-range calendar endpoint. The backend change was breaking and left the calendar broken on alpha until this frontend reached rc on 23 Sep, so releases had to be agreed with the frontend developer. Parent epic EP-57118. Description split: FE 4d (Zakablukov), BE 3d (Tur), QA 3d (Khromei).
musthave.notes: Deployed under parent EP-57118; FE by Oleksandr Zakablukov, QA by Olena Khromei.

musthave.feature: Redesigned Session Cards in Calendar View with Overflow Indicator
musthave.why: For DLG: crowded time slots cram sessions into illegible cards; show at most 2 cards (4 in Day View) and a '+N' badge.
musthave.impact: Attendees: instant readability for packed time slots with one-click access to all concurrent sessions. Organizers & Speakers: eliminates hidden or compressed sessions, giving equal visibility to all tracks.
musthave.deps: Child of EP-57118; relates to EP-57603. Shares one session card component with the All Day banner (EP-57098), so both specifications must agree (title line count aligned to 3 lines on 14 Sep). Built to the approved DLG G3 prototype (calendar-view-proto.vercel.app/dlg-g3). Risk: if the two story pages drift apart again, QA tests against contradictory criteria.
musthave.notes: Deployed under parent EP-57118; FE by Oleksandr Zakablukov, QA by Olena Khromei.

musthave.feature: Session Calendar: Sync "By Track" drawer label with the Admin Display Filter name
musthave.why: For DLG: the calendar drawer hardcodes 'By Track' and ignores the filter name the organiser set, which the rest of the event uses.
musthave.impact: Attendees: consistent taxonomy and terminology throughout agenda browsing. Organizers: full white-label fidelity — custom filter naming is respected everywhere.
musthave.deps: Child of EP-57118. Relies on the existing Admin Panel > Sessions > Display Filters label and its localised variants, which the platform already respects elsewhere; no Admin Panel changes are in scope. Risk if delayed: clients who renamed Tracks keep seeing an inconsistent 'By Track' label.

musthave.feature: [API] Multi-day Session Calendar View Enhancements
musthave.why: API behind the new multi-day session calendar (split from EP-57014): day-range sessions and a days-with-sessions list in one call each.
musthave.impact: Platform & Attendees: eliminates rendering lag and multiple round trips during multi-day calendar navigation. Engineering & QA: clean OpenAPI contract with standardized envelope and server-side timezone boundary resolution.
musthave.deps: Frontend adaptation (EP-57014, Visitor team) had to ship with it: the change is breaking (old view/day body now answers 400), the calendar was broken on alpha until the adapted frontend reached rc on 23 Sep, and pushes to alpha/rc/prod had to be agreed with the frontend developer. Sub-tasks EP-57262 (contract), EP-57263 (build, PR 5089), EP-57264 and EP-57391 (QA). Mobile is not a consumer: Android and iOS calendars are native and call no API for it. Open risks carried: 4 performance cases blocked because the EP-57286 test stand is gone with no one named to replace it; id-list validation defect EP-57367 filed separately across all search endpoints.
musthave.notes: 17 Sep: QA complete on 154 cases with no failures, but 15 cases not executed (performance, planner, timezone, null-start) and none human-verified; four documentation corrections owed, JD-15 fixed in the Description the same day. 17 Sep: Android and iOS confirmed native, not calling these endpoints. Jira: Done, resolved 23 Sep.

musthave.feature: accountsInteractions: sync_ts cursor field to fix incremental-sync data loss
musthave.why: IMEX escalation: about 3.1% of exhibitor-favourite interactions go missing from API incremental syncs, ahead of IMEX America, Oct 2026.
musthave.impact: Clients and 3rd parties that need to retrieve interactions and analytics from ExpoPlatform via the API. Currently a major blocker for IMEX.
musthave.deps: Multi-team EPIC, where Data Science, Exhibitors team and API Team are required to complete the work
musthave.notes: Rough estimations from the Integrations Team. Data Science and Exhibitors Team estimations are required For IMEX Frankfurt 2027 (18-20 May 2027); delivery this year, so it is not overdue (owner, 28 Sep 2026).

musthave.feature: Adding tracking for sponsor and sponsored product clicks
musthave.why: Views and clicks on sponsored cards in the app are never counted, so sponsor statistics undercount sponsors on app-heavy events.
musthave.impact: Tracking clicks is essential for organizers to sell sponsored slots to customers
musthave.deps: Must follow the documented slider counting rules and match the web fix EP-55280; events must flow into the same statistics pipeline as web (admin Sponsorship statistics and exports, sponsor Interactions Dashboard). Open questions: the agreed mobile equivalent of a page refresh (session), and whether meet/message taps on the exhibitor page are tracked (asked 18 Jul, unanswered). Risk: sponsor performance stays under-reported while delayed.
musthave.notes: 18 Jul: meeting and message tracking removed from scope (app slider cards only have a Favourite button); PO's question on exhibitor-page meet/message tracking has no reply. Jira Open, no due date.

musthave.feature: Alphabetical Sorting for Filter Items for sessions and Exhibitor Events
musthave.why: German organisers (HINTE) say long Track, Tag and Type lists are hard to browse and asked for alphabetical order per language.
musthave.impact: Attendees on large and multi-language events find Track, Tag and Type filter options in alphabetical order for their own language on All Sessions, Round Tables, On-Demand and Marketplace Exhibitor Events, on web and in the mobile app. Organisers get an opt-in toggle (off by default); their manual order is kept and restored when it is switched off.
musthave.deps: Backend dynamic sorting and response order_num renumbering for active locale. Risk: mobile smoke test coordination needed; public API v3 remains on manual DB order by design.
musthave.notes: 18 Sep: due on the release candidate on 7 Oct; App QA team to run the mobile smoke test then. 16 Sep: Confluence spec and Jira description updated (accent-sensitive collation, numeric sort, Round Tables in scope). Jira status: In testing.

musthave.feature: Build support for new OTP settings
musthave.why: Web part already released - parity needed
musthave.impact: Benefits users across the board
musthave.deps: OTP rollout will remain incomplete
musthave.notes: Testing uncovered some bugs that need to be sorted

musthave.feature: Exclude surcharge/tax from invoice when offline payment method is selected
musthave.why: For ACI Asia-Pacific & Middle East (RACE 2027): delegates paying by invoice see the 4.5% card surcharge on the invoice PDF.
musthave.impact: Delegates who choose Invoice payment get an invoice with no Credit Card Surcharge and a total equal to the net amount; card payments and other taxes are unchanged. Event admins get a per-event setting, off by default, and order, transaction, dashboard and Payments report totals match the invoice.
musthave.deps: Blocking: Invoice payment is exhibitor-only today, so delegate support may be extra scope (asked 24 Sep); build path vs the Purchasing module rewrite (EP-56047 under epic EP-55566), which warns against a parallel invoice path; EP-55641 on hold on a related VAT question; per-tax vs event-level setting (surcharge set up as a custom tax, EP-38903); behaviour when the payment method changes. Needs written confirmation from ACI of the policy. Risk: early bird registration opened in September 2026 with no target date.
musthave.notes: 24 Sep: Taimoor Zulfiqar asked Derar Toujgani to check how ACI delegates reach Invoice payment, as it is exhibitor-only today. 21 Sep: sample invoice attached. Returned from refinement on 16 Sep; not yet estimated (Jira status Open).

musthave.feature: Exhibitor side repeatable entries and multi-file upload
musthave.why: For FESPA Middle East (Apr 2027, Dubai, ~500 exhibitors): fixed row caps and one-file uploads force exhibitors to email organisers.
musthave.impact: Will remove limitations on file upload and reduce dependency on manual workarounds for uploading exhibitor manual data
musthave.deps: Design completed and linked in the design subtask (16 Sep). Existing fixed-row and single-file forms and submissions must keep working with no data migration, and the organiser's view must show every added row and file. Risk if delayed: exhibitors keep sending data by email, outside structured collection.
musthave.notes: 16 Sep: design completed and linked in the design subtask. Jira status: Ready to start, due 8 Oct.

musthave.feature: Language and Location Filters for Sessions and Exhibitor Events (Mobile App)
musthave.why: For DLG: the app needs the web's Language and Location session filters so the same filters give the same results on mobile.
musthave.impact: DLG expects to have this feature
musthave.deps: Same event data and option sets as the web filters; related EP-57882; linked with calendar view EP-52201 and EP-57332 (filters drive the calendar grid). iOS filters sub-task EP-57557 was assigned to an Android developer and reassigned to the iOS side on 23 Sep. Risk: due 14 Oct with little time logged so far.
musthave.notes: 21 Sep: iOS and Android designs linked. 23 Sep (on EP-52201): iOS filters sub-task EP-57557 reassigned to an iOS developer. Jira In Progress, due 14 Oct.

musthave.feature: New filters for Sessions and Exhibitor events
musthave.why: New filters for Sessions and Exhibitor events, requested by DLG and HINTE.
musthave.impact: DLG expects to have this feature
musthave.deps: New reported issues on Global Search may delay delivery
musthave.notes: Targeted release date is 14th Oct

musthave.feature: Replace ParamPOS with Iyzico
musthave.why: ParamPOS can no longer process payments, so Turkish-market events (reported by Beauty Istanbul) have lost card payments.
musthave.impact: Organisers of events taking Turkish card payments and their registrants: card payment at checkout is restored through Iyzico, with registrants marked paid and transaction records created as for Stripe and PayPal, and a clear error when payment fails.
musthave.deps: Payment refactoring needs to be completed first
musthave.notes: 8 Sep: preliminary investigation done, no code written; recommends Iyzico's hosted Checkout Form. PO agreed to the Checkout Form, keep existing installment logic, and leave technical design to developers. Merchant account, sandbox and webhook signing still to be requested. Jira Open.

musthave.feature: Required (Important) Custom Category Filters in popup
musthave.why: Paid Vinexposium request: let organisers mark custom category filters as required, so users and exhibitors must pick at least one.
musthave.impact: Organisers get at least one category from every required filter on user and exhibitor records. It covers seven Add category popups: user and exhibitor profile activity/interest categories, products, brands, exhibitor events, news and groups. The admin Categories page gains an Optional/Required filter type and some layout clean-up. The backend will not enforce the rule, so categories set through the admin panel, import, the API or the mobile app are not checked.
musthave.deps: Can be delayed till end of October because of overloaded pipeline
musthave.notes: 28 Sep: brief sent to the client; build waits for the client's final approval. 23 Sep: QA raised 13 open spec questions and estimated about 5 + 2 days (web only; mobile needs a separate task). 22 Sep: FE about 4d, BE about 3-4d. Jira due 13 Oct.

musthave.feature: Session Calendar View - All Day Sessions with fixed 44px +N button (Mobile)
musthave.why: For DLG: day-long sessions (6 hours or more) crowd the mobile calendar grid; this brings the web All Day banner to the app.
musthave.impact: DLG expects to have this feature
musthave.deps: Mobile calendar view EP-52201 (no-results state, overlap layout); grid range story EP-57330 (all-day sessions excluded from the range); web specification EP-57098 and its Confluence page; linked with EP-57291. Risk: part of the 14 Oct DLG mobile delivery, which EP-52201 comments already describe as tight.
musthave.notes: 22 Sep: Android release-candidate build 1.81.2 (11862) uploaded for testing; no other status comment. Jira In Progress, due 14 Oct. 17 Sep (on EP-57330): PO amended this story so a day whose sessions are all all-day renders the 09:00-18:00 grid.

musthave.feature: Session Calendar View - Mobile
musthave.why: Committed to DLG (the reporter): attendees and exhibitors need a mobile calendar view to browse sessions by day and time slot.
musthave.impact: DLG expects to have this feature
musthave.deps: Web setting for the default view (EP-55021). Both QA sub-tasks (EP-55568, EP-55578) still in progress; 21 defects raised 2-21 Sep, 13 on iOS, with iOS capacity reduced. Proposed release blockers: EP-57117, EP-57575, EP-57565; EP-57548 (sponsored banner scale) needs a PO decision; EP-57309 (session card design) proposed to split out. musthave.notes: Testing is pending

musthave.feature: Session Calendar View - Show starting and ending time slots only
musthave.why: For DLG: attendees should see the programme on load in the mobile calendar, without scrolling through empty hours.
musthave.impact: DLG expects to have this feature
musthave.deps: Mobile calendar view EP-52201 (no-results state, card rendering across midnight) and all-day banner EP-57332 (all-day sessions excluded from the range). Risk: shares the 14 Oct DLG mobile delivery.
musthave.notes: 17 Sep: PO ruled that an empty day, or an all-empty 3-day block, shows a fixed 09:00-18:00 grid; midnight and all-day rules added to the criteria. 21-22 Sep: Android builds 1.81.2 (11839, 11859) uploaded for testing. Jira In Progress, due 14 Oct.

musthave.deps: Next Step of AI search transition

musthave.feature: Email Digest
musthave.why: Asked by Vinexposium and internally: attendees miss meetings and unread messages; a digest email cuts no-shows and support tickets.
musthave.impact: Attendees & Exhibitors: timely daily summaries of scheduled meetings, incoming requests and unread messages. Organizers & Support: full delivery/open-rate analytics and logs via Campaigns with zero-spam protection.
musthave.deps: Built as a new campaign type in the shared Campaigns module (agreed 16 Sep), so existing campaigns need a regression check. Email layouts from EP-52511; layout of the Booking Activity total and bar awaited from Nazar Melnyk; FE and MQA estimates still to be confirmed by Evgen Polivach; the admin send screen gets no design and is built to existing patterns. Meeting status change log only fills from release, so Booking Activity stays hidden at first. Covers exhibitors from EP-47533. The Confluence spec still describes the superseded design. Risk: the timeline cannot go to the client until the full estimate is locked.
musthave.notes: 28 Sep: aggregate send statistics and ~21-22 backend days approved; 'turn it back on' button kept; admin screen to be built without design. Waiting on FE and MQA estimates (Evgen Polivach) and the Booking Activity card layout (Nazar Melnyk).

musthave.feature: Permission Matrix - Upgrade UI
musthave.why: Admins need a tabbed permissions page so permissions for a large number of categories and roles are clear and easy to manage.
musthave.impact: Makes permission settings easy and clear to use
musthave.deps: Can be taken after contracted items are done
musthave.notes: Open, due 2026-12-31, no original estimate, 12.15 days already logged. 2026-07-27 Konstantin Shein: requirements and design need to be actualised (agreed with Oleksandr Parashchuk). 2026-09-28 Ajay Singh: tentative start and due dates must always be filled.

musthave.deps: Next Step of AI search transition

Spike EP-55778 Done (original estimate 2 days, due 2026-08-25); its outcome is RFC-0010 (published 2026-09-23, status Draft, decision pending), which chooses a per-event, per-entity admin switch between ElasticSearch and AI search, with no fallback on AI failure (team discussion 2026-09-22). 2026-09-22 Oleksii Tur asked what the fallback should be if the AI endpoint returns nothing. First listing story EP-55996 (Exhibitors list) is Open, no estimate. Rollout phases P0 to P4 in the RFC; Exhibitors first, then one entity per change. For IMEX Frankfurt 2027 (18-20 May 2027); delivery this year, so it is not overdue (owner, 28 Sep 2026).

musthave.why: Lets organisers sell Lead Capture Pro and AI Notetaker per team member, not only for the whole exhibitor team, for flexible offers.

musthave.feature: Group Registration
musthave.why: ExpoPlatform has no group registration: a team of ten must register and pay ten times, or our staff key the order in by hand.
musthave.impact: Buyers pay once for many passes (one transaction, one VAT invoice) and assign places later; each claimant completes the normal registration form, so exhibitors and matchmaking get real named attendees; organiser staff stop keying and maintaining group orders by hand.
musthave.deps: Needs an engineering estimate on one data model change: a ticket (slot) that exists without an attendee profile. Blocked by two commercial decisions (how volume bands combine with early bird and discount codes; what happens when a refund drops an order below a band) and a decision on whether slots are claimable before an invoice is paid. Touches 16 modules (basket quantity, ticketing per-order cap, discounts, emails, Open API, kiosks must refuse unassigned slots). Registration and payment were split across two teams in EP-27117.
musthave.notes: Proposal page 'Group Registration: concept and proposal' (last modified 14 Sep 2026) is status 'Concept, not built' and asks for a go/no-go decision, with a clickable prototype and 3 proposed phases. Older Feature Request EP-27117 'Group Registration' (created 2024-03-08) is still 'Incoming request'; last comment 2024-03-19: Team B to build registration, Team A payment; its estimate table is empty apart from 1 PM day for Team B.

needs.name: Buttons instead of hyperlinks in default email templates
needs.what: In the default email templates of a new project, put activation, reset password, meeting and message links on buttons instead of hyperlinks.
needs.why: TAMs place buttons by hand and clients struggle to copy the variable into a button, so emails sometimes go out with long links that users must copy, lowering click-through. Tier 1 customers asking: Dubai World Trade Centre DWTC/ DXB Live, Informa Markets (UK), Informa North America, Kortrijk Xpo (Busworld), Vinexposium.
needs.outcome: Users get clear button calls to action in these emails from the start of every project.
cus: Dubai World Trade Centre DWTC/ DXB Live
North American Passive House Network Inc.

needs.name: Sort options on marketplace listings
needs.what: Add sort options to the marketplace listings (exhibitors, products, brands, delegates) on web and app: A-Z and Z-A, created or last updated date, and hall/stand location, plus an alphabet letter bar to browse the exhibitor directory.
needs.why: Listings have only predefined sorts, so participants scroll whole lists to find an exhibitor or plan an onsite route; asked by IMEX, Informa (Informa Markets UK, Informa North America: MRO, Saladplate, Informa fashion), Frankfurter Buchmesse (all T1), Mercator Media (T2) and Reed Thailand.
needs.outcome: Users order and browse listings alphabetically, by date or by location.
needs.bo: Related: matchmaking sort order on marketplace and delegates pages; not alphabetical (EP-27225, via EP-23544) [MASTER Networking & Interactions §5 User Stories Mapping :6840]; Related: matchmaking-based sort on listing pages, not alphabetical sorting (EP-27225, via EP-244) [MASTER Networking & Interactions §5 User Stories Mapping :6840]; Related: matchmaking-based sort on marketplace pages (EP-27225, via EP-6657) [MASTER Networking & Interactions §5 User Stories Mapping :6840]

needs.name: GDPR cookie consent banner
needs.what: Provide a native GDPR-compliant cookie consent interface: equal Accept all and Reject all buttons, per-category toggles with descriptions, blocking non-essential cookies until opt-in, a Cookie Settings link, and admin-set information links.
needs.why: DLG Markets and Frankfurter Buchmesse (T1), ANWR, HINTE and K5 say the current banner breaks GDPR and risks fines; Vinexposium (T1) wants a clearer consent choice.
needs.outcome: Visitors give or refuse cookie consent explicitly and non-essential cookies stay blocked until they opt in.
needs.bo: Related: KB KB documents only guidance for integrating third-party consent tools (CookieBot, OneTrust), not a native consent interface [MASTER Event Website §4 Feature Inventory :5912 Third-Party Cookie Consent Compliance]

needs.name: Exhibitor logos on stands
needs.what: Show exhibitor logos permanently on their stands on the interactive floor plan, optionally only for selected exhibitors (e.g. sponsors), with ExpoFP integration settings to send all, no or only selected exhibitors' logos.
needs.why: Logos appear only after clicking a stand, so attendees click stand by stand to see who is where; raised by Vinexposium (Wine Paris), Frankfurter Buchmesse and DLG, which sells logo display as a separate service (Tampere also wants control).
needs.outcome: Attendees see who is where at a glance and organisers can sell logo display.
needs.bo: Related (EP-15370): clickable stands link to exhibitor profiles; no static logos [MASTER Exhibitor Marketplace §5 User Stories Mapping :12035] via FIS-1952579589; Partially built (EP-26327): ExpoFP data sync pushes exhibitor data on each change; a switch for logos is the ask [MASTER Floor Plan §5 User Stories Mapping :13653] via EP-42266

needs.name: Multilingual SEO
needs.what: Make multilingual event websites SEO-friendly: language codes in URLs, hreflang tags, correct HTML lang per page, per-language sitemaps, and SEO title, description and meta tags per language.
needs.why: Frankfurter Buchmesse, Kortrijk Xpo (Busworld) and Vinexposium (T1) serve international audiences; Vinexposium cannot set French page meta for Wine Paris, and IMEX (T1) Frankfurt's German pages declare lang=EN.
needs.outcome: Each language version of a page carries its own URL, language attribute and meta data, and ranks in local-language search.
needs.bo: Partially built: EP-23702 browser-language detection is built (the ticket says so); language URLs, hreflang and per-language SEO fields are not [MASTER Event Website §5 User Stories Mapping :5953]; Related: EP-105 per-page SEO fields exist without a language dimension [MASTER Event Website §5 User Stories Mapping :5992]

needs.outcome: Organisers decide exactly who can scan and who can download leads, per category and per team member, without manual per-exhibitor work.

needs.name: Per-form notification recipients
needs.what: Let each custom form have its own admin notification recipients, several per form, with a warning before publishing a form with none.
needs.why: One recipient list is shared by all forms, so people get submissions not meant for them; raised by Vinexposium (T1), Mercator Media, Afreximbank (CANEX, IATF) and others.
needs.outcome: Each form's submissions reach only the organisers chosen for that form.
needs.bo: Related: EP-24373 custom form blocks exist; per-form notification recipients are not described [MASTER Event Website §5 User Stories Mapping :5957]

needs.name: Stay on the edit page after saving

needs.outcome: End users see system error messages in their selected language on web and app.

needs.name: Configurable exhibitor list download

needs.name: Event-level date format setting
needs.what: Add an event setting to choose the date format (DD/MM/YYYY or MM/DD/YYYY), like the 12/24-hour time setting, applied to every date display and input on web, app, Admin panel and Management panel.

needs.what: Send automated reminder emails to recipients of meeting requests left pending, targeted at users by activity (e.g. pending for more than 2-3 days), and remind users who have not replied to a chat.

needs.name: Upcoming and live sessions first

needs.outcome: Attendees land on what is running now and next.

needs.name: Automatic event activation for community members
needs.what: When a user active in the community signs in to a community event, recognise them, activate their event account automatically, populate global data and send them to fill any required fields.
needs.why: Adventics, DLG, Fairtrade and Frankfurter Buchmesse: organisers must import and activate users for each event and users must activate accounts manually.
needs.outcome: Community members enter any community event without separate import or activation.

needs.name: Message reply notifications and unread digest
needs.what: Tell users when someone replies to or messages them: a daily or weekly digest email of unread messages and replies with organiser-set frequency and template, and an in-platform notification and email to the original sender when a message gets a reply.
needs.why: Only the first message triggers a notification, so replies go unseen and exhibitors miss leads; on Vinexposium 99.6% of messages are one-way. Raised by Vinexposium, Kortrijk Xpo (Busworld) and BeautyIstanbul, with a warning that one email per reply would be spam.
needs.outcome: Exhibitors and attendees learn of replies and unread messages and return to the platform to respond.

needs.name: Fully passwordless OTP events

Asked by Informa Markets (UK) (T1), Informa North America (T1), Informa (T4), VDI Technologiezentrum GmbH (T4), K5 GmbH - Future Retail.
needs.outcome: Users on OTP events sign in, manage their profile, cancel registrations and delete their account without ever needing a password.

needs.name: Exhibitor placeholder logos

needs.outcome: Exhibitors without a logo look consistent across web and app.

needs.name: Mandatory matchmaking criteria and weights

needs.outcome: Users get matches that satisfy the mandatory criteria first, ranked by the organiser's weights.
needs.bo: Partially built. Partially built: Multi-Space Matchmaking already scores with space weights; mandatory 'always consider' filters and per-criterion weight/exclusion controls are not documented [MASTER Networking & Interactions §4 Feature Inventory :6526]

needs.name: Pro-forma invoices and deferred invoicing

needs.why: Organisers and their agencies filter, analyse and report on meetings from the export but the fields are missing: Northstar gets the rating fields only through a developer database export, Vinexposium filters stand locations by hand and wants to prioritise follow-ups by exhibitor category, and its agency BBCM spends hours on weekly per-co-exhibitor reports without the parent exhibitor column.
needs.outcome: Organisers group, filter and evaluate meetings straight from the standard export, without manual work or developer exports.
needs.bo: Related. Related: EP-1089: meetings export reworked with all meeting fields; these rating fields are reported missing [MASTER Meetings & Matchmaking §5 User Stories Mapping :7869]; Related: EP-19438: ratings for completed meetings exist [MASTER Meetings & Matchmaking §5 User Stories Mapping :7903]; Related: EP-8011: stand is the default location in the request form; the export column is not covered [MASTER Meetings & Matchmaking §5 User Stories Mapping :7878]; Related: EP-12023: hall/stand replacement in meeting data via API [MASTER Meetings & Matchmaking §5 User Stories Mapping :7892]

needs.name: Lead capture screen save and qualification UX
needs.what: Make the app lead capture screen focused and reliable: a fixed Save button that stays visible above the keyboard and activates on change, a hidden bottom bar, and stars and qualifier buttons that start unset.
needs.why: The keyboard hides Save while typing notes, and prefilled stars and preselected qualifiers produce wrong lead data; the aim is more qualified and noted leads. Asked by Informa Markets (UK) and DWTC, both Tier 1.
needs.outcome: Exhibitors qualify and save more leads with accurate data.
needs.bo: Related: web lead capture page with rating and notes (EP-1080) [MASTER Lead Intelligence §5 User Stories Mapping :12733] [EP-7244]
cus: Dubai World Trade Centre DWTC/ DXB Live

needs.name: Category columns in the brands report
needs.what: Add category columns to the Product Brands report export: the brand category and the exhibitor category.
needs.why: Without categories in the report, organisers must cross-reference the exhibitor file and struggle to verify synchronised data. Informa North America, BolognaFiere and Mercator Media ask.
needs.outcome: Organisers analyse and validate brands by category from one export.
needs.bo: Partially built (EP-1083): Product Brands export exists (SQS rework); the category column is the ask [MASTER Organiser Analytics §5 User Stories Mapping :2754]

needs.name: Confirm email field on registration
needs.what: Add a mandatory confirm-email field to the registration form that must exactly match the main email entry.
needs.why: Typos in the single email field are accepted, causing bounces when organisers email their database; Busworld and Afreximbank want it as standard form practice. Asked by Kortrijk Xpo (Busworld) (T1), Afreximbank (T2), FOCUS - The Meeting Place for International Production (T3), AEIB.
needs.outcome: Registrants cannot submit a mistyped email address, and bounces from typos drop.
cus: FOCUS - The Meeting Place for International Production

needs.name: Parent/child exhibitors and pavilions in the app
needs.what: Bring the web's parent/child exhibitor relationships (pavilions, stand sharers) to the app, including pavilions shown in their own exhibitor list tab.
needs.why: It already exists on web; Informa Markets (UK) and Vinexposium, both Tier 1, and Informa Healthcare ask for it, Vinexposium to boost buyer-exhibitor engagement.
needs.outcome: App users see pavilions and their member exhibitors as on web.
needs.bo: Partially built: The toggle for showing child company indication applies in the app (EP-37805) [MASTER Exhibitor Marketplace §5 User Stories Mapping :12052] [EP-5300]; Related: parent/child management on the frontend (EP-11754) [MASTER Mobile App §5 User Stories Mapping :10640] [EP-5300]; Related: the web parent/child feature (EP-927) [MASTER Exhibitor Marketplace §5 User Stories Mapping :12026] [EP-5300]

needs.name: Reporting data via the API
needs.what: Provide GET API endpoints for post-show reporting data: visitor and exhibitor logins, favourites and exhibitor interactions with the export-file columns, plus media details (ID, name, type, exhibitor) and meeting details (ID, status including whether it happened, date, notes).
needs.why: Informa teams (Informa Markets (UK), Informa Fashion and other Informa divisions) want post-show reporting automated instead of relying on Excel exports, and cannot tell which document was downloaded from which exhibitor or whether a meeting happened.
needs.outcome: Informa pulls its reporting data straight from the API.
needs.bo: Partially built (EP-14482): Statistics API v2 exposes account interactions (including favourites) and page visits; login data endpoints are not covered [MASTER Organiser Analytics §5 User Stories Mapping :2762]; Partially built (EP-9435): /api/v2/meetings/export returns full meeting fields; media detail endpoints are not covered [MASTER Meetings & Matchmaking §5 User Stories Mapping :7885]

needs.name: Direct password reset from the admin profile
needs.what: Add a button in the admin exhibitor profile to reset or update an activated exhibitor's password directly.
needs.why: Informa (MRO; Informa Markets (UK) T1, Informa North America T1) must use the customer service flow and fill unknown mandatory fields; generate-credentials only works for inactive accounts.
needs.outcome: Organisers fix exhibitor login problems in one step.
needs.bo: Related built work: EP-12215: related (EP-23019), customer service button added to list actions; no direct password reset [MASTER Admin / Platform Core §5 User Stories Mapping :1371]

needs.name: Event-specific exhibitor logos
needs.what: Add an environment toggle that makes exhibitor logos local to each event, so an exhibitor can have a different logo per event and the default logo is used where no event-specific logo was uploaded.
needs.why: Informa (Premiere, Cosmoprof) found that logos are global, so an exhibitor's latest upload (e.g. for Orlando) replaced its logo on the still-live Anaheim site, including logos bought as a paid digital upgrade for one event only.
needs.outcome: Each event's website shows the exhibitor logo that belongs to that event, and paid custom logos stay only where they were bought.

needs.name: External marketplace profile button
needs.what: Add an exhibitor registration field for an external marketplace URL, with the usual field options (required, hidden, not editable, show in exhibitor card), in import and export templates, editable by the exhibitor, and shown as a "View Marketplace Profile" button (label customisable) on the exhibitor profile and card.
needs.why: MRO Americas (Informa) offers exhibitors a listing on its own marketplace and wants approved exhibitors to link to it, filled in by file upload.
needs.outcome: Visitors click through from an exhibitor's profile or card to that exhibitor's external marketplace page.

needs.name: Favourites filter on search pages
needs.what: Add a "Favourites" filter to search pages (exhibitors, products, participants, brands, news) on web and app, configurable in Display Filters.
needs.why: Informa (MRO): favourites are only reachable from the profile, which takes users away from the search page.
needs.outcome: Users filter any listing to their favourites without leaving the page.
needs.bo: Related: existing-meeting filters were added to Display Filters; no favourites filter (EP-27888, via EP-12240) [MASTER Exhibitor Marketplace §5 User Stories Mapping :12045]

needs.name: Hide Lead Capture Pro banner after purchase
needs.what: Hide the Lead Capture Pro banner on the exhibitor dashboard automatically once the exhibitor has bought all available options (core, custom questions, product QR), while keeping access under the Networking menu.
needs.why: MRO (Informa) finds the banner stays on the dashboard after purchase, showing redundant information.
needs.outcome: Exhibitors who bought everything see their normal dashboard without the sales banner.
needs.bo: Partially built: Lead Capture Pro purchase from the exhibitor profile exists; banner behaviour after purchase is the ask [MASTER Lead Intelligence §4 Feature Inventory :12704 Lead Capture Pro] via EP-43749

needs.name: Invoice branding when ExpoPlatform bills
needs.what: Show the logo and billing company details on invoices when ExpoPlatform is the billing company (Lead Capture Pro sold to exhibitors), either by allowing invoice customisation or by filling EP billing details by default.
needs.why: Invoices for Lead Capture Pro at MRO Europe go out without logo or billing company details although they are set up, so exhibitors ask for properly formatted invoices they can use for company payments.
needs.outcome: Exhibitors buying Lead Capture Pro receive complete invoices with the logo and billing company details.
needs.bo: Related (KB feature: General Payment Settings): billing company details are a general payment setting; the gap is their display when EP is the biller [MASTER Transactions & Purchasing §4 Feature Inventory :4367]

needs.name: Lead Capture Pro discounts and payment options
needs.what: Add options to Lead Capture Pro purchases: discount/promo codes (including free of charge), choice of which of individual or company payment is offered or preselected, and control over which invoicing fields are shown and mandatory for each.
needs.why: MRO (Informa) organisers want to offer sponsors free or discounted access, early-bird rates and compensation deals, and to tailor the payment form.
needs.outcome: Organisers price and discount Lead Capture Pro per exhibitor and tailor the checkout, which could raise uptake.
needs.bo: Partially built: Lead Capture Pro purchase flow with Stripe, pricing and invoicing exists; discount codes and field control are the ask [MASTER Lead Intelligence §4 Feature Inventory :12704 Lead Capture Pro] via EP-43748

needs.name: Meeting limit disclaimers only when a limit is hit
needs.what: Stop showing the default meeting limit disclaimers (the green rows) in the front-end meeting schedule and show only the red messages when a limit is reached.
needs.why: On Vinexposium the many disclaimer rows confused users, looked like a malfunction and created support emails; hiding them by CSS has to be repeated on every account. Tier 1: Informa Markets (UK).
needs.outcome: Users see limit messages only when they actually hit a limit.
needs.bo: Related. Related: EP-24046: limit errors shown on mobile as on web [MASTER Mobile App §5 User Stories Mapping :10649]

needs.name: Push notification tap tracking
needs.what: Count any tap on an admin push notification as a click, including notifications without a link that open the app, and track link opens separately.
needs.why: Informa sees gaps in analytics because taps on push notifications without a link are not counted, so teams add dummy links as a workaround; comments note plain-text notifications may only allow a seen/not-seen measure.
needs.outcome: Organisers see accurate engagement for every push notification without adding dummy links.
needs.bo: Related (EP-1085): admin notifications panel; tap tracking without links is the ask [MASTER User Engagement §5 User Stories Mapping :9988] via EP-44738

needs.name: Widget scroll bar usability
needs.what: Make the scroll bar of embeddable widgets (exhibitor, session and speaker lists) wider so it is usable with a trackpad or on a tablet.
needs.why: The MRO team embeds widgets on its own site, where a double scroll bar appears and the widget's is too thin to use without a mouse, as internal and customer feedback shows.
needs.outcome: Visitors scroll embedded widgets easily on laptops and tablets.

needs.name: Native integrations on the Integration Hub
needs.what: A restricted Integration Hub where the API Manager and TAMs build native integrations and change field mappings without R&D, with existing native integrations (ASP, Klipso) migrated onto the new Abstract Integration Schema and Integrations page, keeping current behaviour and the standard API mapping as default.
needs.why: Native integrations were built per client, so every new client on the same system needs discovery and feature requests even for small mapping changes, slowing turnaround. The migrations touch Northstar Travel Group (ASP) and Vinexposium (Klipso).
needs.outcome: Native integrations are configured and remapped in the Hub without development.
needs.bo: Partially built (EP-45437): Integration HUB catalogue of connectors with configuration exists in the admin panel; self-service building and mapping is beyond it [MASTER Integrations §5 User Stories Mapping :16028]; Related (EP-11456): the existing ASP integration (exhibitor, session, speaker pull) that is being migrated [MASTER Sessions & Speakers §5 User Stories Mapping :8682]; Related (EP-46491): umbrella native integration migration epic, migration in progress [MASTER Integrations §5 User Stories Mapping :16031]; Related (EP-14473): the existing Klipso exhibitor-data integration being…

needs.name: Semantic headings on system pages
needs.what: Give system and listing pages (speakers, participants, products, exhibitors, events calendar) a single semantic H1 and a correct heading hierarchy, optionally customisable, and pass headings and session names to GA4.
needs.why: Frankfurter Buchmesse (T1)'s web agency and IMEX (T1) report that system pages lack H1/H2 tags, so crawlers and GA4 read empty headings, which hurts SEO and accessibility.
needs.outcome: Each system page renders one correct H1 within a proper heading hierarchy, and GA4 receives page headings.
needs.bo: Partially built: EP-15215 H1 on all pages recorded as delivered; the request reports listing pages still render H2 and adds GA4 tracking [MASTER Event Website §5 User Stories Mapping :5933]; Related: EP-105 per-page SEO controls for system pages; not heading tags [MASTER Event Website §5 User Stories Mapping :5992]

needs.name: Admin sessions and exhibitor events list filters
needs.what: Give the admin panel sessions and exhibitor events lists filters like the frontend and Exhibitor Directory (type, track, speaker, company, breakout only) plus event status.
needs.why: The admin list is flat with almost no filters, so Frankfurter Buchmesse (T1) and IMEX (T1) staff scan page by page; IMEX spent hundreds of hours finding ~4,000 sessions awaiting approval.
needs.outcome: Admins find sessions and events to review in large programmes quickly.
needs.bo: Related (FIS-1567817767, EP-23021): admin session list keeps filter and search state; no new filters [MASTER Admin / Platform Core §5 User Stories Mapping :1372]; Related (EP-23057, EP-26029): frontend filter between sessions and exhibitor events; not an admin filter [MASTER Sessions & Speakers §5 User Stories Mapping :8706]

needs.name: Bulk buyer acceptance with category and status
needs.what: Let organisers set buyer category and status in bulk: multi-select buyers and assign a category when accepting them, let the visitor import file set buyer category and status, and let agent imports carry buyers' profile data and custom question answers.
needs.why: DWTC (T1) and Vinexposium (T1) pre-accept buyers in bulk, but batch accept cannot assign a category and status changes are only possible via agent upload, so buyers are activated one by one or changed in the database; agent imports also drop custom questions.
needs.outcome: Organisers accept, categorise and import many buyers at once with their status, category and profile data.
needs.bo: Related built work: EP-96: related, Buyers Management has batch accept of pre-accepted buyers, not import of status [MASTER Hosted Buyer Management §4 Feature Inventory :14983]
cus: Dubai World Trade Centre DWTC/ DXB Live

needs.name: Card element visibility toggles
needs.what: Let organisers hide elements in card blocks (titles, text, buttons, per card) and hide unused cards, closing the space and keeping the responsive layout.
needs.why: Clients often want cards without some elements and the team does it with custom CSS; IMEX (T1) and Vinexposium (T1) raised it.
needs.outcome: Organisers shape card blocks without custom CSS.

needs.name: Modern image formats (WebP/AVIF)
needs.what: Support WebP and AVIF on the event website: accept uploads in these formats and convert uploaded images automatically, serving AVIF, then WebP, then JPEG/PNG by browser support.
needs.why: IMEX (T1) wants faster image loading; Vinexposium (T1)'s homepage stays at 4 MB even after compression.
needs.outcome: Images are served in lighter modern formats with fallbacks, cutting page weight.

needs.name: Participant category for team members at creation
needs.what: Put team members in the right participant category when they are created: let exhibitors choose it, assign it straight away so badges can be scanned, and let the Klipso native integration assign team member admins to a configured category ID.
needs.why: ADS Security Policy spends about 2 hours a day correcting categories for ~20,000 team members; Kortrijk Xpo (Busworld, T1) has team member badges that are not scannable straight away; Vinexposium (T1) cannot identify team member admins in the visitor list after the Klipso import.
needs.outcome: Team members carry the correct participant category from the moment they exist.
needs.bo: Partially built: setting auto-assigns a participant category to team members; exhibitors cannot pick one (EP-15824, via FIS-1522335745) [MASTER Exhibitor Portal §5 User Stories Mapping :11283]; Related: default category for uncategorised participants (EP-14938, via FIS-1522335745) [MASTER Online Registration §5 User Stories Mapping :5298]; Partially built: a backend setting already auto-assigns a participant category to team members; the scanning delay with the external database is not covered (EP-15824, via EP-24328) [MASTER Exhibitor Portal §5 User Stories Mapping :11283]; Partially built:…

needs.name: Session and exhibitor event filters parity
needs.what: Add web filters to the app's sessions and exhibitor event listings: product categories, language, location and custom filters, with the same results as web.
needs.why: Users cannot filter as on web; asked by DLG Markets and Frankfurter Buchmesse, both Tier 1.
needs.outcome: App users filter sessions and exhibitor events as on web.
needs.bo: Related: session filter fields were extended on the backend (EP-12365) [MASTER Sessions & Speakers §5 User Stories Mapping :8685] [EP-37371]

needs.name: Stats and counter block layouts
needs.what: Offer a stats / counter block that presents several numbers together with flexible background and layout, including where the description sits.
needs.why: IMEX (T1) and Vinexposium (T1) repeat counter modules or use custom code to show several numbers.
needs.outcome: Organisers present key figures in one styled block.

needs.name: Video player behaviour
needs.what: Give website builder videos standard player behaviour: sound, pause and fullscreen controls, click anywhere on the frame to play or pause, and an autoplay option.
needs.why: Vinexposium (T1) and IMEX (T1) visitors expect to control videos easily and currently cannot.
needs.outcome: Visitors control website videos as on YouTube or Vimeo.

needs.name: Buttons in all modules
needs.what: Let every website builder module include linked buttons, including more than two call-to-action buttons, with the usual button options.
needs.why: Vinexposium (T1) and IMEX (T1) ask front-end developers to add buttons with custom code; a two-button limit forces marketing to drop actions.
needs.outcome: Organisers add the calls to action they need in any module.

needs.name: Category sort order
needs.what: Let admins control category order: manual order per language, an automatic A-Z option following language rules (DIN 5007 for German), and product categories displayed in the order of the import file (by category ID) instead of alphabetically.
needs.why: With many categories, manual re-ordering is slow and one order applies to all languages, so German lists are not sorted correctly (DLG Markets), and imported product categories lose their file order (Dubai World Trade Centre, DWTC).
needs.outcome: Categories appear in the intended order for each language without manual re-ordering.
needs.bo: Related. Related: EP-24228: category order made consistent on web and app; import order not covered [MASTER Exhibitor Marketplace §5 User Stories Mapping :12041]
cus: Dubai World Trade Centre DWTC/ DXB Live

needs.name: Clickable images in blocks
needs.what: Let organisers set a link on images in gallery blocks and in the Heading & text & image & button block.
needs.why: Vinexposium (T1) and IMEX (T1) want images to lead to more content.
needs.outcome: Images on the site link to pages or external URLs.

needs.name: Configurable cards per row
needs.what: Let organisers set how many cards show per row (2 to 6, with arrows beyond), reorder and add or delete cards in the card row block.
needs.why: IMEX (T1) and Vinexposium (T1) depend on the front-end team to remove columns from card rows.
needs.outcome: Organisers lay out card rows themselves.

needs.name: Consent-gated embeds
needs.what: Hold back iframes and embedded videos across the whole website (products, sessions, builder pages, app areas) until the visitor consents, extending the exhibitor-profile iframe consent.
needs.why: Frankfurter Buchmesse (T1) must comply with German data protection law, and DLG Markets (T1) reports YouTube embeds set tracking cookies before consent.
needs.outcome: Embedded third-party content loads only after consent, site-wide.

needs.name: Directory visibility by meeting permission
needs.what: Show users only the people they are allowed to meet or contact: a 'Connect and Meet' view listing only attendees a user type may meet, and a delegate list visible to, and contactable by, chosen sponsor and exhibitor categories only.
needs.why: Informa's Smart Events team (CPHI, PP events) wants users to see only the people they may meet, and Kortrijk Xpo (Busworld) wants delegate access limited to certain sponsor and exhibitor categories.
needs.outcome: Each user sees and contacts only the people their category is allowed to meet.
needs.bo: Partially built. Partially built: EP-56: Organisers can restrict which delegate groups see each other in the directory; the dedicated 'Connect and Meet' view is not covered [MASTER Community §5 User Stories Mapping :9294]

needs.name: Favourited exhibitors on the ExpoFP map
needs.what: Sync users' favourited exhibitors to the ExpoFP map through the integration so favourites are shown or filterable on the map on web and in the app.
needs.why: Visitors favourite exhibitors but cannot find them on the ExpoFP map; MRO Americas (Informa North America) had it on its legacy floor plan and Kortrijk Xpo organisers would find it useful. A comment says ExpoFP being third-party made it infeasible at the time.
needs.outcome: Visitors plan stand visits from their favourites on the map.
needs.bo: Related: app users can bookmark stands on the ExpoFP floor plan (stored locally; favourites sync planned) [MASTER Floor Plan §4 Feature Inventory :13578] via EP-27692; Related (EP-26327): exhibitor data pushed from EP to ExpoFP; favourites not synced [MASTER Floor Plan §5 User Stories Mapping :13653] via EP-27692

needs.name: Filters that never lead to empty results
needs.what: Make listing filters dependent so each child filter shows only options that still return results, and let admins hide empty categories from exhibitor and product search filters, on web and mobile.
needs.why: DWTC (T1) wants to avoid empty search results; Vinexposium (T1) lists hiding empty categories as its top priority before its visitor launch.
needs.outcome: Every filter option a user can pick returns results.
cus: Dubai World Trade Centre DWTC/ DXB Live

needs.name: Global typography controls
needs.what: Extend global text styles with sizes per heading level and paragraph, letter-spacing, line-height, weight 800, and a responsive scale for mobile.
needs.why: Frankfurter Buchmesse (T1) and IMEX (T1) rely on external CSS for typography, and text is oversized on phones.
needs.outcome: Organisers control site typography on desktop and mobile without CSS.
needs.bo: Related: EP-23051 typography module in text blocks; no per-breakpoint sizes [MASTER Event Website §5 User Stories Mapping :5951]

needs.name: Organiser moderation of RFPs
needs.what: Route attendee RFPs through the organiser (or its customer service), who accepts or rejects each one before it reaches the exhibitor, as for News; the RFP 2.0 rework also follows the organiser's flow chart and considers a public RFP board.
needs.why: Attendees can send RFPs to many exhibitors without control, spamming them; asked by Fairtrade and by Tier 1 Informa Markets (UK) for Saladplate (Informa Asia), which wants only genuine requests to reach suppliers and better data analysis.
needs.outcome: Exhibitors and suppliers receive only RFPs the organiser has approved.
needs.bo: Related (EP-2104): RFP acceptance count limited by exhibitor category, no moderation [MASTER Exhibitor Portal §5 User Stories Mapping :11234]

needs.name: Platform of interaction in the statistics API
needs.what: Add a platform (user agent: mobile app, web, mobile browser) field and filter to /api/v2/statistics/accountsInteractions, as on accountsPageVisits.
needs.why: Clients pulling statistics cannot tell through which platform an interaction was made, so they cannot separate web and mobile behaviour. IMEX and Informa Markets (UK) ask.
needs.outcome: Statistics API consumers can split interactions by platform.
needs.bo: Related (EP-25280): time filter added to the same statistics endpoint; no platform field [MASTER Exhibitor Portal §5 User Stories Mapping :11295]; Related (EP-14482): Statistics API v2 built; no user agent field [MASTER Organiser Analytics §5 User Stories Mapping :2762]

needs.name: Separate customer-service impersonation from user activity
needs.what: Count admin logins and actions made through "customer service" (impersonating a user) separately from real user logins and activity, and make the Account Activity charts exportable with exhibitor pages separated from regular and custom pages.
needs.why: Informa (Informa Markets (UK), Informa North America) digital ops found customer-service logins and actions inflate login and activity numbers, and chart data cannot be exported.
needs.outcome: Login and activity analytics reflect real users only, and the charts can be exported.

needs.name: Text editor formatting
needs.what: Improve the Text Editor block: pasted content takes global fonts, headlines, Clear All Formatting, a sticky toolbar, and a simpler font weight list.
needs.why: Frankfurter Buchmesse (T1) and IMEX (T1) reformat pasted content by hand, scroll to reach the toolbar, and are confused by identical font weights.
needs.outcome: Organisers format text quickly and consistently.
needs.bo: Related: EP-23051 rich text editor in the new builder; paste handling, clear formatting and sticky toolbar not documented [MASTER Event Website §5 User Stories Mapping :5951]

needs.name: Unsaved changes warning
needs.what: Warn users with a confirmation prompt when they close the tab, reload or navigate away with unsaved changes on every page with a Save button, including exhibitor and visitor edit profile on web and the app's edit profile.
needs.why: Users make changes and leave without saving, unaware nothing was saved, and lose work; asked by Tier 1 Hyve Group and Frankfurter Buchmesse.
needs.outcome: Users are warned before leaving a page with unsaved changes and no longer lose their edits by accident.

needs.name: Visible search bar with focus
needs.what: Show a search bar directly on the homepage instead of a magnifier icon, and put the cursor in it automatically when search opens.
needs.why: Busworld Community (Kortrijk Xpo, T1) users could not find the magnifier icon; Frankfurter Buchmesse (T1) users have to click into the bar again after opening it.
needs.outcome: Users start typing a search immediately.

needs.name: Contrasting pop-up close icon
needs.what: Give the floor plan pop-up close (X) icon an automatic contrasting colour so it is visible on dark backgrounds.
needs.why: The dark grey icon on a dark background is nearly invisible, an accessibility gap that makes attendees click blindly; raised by FBM and DLG. Tier 1 customers asking: DLG Markets GmbH, Frankfurter Buchmesse GmbH.
needs.outcome: Attendees always see and use the close icon in floor plan pop-ups.

needs.name: Exhibitor tags and categories sent to ExpoFP
needs.what: Push exhibitor tags (ExpoFP order tags such as Order:1, Order:2) and exhibitor categories to ExpoFP through the existing native integration, and let the web, Android and iOS floor plan viewers order exhibitors by tag and filter them by category.
needs.why: ExpoFP supports tag-based display order and category filters, but EP does not send these fields, so organisers cannot use them; requested by Cosmoprof for its next shows. Tier 1 customers asking: Informa North America, Vinexposium.
needs.outcome: Visitors on web and app filter the ExpoFP floor plan by exhibitor category and see exhibitors ordered as the organiser tagged them.
needs.bo: Partially built (EP-26327): exhibitor create/edit/delete is already pushed to ExpoFP; tags and categories are not sent [MASTER Floor Plan §5 User Stories Mapping :13653] via EP-46686; Related (EP-24164): EP overlay UI on the ExpoFP floor plan, no category filter [MASTER Floor Plan §5 User Stories Mapping :13652] via EP-46686

needs.name: GDPR-compliant private favouriting
needs.what: Let attendees favourite and save exhibitors, speakers and products privately without becoming visible to exhibitors in delegate lists, matchmaking or notifications, change their opt-in / opt-out choice themselves, and keep an audit trail of consent changes.
needs.why: Favouriting only works when opted in, which exposes the attendee to third parties, while opting out disables all engagement; category-based hiding is inflexible. Raised by DLG and FrankfurterBuchmesse (FBM) for strict German GDPR expectations (EP-40775).
needs.outcome: Attendees can bookmark content anonymously and control their own visibility, with consent changes recorded.
needs.bo: Related. Related: EP-24220: networking opt-in/out exposed via account API; no anonymous engagement [MASTER Online Registration §5 User Stories Mapping :5303]

needs.name: Image alt text
needs.what: Add an 'alt text' setting to every picture input in the web builder, and to every picture upload on the platform.
needs.why: Organisers cannot set alt text for images, which they need for accessibility and for when an image fails to load.
needs.outcome: Organisers enter alt text for each image, and visitors and screen readers get the alternate text.
needs.bo: Already built: EP-36256 alt text field per image in the gallery and block settings, rendered in HTML; uploads outside the website builder not covered [MASTER Event Website §5 User Stories Mapping :5960]

needs.name: Localised country list
needs.what: Show the country, state and city lists in the interface language, starting with a German list for the German interface on web and app.
needs.why: For German-language events (DLG, Frankfurter Buchmesse) the country list appears in English, a foreign language for many registrants. Asked by DLG Markets GmbH (T1), Frankfurter Buchmesse GmbH (T1).
needs.outcome: German-speaking registrants pick their country from a list in German.

needs.name: Register button on OTP login
needs.what: Show a 'Registration' button on the OTP login screen, as in the password flow.
needs.why: The text link is easy to miss, creating support requests (Informa Markets (UK) and Informa North America, both T1).
needs.outcome: Users find registration from the OTP login.
needs.bo: Related: one-time password login flow delivered; registration button not covered (EP-11098) [MASTER User Engagement §5 User Stories Mapping :9991] [EP-37352]

needs.name: Search terms in the interactions API
needs.what: Include the search string in search interactions returned by the interactions API for exhibitor, product and other searches.
needs.why: Informa loses insight into what users search for, which it wants for its analytics and to understand intent.
needs.outcome: API consumers analyse what users search for and how often.
needs.bo: Related (EP-14482): Statistics API v2 interactions endpoint, without search strings [MASTER Organiser Analytics §5 User Stories Mapping :2762]

needs.name: Badge print counts export
needs.what: Export badge printing data (kiosk and frontend) per person: name, email, category, unique and total badges printed, timestamps and per-day or date-range filtering, and include print counts in the participant export.
needs.why: Afreximbank, Mercator Media, ACI and Klay have no record of badge prints per person outside the participant list menu, so they cannot check stationery use, order next-day stock, forecast attendance or analyse onsite activity.
needs.outcome: Organisers track badge printing and stationery use during and after the event.

needs.name: Exhibitor-controlled order of profile content
needs.what: Let exhibitors set the order of the items on their public profile, on web and app: team members, products, brands (at least alphabetically) and marketing content, in a custom order or alphabetically.
needs.why: Items show newest first, by ID or in storage order, so exhibitors cannot choose what appears first; asked by Kortrijk Xpo (Busworld, T1), Mercator Media (T2) and IBC.
needs.outcome: Exhibitors decide what visitors see first on their profile.
needs.bo: Related: alphabetical order for the exported brand list, not the profile (EP-1201, via EP-197) [MASTER Transactions & Purchasing §5 User Stories Mapping :4441]

needs.name: Control over registrant-added cities
needs.what: Add an 'Allow to Add Cities in Registration' toggle so organisers decide whether registrants can add new cities, and block emojis in the city field and its 'Add a new city' option.
needs.why: Free city entry creates duplicate values (many variants of London) and emoji entries Rapid News Group had to clean by hand, yet MRO requires adding cities. Asked by Informa North America (T1), Rapid News Group (T2), MRO.
needs.outcome: Each organiser decides whether registrants may add cities, and city data holds only real names.

needs.name: Search indexing control per page
needs.what: Let organisers choose which pages, including system pages such as sessions, floor plan and exhibitors, are indexed by search engines and included in the sitemap (noindex, follow/nofollow).
needs.why: Rapid News Group's TCT and Medtech Innovation show unready system pages in Google results, and Informa Markets (UK) (T1) for Qmed has no way to keep pages out of search results.
needs.outcome: Organisers hide pages from search until they are ready, and unready pages stop appearing in Google.
needs.bo: Partially built: EP-104 robots.txt editor exists; per-page sitemap exclusion of system pages is not documented [MASTER Event Website §5 User Stories Mapping :5991]; Related: EP-105 per-page SEO controls for system pages [MASTER Event Website §5 User Stories Mapping :5992]

needs.name: Country-based conditional logic
needs.what: Allow the Country system field to drive conditional logic on registration grids, for one or several countries and grids, in visitor and exhibitor pipelines.
needs.why: Conditional logic works only with participant categories and multiple-choice custom questions; the Asia team needs pipelines configured by country. Asked by Informa Markets (UK) (T1), BeautyIstanbul (Ipekyolu International Exhibitions) (T2), Informa - Asia.
needs.outcome: Registrants see the grids that apply to the country they choose.
needs.bo: Related: ticket visibility by country combined with category (EP-37154) [MASTER Online Registration §5 User Stories Mapping :5319]; Related: conditional logic for the new UI form, in progress (EP-26920) [MASTER Online Registration §5 User Stories Mapping :5317]

needs.name: Session location without the floor plan
needs.what: Allow a free-text (or link) session location on the session page and in import, so sessions no longer need a floor plan location and locations can be imported in bulk.
needs.why: Clients that do not use the native floor plan (Informa, Fairtrade Messe (T2), Rapid News Group (T2), Clarion) are forced to set session locations through it, and Rapid News adds each session location by hand, while exhibitors already have free hall and stand fields.
needs.outcome: Organisers set or import session locations as text without building them on the floor plan.
needs.bo: Unresolved, open question for the PO: EP-19915 (COMPLETE) is titled "Text field for Other location in session import and API" and filed under Session Import, but its intent reads "Custom location text field for exhibitor events in import and API" [MASTER Sessions & Speakers §5 User Stories Mapping :8696]. If it covers sessions, the base of this need exists and the session page display is the extension; if it covers exhibitor events only, nothing built covers it.

needs.name: Countdown block styling
needs.what: Add text size, font, weight and style options and separator dots to the Countdown block.
needs.why: Fairtrade cannot make the timer prominent or on-brand, and Vinexposium (T1) needs custom CSS for options the legacy builder had.
needs.outcome: Organisers style the countdown to their brand.

needs.name: Current events only in "We are exhibiting at"
needs.what: Show only current and future events, or let organisers turn past events off, in the exhibitor profile's "We are exhibiting / participating at" section.
needs.why: Kortrijk Xpo (Busworld, T1) can only hide the whole section or show all events including past ones; Fairtrade Messe (T2) finds this inconsistent with the community page.
needs.outcome: Visitors see only the current events an exhibitor is participating in.

needs.name: Lead report in the user's language
needs.what: Export the lead report and Scanned Me report in the user's language (web platform language, app phone language) for column headers and system and custom field values.
needs.why: The lead file is English only; DLG and its German-speaking exhibitors and Reed France (SITL, SCE) want it in their own language on a fully translated platform.
needs.outcome: Exhibitors receive lead files fully in their own language.
needs.bo: Related (EP-22713): lead download moved to async file generation [MASTER Lead Intelligence §5 User Stories Mapping :12737] via EP-172

needs.name: Meeting restrictions for remote-only participants
needs.what: Keep participants who are not onsite out of onsite meetings: online-only exhibitors and their reps request online meetings only, and a participant category option blocks meetings on chosen event days.
needs.why: Informa's Smart Events team has online-only exhibitors that nothing distinguishes when meetings are requested, and InsureTech (Clarion) has an @Home audience with networking access that should not have meetings on event days.
needs.outcome: Remote-only participants cannot book or be booked for onsite meetings.
needs.bo: Related. Related: EP-1104: separate allowed time windows for online and offline meetings, not restriction by exhibitor type [MASTER Meetings & Matchmaking §5 User Stories Mapping :7871]

needs.name: Organiser-fed per-exhibitor external link
needs.what: Give each exhibitor its own external URL, set by the organiser via API or import and not editable by the exhibitor, shown on the exhibitor profile as a clickable link or as a menu item such as "My orders".
needs.why: Organisers need to send each exhibitor to its own ticketing, registration or orders portal but have no field for it, so links are sent by hand; asked by Tier 1 Tampere Trade Fairs (orders link via Salesforce) and HINTE.
needs.outcome: Each exhibitor opens its own external portal or orders link from its EP profile, set in bulk by the organiser.

needs.name: Clearer reschedule notification text
needs.what: Change the reschedule meeting notification text: drop the time and say the other person has confirmed another meeting at the same time and ask to reschedule.
needs.why: BolognaFiere (Cosmoprof): users cannot tell whether the time shown is theirs or the one requested. Tier 1: Informa North America.
needs.outcome: Users understand why they are asked to reschedule.

needs.name: Custom questions on brands
needs.what: Let organisers add custom questions to brands, shown on the frontend brand page, in the same way as for products.
needs.why: Cosmoprof wants this for its 2025 event so users can learn more about brand offerings before the show; custom questions cannot be added to brands today.
needs.outcome: Visitors see brand-specific custom question answers on each brand page.
needs.bo: Related: brand page exists on the website; no custom questions (EP-37488, via EP-22705) [MASTER Event Website §5 User Stories Mapping :5974]

needs.name: Dual SSO and standard login
needs.what: Offer both 'Sign in with SSO' and 'Sign in with Email & Password' on the app sign-in, configured in App Builder.
needs.why: API-created team members cannot log in when only SAML is offered; needed for BolognaFiere (T2) and Informa North America (T1).
needs.outcome: Buyers and team members each log in on their own flow.
needs.bo: Related: SAML sign-in pop-up option; no choice between SAML and standard login (EP-9444) [MASTER Integrations §5 User Stories Mapping :16007] [EP-49228]

needs.name: Live meeting counter on the buyer dashboard
needs.what: Change the dashboard meeting chart to show live values: increase the counter when a meeting is booked and decrease it when it is cancelled.
needs.why: BolognaFiere / Informa North America: the chart only adds up, so cancelled meetings that auto-expire after 120 hours still count and the dashboard does not match the meeting export.
needs.outcome: The dashboard meeting counts match the current state of meetings.

needs.name: Longer recommendation headline fields
needs.what: Increase the character limits of the Headline (by about 5) and sub-title (by about 10) fields in the Recommendations section, as far as the layout allows.
needs.why: DLG and HINTE find German translations do not fit the current limits, leaving content untranslatable on a platform marketed as multilingual.
needs.outcome: German headlines and sub-titles for recommendations fit fully and remain readable.

needs.name: OpenID Connect SSO
needs.what: Support SSO integrations over the OpenID Connect protocol alongside SAML.

needs.outcome: Users registered on a third-party platform log in to ExpoPlatform through the client's OpenID Connect provider.
needs.bo: Related (EP-9444): SAML SSO improvement, not OpenID Connect [MASTER Integrations §5 User Stories Mapping :16007]; Related (EP-1947): a client-specific SSO integration [MASTER Integrations §5 User Stories Mapping :16006]

needs.name: Required fields enforced on profile save

needs.outcome: Users cannot save a profile with missing required fields and see what is missing.

needs.name: Selective event cloning options
needs.what: Add checkboxes to the clone pop-up so organisers choose whether sponsors, news, sessions, local categories and the floor plan are copied, as for exhibitors and products.

needs.outcome: Organisers clone an event with only the content they select.

needs.name: Viewed label off speaker faces
needs.what: Move the "viewed" label on speaker and moderator photos above or below the photo so it does not cover the face.
needs.why: The label sits on the person's forehead in the photo; raised for DLG and HINTE.
needs.outcome: Speaker and moderator photos are shown with the face fully visible and the viewed label beside it.

needs.name: WhatsApp and SMS notification channels
needs.what: Add WhatsApp and SMS as communication channels: an admin module with connection status, templates and texts, consent at registration, and sending of registration confirmations, badges, campaigns, meeting notifications, session reminders and admin push notifications over them, with usage and open statistics.

needs.outcome: Attendees receive key event communications on WhatsApp or SMS when email or the app does not reach them.

needs.why: Attendees cannot find sessions or speakers from one search bar because home page search mostly finds exhibitors; raised by Informa (Informa North America, T1) for Premiere Anaheim.

needs.name: More sponsor banner inventory per page
needs.what: Raise the number of sponsor banners per page (up to 10 on the Exhibitor List page, up to 50 on the Floorplan page) and show them as a rotating carousel instead of one or two banners that change only on refresh.
needs.why: Organisers cannot show all their sponsors, which limits sponsorship sales and revenue for larger events, and users may not know other banners exist; Saladplate (Informa, T1) raised the carousel.
needs.outcome: Every sold banner gets a visible slot on the page.

needs.name: Clear slot availability in the meeting request
needs.what: Show the other party's blocked and unavailable times on the meeting request calendar up front, with tooltips explaining why items are unavailable, disabled non-fitting slots and an auto-reduced duration when no multi-slot default fits.
needs.why: Requesters only learn about unavailability or overlap when submitting, and do not understand why slots are unavailable; raised by Informa Markets (UK), Informa Asia and Saladplate.
needs.outcome: Requesters pick only free slots and understand why others are unavailable.
