needs.name: IAB standard banner ad units
needs.what: Replace the non-standard banner units with IAB standard sizes (728x90 leaderboard top and bottom, 300x250 MPU in the sidebar) served through Google Tag Manager; a separate story asks to streamline banner sizes.
needs.why: Informa (T1: Qmed, CPHI Worldwide) needs advertisers to reuse existing creative and serve ads across the Informa network; non-standard sizes force bespoke creative.
needs.outcome: Advertisers run their standard creatives on event pages without resizing.

needs.name: Premium lead capture for all authorised scanners
needs.what: Give the premium lead scanning screen (rate, qualify, notes, lead email, products, export) to every exhibitor, team member and visitor category allowed to scan, instead of switching lead capture on team member by team member, and deprecate the per-team-member setting.
needs.why: Lead capture must be enabled per team member or globally by hand for each client, which does not scale and has a misleading name; asked by Informa (Smart Events) and Reed France.
needs.outcome: Everyone allowed to scan gets the full lead capture screen with no per-person setup.
needs.bo: Related (EP-1080): new UI lead capture page with rating and notes for team members [MASTER Lead Intelligence §5 User Stories Mapping :12733] via EP-5330; Already built: Exhibitor Manual → Global Settings → Lead Capture "Enable for all (free)" grants access to all exhibitors and team members [MASTER Lead Intelligence §4 Feature Inventory :12619] via EP-201

needs.name: RFP sending and acceptance limits
needs.what: Let organisers cap how many RFPs a visitor can send per day (the exhibitor-side limit exists), and stop listing a supplier in RFP results once it reaches its acceptance limit, possibly with a pop-up telling buyers the limit is reached.
needs.why: Fake buyers use RFPs to advertise, supplier contracts must be respected, and buyers who send RFPs to suppliers at their limit never get a response; asked by Tier 1 Informa Markets (UK) for Saladplate (Informa Asia).
needs.outcome: Visitors cannot flood suppliers with RFPs and buyers only send RFPs to suppliers who can still accept them.
needs.bo: Partially built (EP-2104): RFP acceptance is limited per exhibitor category; a comment confirms only the visitor limit is missing [MASTER Exhibitor Portal §5 User Stories Mapping :11234]

needs.name: Readable exhibitor interactions dashboard
needs.what: Improve the frontend exhibitor interactions dashboard: total interaction counts at the bottom, more than 5 records by default, category/role under the name, slimmer interaction columns and clearer object titles and labels.
needs.why: Saladplate (Informa Markets UK, T1) sees a tick per user and interaction type but not how many users interacted.
needs.outcome: Exhibitors read their interaction totals at a glance.
needs.bo: Related: refreshed interactions/leads dashboard with new metrics and tabs; these layout changes are not listed (EP-26041, via EP-17786) [MASTER Exhibitor Marketplace §5 User Stories Mapping :12042]

needs.name: Track filter showing sessions across all dates
needs.what: On the new UI sessions page, once a track is selected show every session in that track across all dates, paginated (15 to 20 per page), instead of making users pick each date tab.
needs.why: Users must click through date tabs to see a track's sessions and often do not realise it; the old UI showed them all. Planning Portal calls it critical and tied its renewal to it; Vinexposium (T1) and Clarion also ask.
needs.outcome: Selecting a track lists all of its sessions across the event dates in one paginated view.
needs.bo: Partially built (EP-230, EP-12563): Tracks are already a session filter; showing all dates for a selected track is not covered [MASTER Sessions & Speakers §5 User Stories Mapping :8686]; Related (EP-230, EP-21730): date selector logic on the Schedule page, not the sessions list [MASTER Networking & Interactions §5 User Stories Mapping :6831]; Related (EP-135, EP-12563): tracks added to session filters; date behaviour unchanged [MASTER Sessions & Speakers §5 User Stories Mapping :8686]

needs.name: Block specific users from meeting requests and messages
needs.what: Let a buyer block specific suppliers or visitors from sending them messages or meeting requests, in addition to the existing on/off toggles.
needs.why: Saladplate buyers want to stop contact from particular suppliers. Tier 1: Informa Markets (UK).
needs.outcome: Users stop unwanted contacts from reaching them.

needs.name: Breakout rooms under a webinar
needs.what: Let organisers create several breakout rooms under one main webinar session and push participants into them, as Zoom does.
needs.why: Saladplate wants better group engagement; there is no main room linked to breakout rooms.
needs.outcome: Participants move from a main webinar into smaller breakout groups.

needs.name: Buyer-hosted sourcing summits
needs.what: Let a big buyer set up a time-boxed buyer day or summit within the hosted buyer programme, invite suppliers by email to sign up, and let suppliers book product introduction sessions with the buyer.
needs.why: Saladplate (Informa Markets (UK), T1; Informa Asia) wants targeted buyer-supplier summits like RangeMe and WABEL run, and a way to charge suppliers to join; the product team asks what gap hosted buyers or table meetings leave.
needs.outcome: Suppliers sign up to a buyer's summit and book sessions with that buyer.

needs.name: Buyer-supplier enquiry chatbot
needs.what: Add a structured buyer-to-supplier chat with organiser-fed questions, so a buyer's enquiry gets answers when the supplier is offline.
needs.why: Saladplate does not want buyer queries left unattended when suppliers are not online; the product team rates the value as low for a large estimate. Tier 1: Informa Markets (UK).
needs.outcome: Buyers get structured answers to enquiries while suppliers are away.
needs.bo: Related. Related: EP-1107: chat-bot widget for the new UI [MASTER Networking & Interactions §5 User Stories Mapping :6848]

needs.name: Curated custom listing of suppliers and products
needs.what: Build a custom listing page of suppliers and products controlled by organiser filters, so buyers see only relevant items; the detailed brief is attached, not in the text.
needs.why: Saladplate wants to cut irrelevant suppliers and products from buyers' results; it is one of the client's top priorities.
needs.outcome: Buyers browse a curated listing without irrelevant items.
needs.bo: Related: 'Custom Listing' table view with selected registration fields, not a filtered curated page (EP-12725, via EP-6808) [MASTER Exhibitor Marketplace §5 User Stories Mapping :12034]

needs.name: Exhibitor import partial updates and column mapping
needs.what: Allow exhibitor imports with the ID plus only the changed columns, unify column names between export and import templates (e.g. 'Hall Number' vs 'Hall No.'), and make mapping and error handling robust so one bad column does not stop later columns.
needs.why: Organisers must upload the full template and align many columns by hand, and a wrong column can silently stop updates; seen at IMEX (T1), K5 and VDI.
needs.outcome: Organisers bulk-update only the exhibitor fields they need, with clear mapping and errors.

needs.name: Help/Support button in the online meeting room
needs.what: Add a Help/Support button in the online meeting room that connects users to the organiser's customer support, as already exists in sessions.
needs.why: Saladplate users cannot reach support from within a meeting when they hit a technical problem. Tier 1: Informa Markets (UK).
needs.outcome: Users in a meeting get help without leaving the room.

needs.name: Open product pages in a new tab
needs.what: Allow right-click / open in new tab on product cards to open the product detail page.
needs.why: Saladplate users have to click back after each product, which is cumbersome with many products.
needs.outcome: Users open several products in tabs while keeping their list.

needs.name: Real date values in exports

needs.why: Saladplate (Informa Markets (UK), T1; Informa Asia) cannot filter exported reports by date because dates come out as text.
needs.outcome: Organisers filter exported reports by date in Excel.

needs.name: US English language variant

needs.outcome: US events show US spellings without CSS work.

needs.name: Messenger revamp

needs.outcome: App users chat in a modern, clear messenger.

needs.name: Non-destructive exhibitor manual edits

needs.bo: Partially built. needs.name: Configurable user profile menu

needs.outcome: Organisers shape the logged-in navigation to their event's terms and priorities, and users find all relevant modules, including external ones, in their profile menu.

needs.outcome: Users navigate back predictably on both platforms.

needs.outcome: Users find their existing favourites in place at every event they join, as one consistent list.
needs.bo: Related. Related: Favourites exist per event; no cross-event carry-over documented [MASTER Networking & Interactions §4 Feature Inventory :6648]

needs.why: Three rows are not enough for key points, and duplicating the block breaks spacing (IMEX (T1)).
needs.outcome: Organisers list as many points as they need in one block.

needs.name: Toggle for the same time and location warning
needs.what: Add a toggle under session config so organisers can switch off the warning shown when a session or exhibitor event is created with the same time and location as another, in backend and frontend.
needs.why: The warning is always on and confuses Frankfurter Buchmesse (T1) exhibitors who deliberately run several events at once, causing support queries.
needs.outcome: Organisers decide whether same-time, same-location warnings appear.

needs.name: Transport ticket PDF in the app
needs.what: Add a category-gated menu item that opens a public transport ticket PDF attached to the account through the API, with a placeholder and settings.
needs.why: IMEX (T1) Ops wants to give IMEX Frankfurt 2027 attendees transport tickets digitally.
needs.outcome: Attendees carry their transport ticket in the app.
needs.bo: Related: Aditus custom badge page is the menu pattern to reuse; no PDF ticket (EP-25790) [MASTER Mobile App §5 User Stories Mapping :10651] [EP-56134]

needs.name: Type and host on session detail cards
needs.what: Show the session Type on the detail card of sessions and exhibitor events, and the exhibitor host on exhibitor event detail cards, as in the list view; optionally an organiser on regular sessions.
needs.why: Frankfurter Buchmesse (T1) attendees cannot see type or host on the detail card, so organisers add it to descriptions by hand or misuse sponsors, which blocks real sponsors; wanted before end of summer 2026.
needs.outcome: Detail cards show the same type and host information as the list.

needs.name: 12-hour time format for meeting slots
needs.what: Add an event setting that shows meeting request time slots in 12-hour format with AM/PM (e.g. 02:00pm instead of 02:00).
needs.why: US participants commonly use the 12-hour format, and slot times without AM/PM (e.g. 02:00 - 02:30) read as morning times even when they are afternoon, which is confusing (IMEX).
needs.outcome: US participants read meeting slot times unambiguously when requesting meetings.

needs.name: Adjustable floor plan search panel width
needs.what: Make the width of the floor plan search results window adjustable so long exhibitor and session names are not cut off.
needs.why: German compound names are truncated in the fixed-width panel, so attendees cannot tell results apart and DLG (Agritechnica) overrides it with custom CSS.
needs.outcome: Attendees read full names in floor plan search results.
needs.bo: Related (EP-919): new floor plan UI; fixed panel width [MASTER Floor Plan §5 User Stories Mapping :13638] via FIS-1865416811

needs.name: Admin list view for regular meetings
needs.what: Add an admin list view for regular meetings (stand, other location, online) like the table meetings list, with batch send agenda, export, filters, search by meeting ID or participant, and "mark as completed" when both parties scan, without a time constraint.
needs.why: DWTC has these tools for table meetings (EP-3689) but not for regular meetings. Tier 1: Dubai World Trade Centre DWTC/ DXB Live.
needs.outcome: Organisers manage and track all regular meetings from one list.
needs.bo: Related. Related: EP-15162: DWTC improvement to the manage meeting section [MASTER Meetings & Matchmaking §5 User Stories Mapping :7901]; Related: EP-15159: auto-complete on mutual scan at meeting time; the ask removes the time constraint [MASTER Onsite & Kiosks §5 User Stories Mapping :3780]
cus: Dubai World Trade Centre DWTC/ DXB Live

needs.name: Admin notification in-app popup
needs.what: Add a 'Show as a popup in App' option to admin notifications, with image, text and link.
needs.why: Not stated in the request (Hyve, T1).
needs.outcome: Organisers reach in-app users with a visual popup.
needs.bo: Partially built: Admin Notifications panel exists and sends push; the in-app popup display is new (EP-1085) [MASTER User Engagement §5 User Stories Mapping :9988] [EP-46574]; Related: audience segmentation for admin notifications, not the display format (EP-13566) [MASTER User Engagement §5 User Stories Mapping :9995] [EP-46574]

needs.name: Admin order of exhibitor categories on the frontend
needs.what: Display exhibitor categories on the website and in the app (filters) in the same order as set in the admin panel.
needs.why: The frontend order of exhibitor categories looks random and DLG wants control over it.
needs.outcome: Visitors see exhibitor categories in the organiser's chosen order on web and app.
needs.bo: Related: fixed order of product, news and event categories on web and app; not exhibitor categories (EP-24228, via EP-34407) [MASTER Exhibitor Marketplace §5 User Stories Mapping :12041]

needs.name: Admin rescheduling of past meetings
needs.what: Allow admins to reschedule meetings whose time has passed from Manage Meetings (Management → participants/exhibitors); the rescheduled meeting is confirmed when auto-confirm is on, stays pending if it was pending, and returns to pending for the other party if it had been confirmed.
needs.why: During DWTC show days (e.g. GITEX) a party is often late or cannot attend, and concierges would rather move the existing meeting than create a new one. Tier 1: Dubai World Trade Centre DWTC/ DXB Live.
needs.outcome: Concierges move a missed meeting to a new time during the show, with its status handled by clear rules.
needs.bo: Related. Related: EP-15162: DWTC improvements to the admin Manage Meetings section; rescheduling past meetings is not covered [MASTER Meetings & Matchmaking §5 User Stories Mapping :7901]
cus: Dubai World Trade Centre DWTC/ DXB Live

needs.name: Admin schedule download as PDF
needs.what: Let admins download a user's schedule as PDF from the Admin Panel in addition to the Excel format.
needs.why: IMEX: when Excel is chosen, the Admin Panel only offers Excel, so staff on site need five or six clicks through Customer Service login on the frontend to get a PDF some clients prefer.
needs.outcome: Admins export a user's schedule as PDF or Excel directly from the Admin Panel.
needs.bo: Related (EP-23040, EP-20775): My Schedule download in XLS (and PDF) on the frontend; admin PDF is not covered [MASTER Sessions & Speakers §5 User Stories Mapping :8700]

needs.name: All exhibitor events on the exhibitor page
needs.what: Show all of an exhibitor's events on the app exhibitor page, not only those with a team member as speaker.
needs.why: Attendees see a different list than on web (Frankfurter Buchmesse, T1).
needs.outcome: The app lists the same events as web.
needs.bo: Related: exhibitor events public list in apps via widget (EP-14310) [MASTER Exhibitor Portal §5 User Stories Mapping :11277] [FIS-1873575985]; Related: My Exhibitor Events page in the app (EP-14321) [MASTER Sessions & Speakers §5 User Stories Mapping :8689] [FIS-1873575985]

needs.name: Allow active products parameter in the exhibitor API
needs.what: Add a boolean allow_active_products parameter to /api/v2/exhibitor/set that sets the "allow active products" option in exhibitor settings → content.
needs.why: DLG Markets' integration needs to control, per exhibitor, whether products can be active (some exhibitors in a product-allowed category must not), and today this is only possible in the admin panel.
needs.outcome: The integration sets each exhibitor's active-products permission automatically, and the admin panel shows the value.
needs.bo: Related (EP-10479): admin setting that blocks active products; the API parameter is the ask [MASTER Exhibitor Marketplace §5 User Stories Mapping :12031]; Related (EP-26427): product status parameter in the product API [MASTER Exhibitor Marketplace §5 User Stories Mapping :12043]

needs.name: App support for non-GMS Android devices
needs.what: Make the Android app, including push notifications, work on devices without Google Play Services (Huawei).
needs.why: DWTC (T1) and the Asian customer base use such devices, where the app does not function.
needs.outcome: The app works on Huawei and other non-GMS devices.
needs.bo: Related: open-source scanner for non-GMS devices; the rest of the app is not covered (EP-15213) [MASTER Onsite & Kiosks §5 User Stories Mapping :3781] [EP-16000]
cus: Dubai World Trade Centre DWTC/ DXB Live

needs.name: Attend a Stand report
needs.what: Add an Attend a Stand export under Admin panel > Data > Import/Export > Export with one row per request, the specified columns, all exhibitor stands as hall_name: stand_name, and the request creation timestamp.
needs.why: Hyve needs the Attend a Stand requests as a report; the work was planned for an earlier event and postponed.
needs.outcome: Organisers can download every Attend a Stand request with stand and timestamp details.

needs.name: Attendance limits by exhibitor event type
needs.what: Add an "Attendance limit" setting per exhibitor event type (default "set by Exhibitor", or a fixed limit that presets and locks the exhibitor's input), and show remaining places on exhibitor event cards and pages on web and app, disabling Book when full.
needs.why: IMEX's sales team sets booking limits on every exhibitor event by hand, which is time consuming and leads to wrong limits; exhibitors want to cap attendance to keep engagement quality.
needs.outcome: Limits are set once per event type, exhibitors see them applied, and attendees see how many places are left and cannot book a full event.
needs.bo: Partially built (EP-23527, EP-11664): global event limits and max attendees exist for exhibitor events; type-level preset and availability display are not covered [MASTER Exhibitor Portal §5 User Stories Mapping :11263]

needs.name: Audible check-in confirmation
needs.what: Play an audible signal on the scanning device when a check-in is accepted.
needs.why: Requested by Kortrijk Xpo.
needs.outcome: Staff hear confirmation of each accepted check-in without looking at the screen.

needs.name: Auto-collapse route drawer on mobile web
needs.what: Collapse the route guidance drawer automatically on mobile web after a route is plotted, so the map and route are visible.
needs.why: The expanded drawer covers the map and cannot be collapsed, making wayfinding unusable on mobile web; reported for Frankfurter Buchmesse (EP-57159).
needs.outcome: Attendees on mobile web see and follow the plotted route.
needs.bo: Related (EP-24164): route drawer redesigned; mobile-web collapse not covered [MASTER Floor Plan §5 User Stories Mapping :13652] via FIS-2133229571; Related (EP-10344): wayfinding improvement v1 [MASTER Exhibitor Portal §5 User Stories Mapping :11257] via FIS-2133229571

needs.name: Automated anomaly detection and engagement rate-limiting
needs.what: Detect anomalous attendee engagement automatically and rate-limit it, e.g. very high favouriting volumes that sweep the directory.
needs.why: One IMEX account favourited 5,611 users (peak 50 per minute), skewing analytics and risking attendees sharing details with a scammer; staff spot it in Grafana and detach the attendee by hand (IMP-300).
needs.outcome: Harvesting-style activity is limited automatically and event data stays trustworthy.

needs.name: Automatic floor plan from DXF and XML
needs.what: Generate the floor plan automatically: read outer hall walls from the DXF and booths and exhibitors from the XML, build an SVG with exhibitor logos and a clickable grid per booth, and refresh it when new XML is uploaded or exhibitors upload logos.
needs.why: DLG wants a hall plan like the Agritechnica exhibitor database; no problem statement is given.
needs.outcome: Visitors see an up-to-date hall plan with logos and clickable booths, without manual redrawing.
needs.bo: Partially built (EP-10210): DXF import for interactive stand shapes exists; XML booth mapping, logos and auto-refresh are the extension [MASTER Exhibitor Portal §5 User Stories Mapping :11255] via EP-14320

needs.name: Backend notes in the visitor export
needs.what: Include the backend notes on a visitor profile in the visitor Excel export.
needs.why: Vinexposium (T1) organisers note follow-up calls on visitor profiles for Wine Paris and Vinexpo Paris, but the notes are missing from the export.
needs.outcome: Organisers follow up from the export with the notes included.
needs.bo: Partially built: EP-12516: partially built (EP-11592), notes are in the exhibitor export; the visitor export is asked [MASTER Exhibitor Portal §5 User Stories Mapping :11262]

needs.name: Badge in digital wallets
needs.what: Let attendees add their badge to iOS and Android digital wallets.
needs.why: Requested for Informa Markets (UK) (T1); no reason is stated.
needs.outcome: Attendees carry their badge in the phone wallet.

needs.name: Blocked timeslot location in the Meeting Wizard
needs.what: In the Meeting Wizard, show on hover over a user's blocked timeslot the reason and the location of the blocking activity (hall/stand, exhibitor stand, "Other" location or zone), as the frontend already shows reasons.
needs.why: DWTC concierges cannot see where a user's blocking activity takes place, and GITEX venues are far apart, so they must open profiles or contact users and risk booking back-to-back meetings at distant venues. Tier 1: Dubai World Trade Centre DWTC/ DXB Live.
needs.outcome: Concierges see where a user is before and after a slot and book meetings at a reachable location.
needs.bo: Related. Related: EP-252: Meeting Wizard exists; blocked-slot reasons and locations are the ask [MASTER Meetings & Matchmaking §5 User Stories Mapping :7866]
cus: Dubai World Trade Centre DWTC/ DXB Live

needs.name: Branded downloadable documents
needs.what: Apply the event's Brand 1 and Brand 2 colours to documents users download from the platform, such as the schedule sent by email and the marketplace exhibitor list.
needs.why: The design of downloadable documents is not tied to the organiser's branding. Asked by Frankfurter Buchmesse GmbH (T1).
needs.outcome: Documents users download carry only the event's brand colours.

needs.name: Breadcrumbs on custom pages
needs.what: Show a breadcrumb trail on website custom pages in the same format as on system pages such as the exhibitor page.
needs.why: System pages have breadcrumbs but custom pages do not, so navigation on Vinexposium's website is inconsistent.
needs.outcome: Visitors see a breadcrumb trail on custom pages and can navigate back up the site as on system pages.
needs.bo: Related: EP-37490 breadcrumbs are kept on migrated system pages such as events; custom pages not covered [MASTER Event Website §5 User Stories Mapping :5976]

needs.name: Bulk download of exhibitor logos
needs.what: Add a "Download all logos" action on the admin exhibitors list or in Data > Import/Export that builds a ZIP of all exhibitor logos, named {exhibitorName}_{exhibitorId}, asynchronously with an email link, optionally filtered and with a CSV manifest.
needs.why: Logos can only be downloaded one by one from each exhibitor profile, which takes hours for events with hundreds of exhibitors; a comment records a request from Hyve for the Shoptalk event programme (another comment says the ticket was a test).
needs.outcome: Organisers download every exhibitor logo in one ZIP for programmes, signage and marketing.
needs.bo: Related: tabular exports only; no binary logo export (KB feature: Data Export, via EP-52240) [MASTER Admin / Platform Core §4 Feature Inventory :1313]

needs.name: Bulk removal of external QR codes
needs.what: Let organisers bulk-remove all external QR codes for an event themselves.
needs.why: Reusing external QR strings across events mixes up data, and cleaning them today needs a developer database operation that is no longer acceptable; raised for IMEX Frankfurt and IMEX America 2026. Comments ask where the codes and the button live in the admin panel.
needs.outcome: Organisers clear an event's external QR codes without developer help.
needs.bo: Related (EP-10400): history of external QR codes is stored; no bulk removal [MASTER Onsite & Kiosks §5 User Stories Mapping :3768] via FIS-1763672070

needs.name: Button alignment
needs.what: Add left, centre and right alignment to the button settings of every new website builder module that has buttons.
needs.why: Vinexposium organisers cannot centre or align buttons and must rely on front-end developers.
needs.outcome: Organisers align buttons themselves in any module.

needs.name: Buyer category in the get account API
needs.what: Add a parameter with the buyer category name to the get account API.
needs.why: Vinexposium segments its data in Zoho through an existing integration; the buyer category is only in the admin Visitors/Buyers export, so it must be handled manually.
needs.outcome: Integrations receive each account's buyer category through the API.
needs.bo: Partially built (EP-14474): accounts API v2 endpoints exist; buyer category is not documented as a returned field [MASTER Integrations §5 User Stories Mapping :16008]

needs.name: CIDAAS login integration
needs.what: Add a CIDAAS login integration, with admin settings, so that when it is enabled users log in on web and app through CIDAAS instead of the native login, as was done for Reach5.
needs.why: DLG uses CIDAAS as its central authentication provider and wants all external services to be reached only through it.
needs.outcome: DLG users log in to the platform with their CIDAAS credentials on web and app.
needs.bo: Related (EP-36147): Reach5 SSO for exhibitor authentication; same pattern, different provider [MASTER Exhibitor Portal §5 User Stories Mapping :11300]; Related (EP-1947): native SSO for Informa's IIRIS identity platform [MASTER Integrations §5 User Stories Mapping :16006]

needs.name: CPD credit tracking
needs.what: Support CPD; the request contains only a link to a Lucidchart diagram.
needs.why: Not stated in the request.
needs.outcome: Not stated in the request.

needs.name: Card border and shadow
needs.what: Add border and shadow options for the whole static card component in the website builder, not just the card image, matching what carousel cards offer.
needs.why: IMEX cannot give static cards a border or shadow through the UI, unlike carousel cards, so pages look inconsistent unless custom CSS or ExpoPlatform help is used.
needs.outcome: Static and carousel cards can be styled consistently from the builder.
needs.bo: Related: EP-12606 static content block library delivered; full-card border/shadow not documented [MASTER Event Website §5 User Stories Mapping :5931]

needs.name: Category auto-assigned from answers
needs.what: Extend registration pipeline conditional logic (visitor and exhibitor) so a specific answer to a question, e.g. "main activity" = importer, automatically sets the participant category (e.g. buyer) while the category field stays hidden.
needs.why: Vinexpo India can only show or hide the category field by condition, so records get the default category and must be updated by hand. Asked by Vinexposium (T1).
needs.outcome: Registrants get the right category from their answers, and their e-badge shows it, with no manual updates.
needs.bo: Related: default category auto-assigned when none is selected; answer-based assignment is the ask (EP-14938) [MASTER Online Registration §5 User Stories Mapping :5298]

needs.name: Category titles in the exhibitor registration form
needs.what: Show the activity category titles in the exhibitor registration form, as they appear in exhibitor profiles.
needs.why: Vinexposium (Vinexpo Explorer Quebec): registering through the exhibitor registration link shows activity categories without their titles, and registration was about to open.
needs.outcome: Exhibitors registering see titled activity categories.

needs.name: Category tree in the profile preview
needs.what: Show the Categories section of the frontend profile preview as a tree reflecting the backend hierarchy (indentation, optional expand/collapse, styling) instead of a flat list.
needs.why: DLG Markets' events use complex category trees, and in a flat list parent and child categories appear far apart, so relationships are unclear.
needs.outcome: Viewers understand a profile's main categories and sub-categories at a glance.

needs.name: City search and add on the payment step
needs.what: On the payment step, when a company is the payer, remove the "null" region shown for a city newly added during registration (show the city only or require the region), and add search and the ability to add a city to the city box, as in registration.
needs.why: DLG: the payer address can differ from the registration address, but the city list can only be scrolled, new cities cannot be added, and new cities show a "null" region.
needs.outcome: Payers enter or find their city on the payment step without errors.
needs.bo: Related (EP-9415): state/region and city added to custom select fields; payment step not covered [MASTER Exhibitor Portal §5 User Stories Mapping :11250]

needs.name: Clear banner aspect ratio format
needs.what: Show banner image aspect ratios in Exhibitor Portal → Sponsorships → Banner Upload as a ratio (e.g. "7.2:1", optionally "36:5") instead of a single number, wherever banner specifications appear.
needs.why: Frankfurter Buchmesse says "Image aspect ratio 7.2" is unclear to exhibitors and designers preparing sponsored banners.
needs.outcome: Exhibitors understand the required banner proportions and upload correctly sized graphics.

needs.name: Clear image format guidance on uploads
needs.what: Change the "Add Picture" hint on exhibitor profile, product, brand and exhibitor event uploads (web and app) to recommend PNG for best colour while listing JPG and JPEG, with an optional tooltip.
needs.why: DLG Markets exhibitors reported colour discrepancies in logos and session images and do not know which format keeps colours accurate.
needs.outcome: Exhibitors pick PNG when uploading, and fewer images show colour problems.

needs.name: Clickable links in custom text fields
needs.what: Render URLs entered in custom text fields on the exhibitor profile as clickable links.
needs.why: URLs in custom text fields show as plain text, so visitors copy and paste them, which organisers and exhibitors find unfriendly; seen at a Tampere Messut event.
needs.outcome: Visitors open file and web links from the exhibitor profile with one click.
needs.bo: Related: rich text editor with link support for the exhibitor profile; custom text fields not covered (EP-13852, via FIS-1537114189) [MASTER Exhibitor Portal §5 User Stories Mapping :11272]

needs.name: Clone and edit admin notifications
needs.what: Let admins clone an already sent admin notification (content, recipient groups, send time) to reuse it, and edit or reschedule notifications that are still scheduled.
needs.why: A sent notification cannot be changed or reused, so admins at DWTC recreate it from scratch to update information or timing, which duplicates effort. Tier 1 customers asking: Dubai World Trade Centre DWTC/ DXB Live.
needs.outcome: An admin reuses a sent notification as the starting point for a new one without retyping it.
needs.bo: Partially built (KB feature: Scheduled Push Notifications): scheduled notifications can already be edited or cancelled; cloning a sent one is not documented [MASTER User Engagement §4 Feature Inventory :9904] via EP-45248
cus: Dubai World Trade Centre DWTC/ DXB Live

needs.name: Colour picker for session tracks
needs.what: Replace the predefined colour set for session tracks with a colour picker that accepts any colour via hex, RGB or a visual spectrum.
needs.why: Track colours are limited to a predefined palette, so Frankfurter Buchmesse and other organisers cannot match their brand colours.
needs.outcome: Organisers give each track an exact brand colour, and tracks show that colour on session cards.

needs.name: Community group activity notifications
needs.what: Add an admin setting that sends notifications to members of a community group when someone posts in the group (and when someone reacts to their post), only to users who joined that group.
needs.why: Community groups send no notifications today, so members do not know about new posts or reactions and Busworld expects engagement to stay very low.
needs.outcome: Group members are notified of new activity in the groups they joined and come back to engage.
needs.bo: Related (EP-14681): group chats and messaging in community groups; no post notifications [MASTER Community §5 User Stories Mapping :9295]

needs.name: Community page group block design
needs.what: Redesign the group block on the community page to match the session blocks: larger logos, full group names without truncation, and a slider with the newest groups first.
needs.why: Frankfurter Buchmesse users find the group block small, compact and inconsistent with other blocks, and long group names are cut off.
needs.outcome: Users see groups clearly on the community page in the same style as session blocks.
needs.bo: Related (EP-37489): community page exists; the group block design is the ask [MASTER Event Website §5 User Stories Mapping :5975]

needs.name: Component internal names
needs.what: Add a 'Component Name' identifier field at the end of the General tab of every component in the new Website Builder (creating a General tab where missing), defaulting to the block's system name, editable, shown to admins on hover in the block's top-right corner and never shown on the frontend.
needs.why: The client (IMEX) wants internal names on components so they can tell which components should be live or hidden at each stage of the show cycle without manual tracking.
needs.outcome: Admins see their own name for each builder component on hover and can plan which components to show or hide per show phase.

needs.name: Concierge notifications on meeting changes
needs.what: Add two Meeting Wizard email templates, "Admin Notify Reschedule" and "Admin Notify Cancellation", sent to the backend admin (concierge) who created a meeting when an end user reschedules or cancels it, with variables for both parties' contacts, subject, location, time, date, reason, message and a link to the Manage Meetings list.
needs.why: DWTC concierges who arrange table or regular meetings from the backend have no way to be notified when end users reschedule or cancel them, so they cannot track changes. Tier 1: Dubai World Trade Centre DWTC/ DXB Live.
needs.outcome: The concierge who created a meeting gets an email with full details whenever an end user reschedules or cancels it.
needs.bo: Related. Related: EP-12571: custom concierge meeting confirmation template for DWTC; admin notifications on changes are new [MASTER Meetings & Matchmaking §5 User Stories Mapping :7895]
cus: Dubai World Trade Centre DWTC/ DXB Live

needs.name: Confidentiality wording in autologin emails
needs.what: Add default wording to the footer of emails that contain autologin links saying the content is confidential and must not be shared.
needs.why: At Vinexposium an exhibitor used a buyer's autologin link to view the buyer's messages and meetings, showing that human error can expose accounts.
needs.outcome: Recipients of autologin emails are warned not to forward them.

needs.name: Consent gate for embedded session videos
needs.what: Block iframe embeds in livestream and on-demand sessions and exhibitor events behind a consent banner until consent is given, on the session or exhibitor event page and in list and card views, or on the pre-entrance page, as done for exhibitor profile videos (EP-32016).
needs.why: Consent must cover all end-user and exhibitor input where iframes are available, and online session embeds are not covered (Frankfurter Buchmesse).
needs.outcome: Session video embeds load only after the viewer gives consent.

needs.name: Consent gate for product iframe videos
needs.what: Block iframe videos that exhibitors add to products behind a consent banner on the product page until consent is given, the same way as for exhibitor profile videos (EP-32016).
needs.why: Consent must cover every part of the platform where iframes can be embedded, and product videos are not covered yet (Frankfurter Buchmesse).
needs.outcome: Product videos load only after the visitor gives consent.

needs.name: Consistent currency format with cents
needs.what: Always display money amounts with cents during the registration payment process.
needs.why: DLG: amounts are shown sometimes with and sometimes without cents, which confuses users; their accounting department requires cents.
needs.outcome: All amounts in the payment flow show a consistent format with cents.

needs.name: Continent filter in hosted buyer admin
needs.what: Add a Continent field for buyers in Hosted Buyer > Buyers, filled via the API, and make it a filter there.
needs.why: CosmoProf (Informa North America, T1) wants to filter buyers by continent in the backend and asked for effort and cost.
needs.outcome: Organisers filter the buyer list by continent.
needs.bo: Partially built: EP-110: partially built (EP-66), buyer admin filters by any custom registration question field [MASTER Hosted Buyer Management §5 User Stories Mapping :15023]; EP-110: partially built, Buyers Management "+ Add filter fields" includes registration form fields [MASTER Hosted Buyer Management §4 Feature Inventory :14983]

needs.name: Cookie consent banner in the app
needs.what: Let organisers add and manage a custom cookie consent banner in the app via the Didomi SDK.
needs.why: Vinexposium (T1) needs cookie compliance in its app.
needs.outcome: The app meets cookie consent rules.
needs.bo: Related: cookie consent banners are documented for the event website only, not the app (KB feature: Third-Party Cookie Consent Compliance) [MASTER Event Website §4 Feature Inventory :5912] [EP-44925]

needs.name: Copy email templates with all languages
needs.what: When copying an email template from another event, copy all its language versions, not only English.
needs.why: Kortrijk Xpo (Busworld) says re-creating the other languages takes extra time.
needs.outcome: Copied templates arrive with all their languages.

needs.name: Copy table meeting details
needs.what: Add a copy button to each row of Networking & Matchmaking → Meetings → Table Meetings List that copies the meeting as text: created by, day and time, zone and table, and meeting parties.
needs.why: DWTC organisers copy meeting details by hand or via export to share them externally. Tier 1: Dubai World Trade Centre DWTC/ DXB Live.
needs.outcome: Organisers copy a table meeting's key details in one click and paste them anywhere.
needs.bo: Related. Related: EP-252: Meeting Wizard and table meetings exist; the copy action is the ask [MASTER Meetings & Matchmaking §5 User Stories Mapping :7866]
cus: Dubai World Trade Centre DWTC/ DXB Live

needs.name: Country code on the team member phone field
needs.what: Add a country code dropdown, covering all standard country codes, to the telephone field when adding a team member.
needs.why: The team member phone field has no way to choose a country prefix; Busworld wants the phone data to be more intuitive.
needs.outcome: Exhibitors enter team member phone numbers with the correct international prefix.

needs.name: Custom category filters for sessions and exhibitor events
needs.what: Make the custom filters created under Networking & Matchmaking → Categories available for Exhibitor Events and Sessions: in their Display Filter settings in the admin panel, on the exhibitor events and sessions list pages, and in the app session filter instead of Product category; the requester also suggests News.
needs.why: Frankfurter Buchmesse broke its activity and interest categories into custom filters, but they only work on exhibitor and visitor pages, so filtering is inconsistent across the platform.
needs.outcome: Attendees filter sessions and exhibitor events by the same custom filters used for exhibitors and visitors, on web and app.
needs.bo: Related. Related: EP-12365: session-specific filter fields, not the shared custom category filters [MASTER Sessions & Speakers §5 User Stories Mapping :8685]; Related: EP-27888: networking filters for attendee and exhibitor lists [MASTER Exhibitor Marketplace §5 User Stories Mapping :12045]

needs.name: Custom form responses export
needs.what: Include the submitted answers, not just the questions, in the custom form export (Marketing > Forms > Export XLS), including forms attached to exhibitor events.
needs.why: The export holds only questions and there is no other report of responses, so Frankfurter Buchmesse (FBM) organisers cannot analyse answers, follow up leads or meet reporting needs (EP-50735).
needs.outcome: Organisers download every submitted answer to a custom form in bulk.
needs.bo: Related: EP-24373 custom form blocks exist in the builder; response export not covered [MASTER Event Website §5 User Stories Mapping :5957]; Related: EP-26093 organiser questions at exhibitor event submission with answers in admin event details [MASTER Sessions & Speakers §5 User Stories Mapping :8707]

needs.name: Custom icon upload
needs.what: Let organisers upload their own icons (including bulk upload) to the Gallery and pick them from a new menu item in the Icon Card block's icon library.
needs.why: The Icon Card block offers no icon customisation, and organisers want to use their brand icons.
needs.outcome: Organisers use their own brand icons in Icon Card blocks.

needs.name: Custom lead category labels
needs.what: Let organisers change, from the back end, the wording of the lead categories (e.g. potential partner, supplier) that exhibitors pick when scanning leads in the app.
needs.why: Kortrijk Xpo cannot customise these lead category labels today.
needs.outcome: Exhibitors categorise scanned leads with the organiser's own category names.

needs.name: Customisable Share Your Profile section
needs.what: Let organisers customise the 'Share Your Profile' section of the exhibitor dashboard through templates or a design tool, e.g. show or hide team members, change the logo size, and edit text and font.
needs.why: The 'Share Your Profile' feature is static, so Frankfurter Buchmesse cannot adapt it to its branding or its exhibitors' needs.
needs.outcome: Exhibitors share a profile card that matches the event's branding and the organiser's chosen content.

needs.name: Customisable no-product-allowance message
needs.what: Fix the pop-up shown when an exhibitor without product allowance adds a product so it matches the category setting, make it optional or its content customisable, and translate it for multilingual events.
needs.why: Vinexposium (Vinexposium Connect, Wine Paris, Vinexpo Asia): the message contradicts the "do not allow active products" setting and appears in English on French pages, after the organiser invested in localised messages.
needs.outcome: Exhibitors see a correct, organiser-controlled message in their language when they hit the product limit.

needs.name: Customisable no-product-allowance message
needs.what: Let organisers customise the message shown when an exhibitor's package does not allow adding products, ideally with a clickable link or a contact email.
needs.why: Vinexposium wants blocked exhibitors pointed to where they can buy the product option.
needs.outcome: Exhibitors who cannot add products see the organiser's upgrade message and link.
needs.bo: Related: product limits per exhibitor category exist; the message is not configurable (EP-2431, via EP-269) [MASTER Exhibitor Portal §5 User Stories Mapping :11237]

needs.name: Customisable platform tour
needs.what: Let admins hide specific steps of the platform tour pop-up and customise the text of each step.
needs.why: Informa Markets (UK) users are confused by tour steps about sections an event does not use, such as the product tab at the Informa Fashion show, and by wording that does not match the event's terminology.
needs.outcome: Users only see tour steps relevant to their event, worded in the event's own terms.

needs.name: Daily scanned badges email for exhibitors
needs.what: Email exhibitors an automatic daily summary at the end of each event day listing the attendees whose badges they scanned.
needs.why: Exhibitors must trigger the export from the app or web themselves and often forget during the event, delaying follow-up; raised by Vinexposium for Wine Paris 2027.
needs.outcome: Exhibitors receive each day's scanned leads by email without any manual export.
needs.bo: Related (EP-8982): manual Scanned Me download on web; no scheduled digest [MASTER Mobile App §5 User Stories Mapping :10639] via FIS-1952153616

needs.name: Default event-to-app Universal Link mapping
needs.what: Link an event to its mobile app for Universal Links by default in App Builder, including after event cloning, so email deep links open the right app.
needs.why: When organisers forget the manual Universal Links step, meeting and session links open another app, breaking journeys and creating support tickets; raised by DLG Markets (T1).
needs.outcome: Email deep links always open the event's own app.

needs.name: Default meeting info for Meeting Wizard admins
needs.what: Let each Meeting Wizard admin save default meeting info on their own admin account, added automatically to every curated meeting they create at step 1, as the frontend already offers predefined meeting info.
needs.why: DWTC's concierge team, where one person handles many exhibitor startups and investors, wants to reduce the effort of scheduling curated meetings. Tier 1: Dubai World Trade Centre DWTC/ DXB Live.
needs.outcome: Concierges create curated meetings faster because their saved default meeting info is filled in automatically.
needs.bo: Related. Related: EP-252: Meeting Wizard for arranging concierge meetings exists; default info per admin is new [MASTER Meetings & Matchmaking §5 User Stories Mapping :7866]
cus: Dubai World Trade Centre DWTC/ DXB Live

needs.name: Delegate list hidden until search
needs.what: Add a setting so the app Delegates page shows nobody until the user searches or filters.
needs.why: DWTC (T1) does not want the full delegate list visible on open.
needs.outcome: Organisers control delegate list exposure.
cus: Dubai World Trade Centre DWTC/ DXB Live

needs.name: Email template builder gallery, shared header and From Name variable
needs.what: Improve the email template builder: organise the image gallery by the main gallery's folders with newest-first sorting (and optional search), add "Apply to All" for the header image across the event's emails, and support an {{event_name}} variable in the From Name.
needs.why: DLG Markets admins scroll through an unsorted gallery, insert the same header in every email by hand and re-enter the From Name for each event.
needs.outcome: Admins build consistent email templates faster with fewer manual steps.

needs.name: Email template import, export and finalisation status
needs.what: Export all email templates of an event (registration, networking messaging, session and exhibitor manual templates) with name, header image, from name, subject, HTML body and language, import updated templates in bulk, and show a status (edited, default, finalised), optionally with a progress overview.
needs.why: DLG Markets has no simple way to check that every template has been finalised, especially per language, so default unbranded emails can go out.
needs.outcome: Organisers review and finalise all templates in every language from one file and see which still need work.

needs.name: Empty search result state
needs.what: Show 'No result found' instead of a blank page when an app search returns nothing.
needs.why: The app shows a blank page for empty searches on delegate, exhibitor, product and other lists (Informa Markets (UK), T1).
needs.outcome: Users understand that a search found nothing.

needs.name: Event time zone for all export times
needs.what: Show all times inside exported reports, including participant registration (creation) time and profile completed time, in the event location's time zone, formatted YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS with the UTC offset in 24-hour time.
needs.why: Frankfurter Buchmesse sees that export links already follow the event location time (EP-29932), but creation and profile completion times in the files are still GMT, so reporting times are inconsistent.
needs.outcome: Every time in every report is in the event's local time with a consistent format.
needs.bo: Partially built: exports already show the timezone per the event's country setting; creation and completion fields are the gap [MASTER Admin / Platform Core §4 Feature Inventory :1313 Data Export]

needs.name: Excluded timeslots in opt-in speed networking
needs.what: In Opt-in Speed Networking sessions, let a user exclude specific timeslots instead of cancelling participation; no meetings are generated or moved into excluded slots, and meetings already in them are tagged as on an excluded timeslot in the admin panel and frontend.
needs.why: For Hyve: today a user can only cancel participation entirely, even when they can attend part of the session.
needs.outcome: Users join only the timeslots they can attend, the algorithm avoids their excluded slots, and organisers see which existing meetings sit on excluded slots so they can move them.
needs.bo: Related. Related: EP-40448: timeslot blocking exists for Meeting Program participants, not Speed Networking [MASTER Networking & Interactions §5 User Stories Mapping :6855]; Related: EP-8213: pending meeting requests block slots in self-managed meetings [MASTER Meetings & Matchmaking §5 User Stories Mapping :7881]

needs.name: Exhibitor bulk promotional messaging
needs.what: Let exhibitor companies, and admin team members switched to a company profile, send a promotional message as individual 1:1 chats to many users at once, choosing recipients by organiser-defined categories and custom fields, within weekly and total limits set per exhibitor category or individual exhibitor.
needs.why: Exhibitors have no efficient way to reach their most relevant buyers during a show, and organisers such as IMEX see it as an additional monetisation opportunity.
needs.outcome: Exhibitors reach a filtered target audience with one send, and organisers control and can sell the volume through limits.

needs.name: Exhibitor categories carried to the next edition
needs.what: Add an option under Registration settings > Exhibitor > Additional settings to carry an exhibitor's selected categories from one edition of an event to the next.
needs.why: Vinexposium exhibitors returning to the same event (e.g. WPVP 23 to 24, Vinexpo Asia 23 to 24) must re-select all their categories from a very long list each time.
needs.outcome: Returning exhibitors find their categories pre-filled and only update what changed.
needs.bo: Related: global vs local fields define which exhibitor data is shared across events; categories per edition are not covered (KB, via EP-27833) [MASTER Admin / Platform Core §4 Feature Inventory :1329]

needs.name: Exhibitor event attendance from badge scan
needs.what: Extend how users get the Attended mark for exhibitor events: keep check-in app and manual admin marking (on a new Attendees tab), and add attendance when the owning exhibitor scans the badge of a user who has the event in their schedule during the event time plus or minus one hour; external check-ins are marked and locked, manual marks can be undone.
needs.why: Organisers are unlikely to send staff to check in every exhibitor event or give exhibitors the check-in app, so exhibitor event attendance goes unrecorded.
needs.outcome: Exhibitor event attendance is recorded from exhibitors' own badge scans and visible to organisers.
needs.bo: Related (EP-39837, EP-11165): booked and attended session columns exist in the exhibitor sponsor dashboard [MASTER Onsite & Kiosks §5 User Stories Mapping :3770]

needs.name: Exhibitor events export with attendees
needs.what: Add an "Export Event Data" button under Data > Import/Export that produces an XLS of all exhibitor events (name, date, time, location, description, speaker, moderator) with a column of the full names of users who added each event to their schedule.
needs.why: Exhibitors want to track engagement with their events and follow up with the attendees who scheduled them. Tier 1 asking: IMEX.
needs.outcome: Organisers download one file listing every exhibitor event and who scheduled it.
needs.bo: Related (EP-36095): attendee names column exists in the team schedule export [MASTER Sessions & Speakers §5 User Stories Mapping :8711]; Related (EP-24160): exhibitor event date/time is in the leads export [MASTER Lead Intelligence §5 User Stories Mapping :12741]

needs.name: Exhibitor invitee registration tracking
needs.what: Let exhibitors (and the organiser) see whether the visitors they invited to register actually registered.
needs.why: Kortrijk Xpo uses exhibitor invitations heavily but cannot see who registered. Asked by Kortrijk Xpo (Busworld) (T1).
needs.outcome: Exhibitors track which invitees completed registration.
needs.bo: Partially built: statistics for the invited visitors flow (EP-27290) [MASTER Online Registration §5 User Stories Mapping :5318]

needs.name: Exhibitor name on product cards
needs.what: Show the exhibitor name on app product cards, instead of or next to the description.
needs.why: Vinexposium (T1) asked for it before the Vinexposium Connect store release.
needs.outcome: Users see who makes each product in the list.

needs.name: Exhibitor news auto-approval
needs.what: Add an 'Auto-approve the Exhibitor news' toggle in /admin/news/list: when on, exhibitor news is approved and visible on web and app immediately; when off, it waits for organiser approval.
needs.why: Exhibitor news always needs organiser approval, and DLG wants exhibitor news to go live immediately.
needs.outcome: Exhibitor news goes live on submission when the organiser chooses auto-approval.
needs.bo: Related (EP-50740): News MVP service; approval flow unchanged [MASTER Exhibitor Portal §5 User Stories Mapping :11303]

needs.name: Exhibitor news linked to exhibitor and product profiles
needs.what: Link news articles added by an exhibitor to that exhibitor's profile and to the relevant product profiles, so readers can open them from the article.
needs.why: Kortrijk Xpo (Busworld) exhibitors publish news, but readers cannot navigate from an article to the exhibitor or product profile, which limits interaction with exhibitors.
needs.outcome: Users go from a news article straight to the exhibitor and product profiles behind it.
needs.bo: Related: news service MVP for exhibitor-facing news; no links to exhibitor or product profiles documented (EP-50740, via EP-24277) [MASTER Exhibitor Portal §5 User Stories Mapping :11303]

needs.name: Exhibitor registration summary step
needs.what: Add a summary step with T&C confirmation at the end of exhibitor registration, as visitor registration has.
needs.why: DLG considers the visitor registration summary good practice and wants exhibitors to double-check their data before submitting.
needs.outcome: Exhibitors review all entered information before completing registration.

needs.name: Exhibitor stand as default meeting location
needs.what: Pre-fill the app meeting request location with the exhibitor's stand, falling back to the 'Exhibitor stand' default; empty for visitor-to-visitor meetings.
needs.why: Requested by IMEX (T1); no reason is stated.
needs.outcome: Meeting locations are correct without typing.
needs.bo: Partially built: built on web; this ticket brings it to the app (EP-8011) [MASTER Meetings & Matchmaking §5 User Stories Mapping :7878] [EP-10065]

needs.name: Exhibitor tag management
needs.what: Add management of exhibitor tags: create, delete, edit and reorder them.
needs.why: Informa: tags are ordered as they were added to profiles and cannot be edited, reordered or deleted once created, which makes filters hard to maintain.
needs.outcome: Organisers keep exhibitor tag filters current and in the order they want.

needs.name: Exhibitors add speakers to their events
needs.what: Let exhibitors select speakers for their exhibitor events on the frontend (Exhibitor events > Edit), including creating new speaker accounts by email, name and surname, similar to adding team members.
needs.why: Exhibitors cannot create speaker profiles, so Vinexposium has to collect speaker details and create them in the admin panel, which is manual work.
needs.outcome: Exhibitors attach their own speakers to exhibitor events without organiser intervention.

needs.name: Exported profile links with company and role
needs.what: Improve the exported profile links file so it has First name, Last name, Job title, Company name and Profile link, sorted by company (parent first, then child companies A–Z) with each company's team members A–Z by last name.
needs.why: Today the file has only a user name, mixing exhibitors with team members, and a link, in no defined order, so IMEX cannot tell which company or position each team member belongs to across parent and child companies.
needs.outcome: Users read from the file which company each team member represents and their role, grouped by parent and child company.

needs.name: Fax on exhibitor and product cards
needs.what: Add Fax (with State, Address and Phone number) to the 'Show in Exhibitor and Product Cards' setting in exhibitor registration settings and display it on exhibitor and product cards.
needs.why: DLG wants fax shown as additional contact information for visitors, extending the existing card fields setting.
needs.outcome: Visitors see the exhibitor's fax number on exhibitor and product cards when the organiser enables it.

needs.name: Featured sessions at the top of the list
needs.what: Show featured sessions at the top of the sessions page with a 'featured' label, on web and in the app.
needs.why: Not stated in the request.
needs.outcome: Attendees see featured sessions first, clearly labelled.
needs.bo: Related (EP-2672, EP-22334): website sessions block can filter by featured [MASTER Event Website §5 User Stories Mapping :5949]

needs.name: Feeds on exhibitor company profiles
needs.what: Bring the feeds module to exhibitor company profiles, with per-exhibitor-category controls to turn the Feeds tab on or off and set daily or weekly posting limits.
needs.why: IMEX asked for it; no problem is stated beyond the need.
needs.outcome: Exhibitors can post to a feed on their company profile within the limits their category allows.

needs.name: Field-level contact sharing in leads export
needs.what: Allow excluding only the phone number from the leads export, instead of all personal details or none.
needs.why: DWTC (Gitex Africa, needed before end of May) wants finer control over contact sharing. Tier 1 customers asking: Dubai World Trade Centre DWTC/ DXB Live.
needs.outcome: Exhibitors get lead contact details without phone numbers when the organiser chooses.
cus: Dubai World Trade Centre DWTC/ DXB Live

needs.name: File attachments on sessions (web and app)
needs.what: Let organisers attach files (up to at least 100 MB) to live sessions and show them on the session page on web and app, as for exhibitor profiles.
needs.why: DWTC: sessions need content attached.
needs.outcome: Attendees download session materials from the session page.
cus: Dubai World Trade Centre DWTC/ DXB Live

needs.name: Filter for inactive activated participants
needs.what: Add a filter in Management > Participants for users who activated their profile but have not acted on the platform.
needs.why: Kortrijk Xpo (T1) organisers want to target these users with engagement campaigns for Busworld.
needs.outcome: Organisers list activated but inactive participants and target them.

needs.name: Filter values via the API
needs.what: Expose filter values for sessions, exhibitors, products and other entities in the API so external systems can read, add, update and delete them.
needs.why: Filter values can be added only by hand or by file upload, which means manual data work for organisers with large data sets; requested for DLG.
needs.outcome: Organisers keep filter values in sync from their own systems through the API, without manual entry.
needs.bo: Related (EP-15375): five session filter fields are importable via XLS; no API [MASTER Sessions & Speakers §5 User Stories Mapping :8692]

needs.name: Finnish platform language
needs.what: Add Finnish as a language on the web platform and the mobile app using the translation files provided (web, iOS and Android).
needs.why: New client Tampere Fairs runs its events in Finnish, has already paid for the translation and expects to use it for its January event.
needs.outcome: Organisers, exhibitors and visitors use the web platform and app in Finnish.
needs.bo: Partially built (EP-33184, EP-18901): platform multilanguage exists and KB :795 lists FI (Finnish) among available languages; delivery of the provided translations not confirmed as a story [MASTER Client Manager §5 User Stories Mapping :821]

needs.name: Friendly access restriction message
needs.what: Replace the end-user pop-up "You don't have permission to view this page!" with "You don't have access to this page. Please contact support if needed." everywhere access restrictions apply.
needs.why: The current wording is abrupt and gives no next step, which confuses and frustrates end users who hit a restricted page; raised for the organiser. Tier 1: Frankfurter Buchmesse GmbH.
needs.outcome: End users who open a page they cannot access see a polite message that tells them to contact support.

needs.name: GES networking opt-in mapping
needs.what: Add a mapping field to the GES native integration so that networking opt-in can be switched on per participant category for imported accounts, keeping networking opt-out as the default.
needs.why: The Open API gained a 'networking' parameter defaulting to false, but the GES native integration was never updated, so every GES account lands on ExpoPlatform with networking turned off; Northstar, live on the integration, is directly affected.
needs.outcome: Participants registered through GES arrive with networking on or off according to their mapped category and can use matchmaking as standard.
needs.bo: Partially built (EP-24220): networking opt-in exposed on /api/v2/account/set; the GES native integration does not use it [MASTER Online Registration §5 User Stories Mapping :5303]

needs.name: Gallery file URLs on event domain
needs.what: Change the URL format of images and PDFs uploaded to the new web builder gallery from the storage host address to one on the event domain, for example wineparis.com/newfront/upload/<date>/<file name>.
needs.why: Gallery file URLs start with an unreadable storage host address, which Vinexposium finds messy when it shares uploaded files.
needs.outcome: Files uploaded to the gallery get clean URLs on the event's own domain that organisers can share.

needs.name: Header image on app pages
needs.what: Let organisers add a header image on all app pages except the home page.
needs.why: Vinexposium (T1) wants stronger branding.
needs.outcome: App pages carry the event's branding.

needs.name: Hide tracks by visitor category
needs.what: Add settings under Management > Sessions to hide a whole track from selected visitor categories.
needs.why: Kortrijk Xpo (Busworld) can only hide individual sessions for a visitor category, not an entire track. A comment notes concern about the growing number of settings.
needs.outcome: Visitors in the chosen categories do not see the hidden track or its sessions.
needs.bo: Partially built (EP-24229): session-level visibility restriction exists; track-level hiding per category is not documented [MASTER Sessions & Speakers §4 Feature Inventory :8651]

needs.name: Hierarchical page URLs
needs.what: Let organisers assign a parent page to a website page so its URL nests under the parent (e.g. /sustainability-in-events/eco-friendly-venues/), or allow '/' in page slugs to build hierarchical URLs.
needs.why: Only a flat slug can be set and '/' is not allowed, which blocks the hierarchical page structure IMEX needs for its SEO work.
needs.outcome: Organisers publish pages in a nested URL structure.
needs.bo: Related: EP-105 per-page SEO controls; no parent pages or nested slugs [MASTER Event Website §5 User Stories Mapping :5992]

needs.name: Highlighted note on sessions (multilingual)
needs.what: Add a note text field to sessions, in each language for bilingual sessions, shown on the frontend to highlight specific information.
needs.why: Vinexposium wants to highlight information many attendees miss in the description; CSS cannot target specific sessions and not all sessions are bilingual.
needs.outcome: Attendees see a highlighted note on the sessions that need one, in their language.

needs.name: Highlighted stand visibility on app floorplan
needs.what: Make the highlighted stand clearly visible when the floorplan opens from an exhibitor page, for example with a pin or an organiser-chosen colour, with accessibility in mind.
needs.why: The light grey highlight is almost invisible, so Vinexposium (T1) app users cannot spot the stand.
needs.outcome: Users find the exhibitor's stand immediately on the floorplan.

needs.name: Icon, title and text block
needs.what: Add a block to the new website builder with rows of icon + title + text (no button), with the number of items per row configurable at 2, 3 or 4.
needs.why: Vinexposium wants the layout to publish content more widely on its website; the request gives no further reason.
needs.outcome: Organisers can add an icon, title and text row block with 2 to 4 items to their website pages.

needs.name: Image gallery without video tab
needs.what: Hide the video tab in the Static content > Image gallery component of the website builder.
needs.why: Videos do not work in the image block, yet IMEX and other clients try to add them there, which confuses clients and creates questions for TAMs.
needs.outcome: Organisers only see image options in the image gallery component.

needs.name: Images in admin notifications
needs.what: Let organisers add an image to Admin notifications and show it with the text and link in app push notifications and in bell notifications on app and web.
needs.why: Organisers want to promote exhibitor sponsors with images, as an extra monetisation tool. Tier 1 customers asking: Dubai World Trade Centre DWTC/ DXB Live.
needs.outcome: Attendees see image-rich notifications that sponsors can pay for.
needs.bo: Partially built (EP-1085): Admin notifications with text and link exist; images are the extension [MASTER User Engagement §5 User Stories Mapping :9988] via EP-46532; Related (EP-1113): bell notification centre exists [MASTER User Engagement §5 User Stories Mapping :9989] via EP-46532
cus: Dubai World Trade Centre DWTC/ DXB Live

needs.name: In-app surveys
needs.what: Let organisers create surveys shown in the app, with triggers deciding when each appears, and record answers.
needs.why: Requested for Informa Markets (UK) (T1); no reason is stated.
needs.outcome: Organisers collect survey answers inside the app.

needs.name: IngenioData floor plan and navigation integration
needs.what: Build a native integration with the IngenioData floor plan and navigation system (SDK/REST, Situm documentation) for web and app, configured under General > Settings: map and navigation, user navigation data counted on the floor plan, location-triggered admin push notifications when users pass a stand, and exhibitor and session links to stands.
needs.why: DXB Live organisers have a full navigation system prebuilt with IngenioData for the DWTC venue and chose neither ExpoFP nor Invisual; the ask is similar to the ExpoFP + CrowdConnected integration. Tier 1 customers asking: Dubai World Trade Centre DWTC/ DXB Live.
needs.outcome: Attendees navigate the DWTC venue with IngenioData maps in the ExpoPlatform app and web, and organisers send location-based notifications.
needs.bo: Related (EP-27382): native Invisual floor plan integration with wayfinding; different vendor [MASTER Floor Plan §5 User Stories Mapping :13654] via EP-36919
cus: Dubai World Trade Centre DWTC/ DXB Live

needs.name: Inviter variables in the add team member email
needs.what: Add {Name Admin} (the person who added the team member) and {Mail Admin} (the exhibitor contact email) variables to the 'Adding team member' registration email template.
needs.why: Frankfurter Buchmesse's GDPR officer requires the email to tell the added person who added them and whom to contact, since no active consent is obtained and wrongly added team members (fraud cases) must be detectable.
needs.outcome: People added as team members see who added them and can contact that person to dispute it.
needs.bo: Related: team_member_role variable in email templates; not the inviter's name or email (EP-2832, via EP-31428) [MASTER Exhibitor Portal §5 User Stories Mapping :11240]

needs.name: Job offers block on the exhibitor profile
needs.what: Add a predefined Job Offers field to the exhibitor registration form, like About the Company, editable in the exhibitor's edit profile and shown on the public exhibitor profile on web and app.
needs.why: DLG wants exhibitors to publish vacancies on the platform; this is meant as a low-effort workaround. Developers ask for more detail on filtering, import/export and design.
needs.outcome: Visitors read an exhibitor's job offers on its profile.

needs.name: Job title as participant filter
needs.what: Add a setting on the Job Title field (Registration Settings → Visitor) that lets it be used as a frontend filter with predefined search options, on web first and in the mobile app if possible, with a copyable link to filtered results.
needs.why: DWTC concierges cannot filter participants by job title because it is a free text field, and the custom-field workaround does not give them the sortable list of titles they need. Asked by Dubai World Trade Centre DWTC/ DXB Live (T1).
needs.outcome: Concierges and users filter participant lists by job title on web and app and share the filtered view by link.
needs.bo: Related: job title shown in the admin participants list; not a frontend filter (EP-11654) [MASTER Admin / Platform Core §5 User Stories Mapping :1364]
cus: Dubai World Trade Centre DWTC/ DXB Live

needs.name: Keep menu items in burger and bottom nav
needs.what: Add an App Builder option to keep a module in the burger menu when it is also in the bottom navigation.
needs.why: In the Vinexposium (T1) app, adding an item to the bottom navigation removes it from the burger menu where users expect it.
needs.outcome: Users find the same items in the main menu and bottom bar.

needs.name: Keep parent team members out of child messages
needs.what: Add a setting, shown when "Allow team members of Parent exhibitor to access his Childs" is on, that hides the messages tab when a parent team member opens a child exhibitor's profile.
needs.why: Vinexposium needs parent team members kept out of child exhibitors' messages to comply with GDPR and protect the privacy of their communications; engineering notes notifications also carry message content.
needs.outcome: Parent team members can manage child exhibitor profiles without seeing the child's messages.
needs.bo: Related: parent admin team members can edit child profiles; the ask restricts their access to messages (EP-2144, via EP-39611) [MASTER Exhibitor Portal §5 User Stories Mapping :11235]; Related: one person managing several exhibitor accounts (EP-27619, via EP-39611) [MASTER Exhibitor Portal §5 User Stories Mapping :11298]

needs.name: Klipso: activation email to team member admin
needs.what: Replace the Klipso integration's 'send email' checkbox with a dropdown: send the exhibitor activation email to the exhibitor (current flow), or send the Exhibitor Team Member email template to the team member admin; send nothing when unset.
needs.why: In the new flow members log in with their own accounts and switch to the company profile, but there is no automated way for the team member admin to receive the activation link when exhibitors arrive via the API (Vinexposium).
needs.outcome: Each team member admin automatically receives their activation email when their exhibitor is created through Klipso.
needs.bo: Related (EP-14473): Klipso exhibitor data integration; email recipient choice not covered [MASTER Exhibitor Portal §5 User Stories Mapping :11278]

needs.name: Klipso: protect team member admin from updates
needs.what: Add 'team member admin' as a third option in the Klipso integration's 'Disable updates' field (alongside company name and exhibitor category), so contact person changes from Klipso no longer update the team member admin.

needs.outcome: Team member admins keep their details across shows while other Klipso data keeps syncing.

needs.outcome: Admins remove speakers or moderators one after another without losing their page in the list.
needs.bo: Related (EP-46707, EP-27790): search in speaker/moderator lists for large datasets; removal behaviour unchanged [MASTER Sessions & Speakers §5 User Stories Mapping :8710]

needs.name: Requestor confirmation email template
needs.what: Add a meeting email template under Networking & Matchmaking > Meetings > Email templates for the requestor when a team member books a meeting from the exhibitor account and adds themself as a participant, with variables showing the recipient's details; otherwise stop sending the incoming-request email to the requestor.
needs.why: At Vinexposium's Wine Paris the requestor receives the 'incoming' template with name, company and from mixed up with their own details, so they think the request never reached the buyer and complain.
needs.outcome: Requestors receive a clear confirmation of what was sent to whom, or no misleading email.

needs.name: Responsive images (srcset)
needs.what: Generate several sizes of each uploaded website image (small, medium, large) and serve them with the srcset attribute so the browser picks the right size for the device.
needs.why: IMEX reports that website images do not support srcset, so browsers cannot choose an optimised size, which hurts page load, Largest Contentful Paint, PageSpeed scores and SEO, especially on mobile.
needs.outcome: Website images load at a size fitting the visitor's screen, cutting bandwidth and improving LCP and PageSpeed scores.

needs.name: Resync single records in the ASP integration
needs.what: Add a field to the ASP integration settings to resync a single exhibitor, speaker or moderator account by email or external ID (ASP uuid), and a single session by external ID.
needs.why: The ASP integration can only resync a whole module, so getting fresh data for one exhibitor or speaker during setup or live days takes time and resources; wanted before Northstar's live days.
needs.outcome: Support and TAM teams refresh one record from ASP on demand instead of resyncing the full module.
needs.bo: Related (EP-11456): ASP integration pulls exhibitors, sessions and speakers per module; no per-record resync [MASTER Sessions & Speakers §5 User Stories Mapping :8682]; Related (EP-25344): ASP sessions, filters and speakers enrichment; no per-record resync [MASTER Exhibitor Portal §5 User Stories Mapping :11296]

needs.name: Retire old exhibitor event autoapproval

needs.name: Round table confirmation in the app

needs.name: Sent email content audit

needs.outcome: Admins open any sent email from the email tracking list and see what the recipient received.

needs.name: Separate T&Cs per registration pipeline

needs.outcome: Users tell communities and events apart on the multi-event home.

needs.name: Webview delegates result count
