needs.name: Stand reservation and buying on the floor plan
needs.what: Let exhibitors pick an available stand on the ExpoFP floor plan (size and price in the pop-up), reserve or buy it, pay on the platform with one contract and invoice, get a confirmation and receipt, and have the stand assigned and its status (available, reserved, sold) updated in ExpoFP; give organisers real-time stand sales analytics against targets.
needs.why: Stand sales are organisers' main revenue but are sold manually; clients using ExpoFP want to monetise the floor plan, Messe Duesseldorf wants a one-stop shop with one invoice and MCI Germany wants live sales data against targets.
needs.outcome: Exhibitors secure a stand online with instant confirmation and organisers track stand revenue live.
needs.bo: Related (EP-23328): items reserved during payment in the basket; no booth purchase [MASTER Exhibitor Portal §5 User Stories Mapping :11291] via EP-26008; Related (EP-26327): exhibitor data pushed from EP to ExpoFP; no stand purchase flow [MASTER Floor Plan §5 User Stories Mapping :13653] via EP-24105

needs.name: Co-located event check-in and crossover analytics
needs.what: Show in Check-in Analytics, live, the check-ins of each co-located event, the crossover attendees who checked in to several events (on EP or not) and the events they came from, filterable by event and comparable in the Total Check-In / Check-Out graph.
needs.why: Check-in Analytics covers one event only, so Rapid News Group (TCT, MEDTECH, INTERPLAS) downloads and cross-references several reports to answer attendance questions it is asked onsite; the client ties its renewal to this.
needs.outcome: Organisers answer cross-event attendance questions live without exporting reports.
needs.bo: Related (EP-14043): check-in export includes co-located show type; the analytics dashboard does not [MASTER Onsite & Kiosks §5 User Stories Mapping :3773] via FIS-1535836204

needs.name: Multi-column page layout
needs.what: Let website builder rows hold several columns so blocks sit side by side or in grids, with a quick way to add elements to grid cells.
needs.why: Blocks stack in a single column, so complex layouts need custom CSS from the frontend team (raised for CONNECT Oman).
needs.outcome: Organisers build multi-column layouts in the builder.
needs.bo: Already built: EP-47645 Custom Grids lets organisers create multi-column grid layouts with blocks placed in configurable cells [MASTER Event Website §5 User Stories Mapping :5989]

needs.name: Badge QR and barcode values in the accounts API
needs.what: Expose participants' badge QR codes and barcodes (internal and external, as strings, with badge print links) through the accounts API, including a bulk v2 visitor pull with from/to time filters and pagination returning personal and contact data and custom answers.
needs.why: Badge and lead systems integrating onsite (FieldDrive for ADS Group, badge printing systems) need the codes to match records, and neither account/get nor the v1 timestamp-only endpoint provides them.
needs.outcome: Onsite integrators retrieve badge codes and bulk visitor data through the API.
needs.bo: Related (EP-24220): networking opt-in added to account API, not badge codes [MASTER Online Registration §5 User Stories Mapping :5303]; Partially built (EP-14474): accounts API v2 endpoints exist; the to/from bulk pull with the full payload is the extension [MASTER Integrations §5 User Stories Mapping :16008]

needs.name: Deeper navigation menus
needs.what: Let website navigation hold many sub-items: a third menu level, and mega-menu panels with grouped columns.
needs.why: Mercator Media has many custom pages and only two navigation levels, so users face long lists; the flat dropdown cannot organise many sub-items.
needs.outcome: Visitors find pages through a structured, multi-level menu.
needs.bo: Related: EP-27309 tiered menu navigation for the app browser [MASTER Event Website §5 User Stories Mapping :5959]; Related: EP-36267 header menu customisation, in progress [MASTER Event Website §5 User Stories Mapping :5961]

needs.name: Different content per language
needs.what: Allow website content to differ per language, not only be translated: different blocks or pages per language, and different external links per language in menus and buttons.
needs.why: IMEX wants content suited to users from different countries; HINTE cannot point visitors to language-specific pages because a link change applies to every language.
needs.outcome: Each language version of the site carries its own content and links.
needs.bo: Partially built: EP-18901 multi-language desync makes each block independent per language; different block sets or pages per language are not documented [MASTER Event Website §5 User Stories Mapping :5938]; Related: EP-8495 website builder main menu exists; links are not stored per language [MASTER Event Website §5 User Stories Mapping :5927]

needs.name: Independent table and regular meeting types
needs.what: Separate table meetings from regular meetings so organisers can offer each type per event, user type or category, and send users straight to the allowed meeting request without the type-selection pop-up.
needs.why: Enabling table meetings also enables regular meetings, and the Regular option always appears, which confuses attendees and causes wrong selections and support questions; table-meeting clients A3, DoE and SpacePlus complain.
needs.outcome: Users see and book only the meeting type they are allowed, with no irrelevant choice.
needs.bo: Partially built. Partially built: EP-2948: table meeting permissions are defined on the frontend; unlinking regular meetings and direct redirection are not covered [MASTER Meetings & Matchmaking §5 User Stories Mapping :7876]

needs.name: Multi-ticket and group purchase
needs.what: Let one buyer or organisation purchase several tickets in one transaction and hand them to colleagues, either as ticket codes or by entering their emails so each receives an invitation and registers with their own details and consent, with duplicate-email checks.
needs.why: Visitors can only buy one ticket each, which does not suit C-suite users or people without a company card, and clients are surprised to find this after kick-off; buyers entering others' data also breaks data quality and GDPR consent. Asked by Loovent, Messukeskus (Helsinki Fairs) and SPE; other platforms offer bundles.
needs.outcome: A buyer pays once for several tickets and each colleague registers against an assigned ticket with their own details and consent.
needs.bo: Related (EP-37664): new ticket objects purchasable in the basket; buying several tickets for others is not covered [MASTER Transactions & Purchasing §5 User Stories Mapping :4439]

needs.name: No-shows in co-located check-in reports
needs.what: Include registered users with no check-in in the unique check-ins per event and per day reports for co-located events, via an export setting.
needs.why: Rapid News Group combines the attendee list and check-in reports in spreadsheets to find no-shows, which is slow and error-prone for large co-located events.
needs.outcome: Organisers see who did not attend directly in the check-in reports.
needs.bo: Related (EP-14043): custom check-in report with co-located show type; lists check-ins only [MASTER Onsite & Kiosks §5 User Stories Mapping :3773] via FIS-1536196624; Related (EP-20384): unique-per-event and per-day report versions [MASTER Onsite & Kiosks §5 User Stories Mapping :3785] via FIS-1536196624

needs.name: Payment after organiser approval
needs.what: Let tickets or registrations that need organiser approval be submitted without payment as pending (with document upload per approval ticket), reserve the tickets, and open payment or activation only after approval; rejection cancels the reservation.
needs.why: When registration or a restricted ticket needs approval, a ticket paid for up front may have to be refunded if rejected; HINTE asks for approval tickets with document checks.
needs.outcome: Organisers check qualifying documents or approve registrants before payment, rejected registrants never pay, and refunds are avoided.
needs.bo: Related (EP-2749): approval flow exists for team members with a buyer category, not for tickets [MASTER Hosted Buyer Management §5 User Stories Mapping :15025]; Related (EP-37784): tickets are reserved for 15 minutes on the payment page; this asks for reservation until approval [MASTER Transactions & Purchasing §5 User Stories Mapping :4440]; Related (EP-37664): tickets already purchasable in the basket [MASTER Transactions & Purchasing §5 User Stories Mapping :4439]

needs.name: Postcode validation at registration
needs.what: Validate the post code entered on registration forms, for example with a PAF (Postcode Address File) lookup that verifies postcode and address and blocks registration until the postcode is valid.
needs.why: Addresses are entered without any check, so data is messy and mailouts are rejected by mailing systems (Rapid News Group). Asked by Rapid News Group (T2).
needs.outcome: Registrants can only submit a valid postcode, and organisers get clean address data.

needs.name: Preserve list position when returning
needs.what: Keep the page, scroll position and filters of admin lists, starting with the participant list, when returning from a record, and remember pagination universally across the admin panel.
needs.why: Returning from a record resets the list, so ADS Group (T2) organisers re-apply filters and page back each time while checking attendees for Security and Policing 2027.
needs.outcome: Organisers return to exactly where they were in a list.
needs.bo: Partially built: FIS-2062974990: partially built (EP-23021), filter and search retention on back-to-list delivered for visitor lists; page and scroll position, and the reported reset, are not covered [MASTER Admin / Platform Core §5 User Stories Mapping :1372]

needs.name: Sticky header
needs.what: Add a setting to keep the website menu bar fixed at the top while scrolling, including a variant that sits below the intro block and sticks once scrolled.
needs.why: A fixed menu bar is standard on modern websites; Fairtrade Messe gets it today only with custom CSS.
needs.outcome: Visitors keep the navigation in reach while scrolling, without custom CSS.
needs.bo: Related: EP-36267 header menu customisation options, in progress; fixed position not stated [MASTER Event Website §5 User Stories Mapping :5961]

needs.name: Badge fold margin settings
needs.what: Let organisers set the centre fold margins and fold line position on the printed badge template, without relying on printer settings.
needs.why: For ADS Group's Security & Policing 2022, the fold line and artwork print out of line; the client cannot ask 7,000 attendees to change printer settings and delayed switching on badge printing.
needs.outcome: Badges print aligned on the fold straight from the template.
needs.bo: Related (EP-9812): left and right field margins in the badge builder, not fold lines [MASTER Onsite & Kiosks §5 User Stories Mapping :3766] via EP-1146

needs.name: Barcode variable in registration email
needs.what: Add a "Print Badge Bar Code" variable to the visitor registration email template.
needs.why: Mercator Media: the Klay onsite badge printing reads only barcodes, not the QR code currently available in the email.
needs.outcome: Visitors bring a barcode from their registration email that Klay can print badges from.
needs.bo: Partially built (EP-11106): barcode variable exists in the Visitor Switch Category template [MASTER Onsite & Kiosks §5 User Stories Mapping :3769] via EP-16927; Partially built (EP-15823): barcode variable exists in the Buyer Accept template [MASTER Onsite & Kiosks §5 User Stories Mapping :3783] via EP-16927

needs.name: Brandbox print-ready PDF generation
needs.what: Integrate with Brandbox via API to generate print-ready PDFs (A4 or custom, 300 dpi) from platform content such as exhibitor lists and profiles, product and brand catalogues, session schedules and speakers, triggered from the admin panel with templates per event, a log of generated files and access control.
needs.why: HINTE wants on-demand branded brochures and exports of directories, speaker lists and meeting summaries for internal use or attendees.
needs.outcome: Organisers produce up-to-date, branded print PDFs of event content from the admin panel.

needs.name: Bulk import of admin push notifications
needs.what: Add "Import from Excel" to Admin Notifications: download a template (title, message, send date/time, audience, optional deep link, push type), upload it, get row-level validation and a preview, and add the rows to the notification queue.
needs.why: Each push notification has to be created one by one, which is slow and error-prone for high-volume events such as the Connect Oman portfolio (OHE, OPES, OSW, ODBW); requested by the TAM team.
needs.outcome: Organisers schedule many push notifications in one upload that attendees receive as usual.
needs.bo: Related (EP-1085): admin push notification panel supports single notifications only [MASTER User Engagement §5 User Stories Mapping :9988] via EP-56993

needs.name: Category ID prefix in badge barcode
needs.what: Add a toggle under Registration Settings → Visitor → Additional settings, off by default, that prefixes each visitor's badge barcode with their category ID (e.g. 278 + 754643323).
needs.why: BeautyIstanbul wants to tell a visitor's category from the barcode number; they use EAN-13 badge barcodes. Comments say the client's process worked without it and the request can be closed.
needs.outcome: When the toggle is on, badge barcodes start with the visitor's category ID, so staff can read the category from the code.
needs.bo: Related (EP-9822): barcode and QR resize in badge builder, not code content [MASTER Onsite & Kiosks §5 User Stories Mapping :3767] via EP-38962

needs.name: Configurable sponsor display cap on the exhibitor list
needs.what: Replace the hardcoded 48-sponsor cap on the exhibitor list page (expanded view) with an admin setting, default 48, up to a performance-validated maximum, and apply the same rule in the app if it has the cap.
needs.why: Seawork 2026 has 56 paying premium sponsors but only 48 render on the frontend, silently, because of a cap introduced by EP-35640 and not shown in the admin; raised by the TAM team.
needs.outcome: All sponsors the organiser has sold and configured appear on the exhibitor list page.
needs.bo: Partially built: a custom sponsor limit is configurable, but the expanded view still stops at 48 (KB feature: Sponsor Limit on Marketplace, via EP-52343) [MASTER Sponsorship §4 Feature Inventory :14171]

needs.name: Country-based ticket pricing
needs.what: Add Country as a ticket variable: after entering email, registrants pick a country (locked for the show) and see that country's ticket prices, combined with category, with registration completing only if ticket and profile countries match.
needs.why: BeautyIstanbul charges only Turkish visitors and participants currently choose unpaid categories to avoid paying.
needs.outcome: Visitors are charged according to their country.
needs.bo: Partially built (EP-37154): Ticket visibility by country combined with category exists in the old UI; locked country selection and matching rules are not covered [MASTER Online Registration §5 User Stories Mapping :5319]

needs.name: Create exhibitors as pending via the API
needs.what: Add an optional status parameter (pending or active, default active) to the Open API exhibitor creation endpoint so API-created exhibitors can land in the admin Pending Exhibitors list and stay hidden on web and app until approved.
needs.why: Exhibitors created via the API skip manual review and go live at once, unlike web-form registrations, which Afreximbank's IATF and Canex projects cannot accept.
needs.outcome: Organisers review and approve API-created exhibitors in the same pending queue as web registrations.

needs.name: Custom A4 badge size
needs.what: Allow the printed badge size for the A4 format to be set to custom dimensions instead of the fixed 10.2 cm by 14.5 cm.
needs.why: Not stated in the request.
needs.outcome: Organisers print A4-format badges at the size their badge stock needs.

needs.name: Custom field on session cards
needs.what: Add a customisable field to the session card on the sessions page, set by admins from custom options (e.g. panel session, workshop, keynote) or free input, and shown prominently with the other card details.
needs.why: Session cards can only show Tracks, Type and Tags, so Fairtrade and other organisers cannot add their own information to the cards for conferences.
needs.outcome: Attendees see each session's custom type on the session card and can pick sessions that match their interests more quickly.

needs.name: Custom states and regions in registration
needs.what: Add a city field when creating a custom state/region in Event setup → Country Manager, so custom states/regions appear in the registration pipeline once the country is selected without separately adding a city.
needs.why: Rapid News Group found custom states/regions do not show in registration unless a city is attached, and the Country Manager gives no way to add one when creating the region, which causes confusion. Asked by Rapid News Group (T2).
needs.outcome: Registrants see the organiser's custom states/regions for their country in the registration form.
needs.bo: Related: state/region/city selectable in a custom select field; Country Manager regions are the ask (EP-9415) [MASTER Exhibitor Portal §5 User Stories Mapping :11250]

needs.name: Draft preview before publishing
needs.what: Add a Preview action next to Publish in the new Website Builder that opens the current unpublished draft in a new tab on an unlisted, non-indexed URL that can be shared internally, without changing the live site.
needs.why: The site can only be seen as visitors will see it after publishing, so organisers publish unfinished work and fix it live; requested across the TAM portfolio and by Connect Oman.
needs.outcome: Organisers review and share draft website changes privately and publish only when satisfied.
needs.bo: Partially built: KB feature: Website Preview in-editor mobile/tablet/desktop preview of the unsaved state exists; no shareable draft URL [MASTER Event Website §4 Feature Inventory :5858]

needs.name: Email domain allow and block lists
needs.what: Add registration settings for allowed and blocked email domain lists, e.g. validate an "I work for a RELX company" answer against a list of company domains and auto-approve on a match, sending non-matches for manual validation.
needs.why: Lexis Nexis needed internal users validated by email domain; the team is approving them manually, and the need applies to registration in general, not only hosted buyers. Asked by Lexis Nexis (T3), RELX.
needs.outcome: Registrations from allowed domains are approved automatically and others are blocked or held for review.

needs.name: Email subject lines longer than 39 characters
needs.what: Raise the email subject line limit from 39 characters to at least 100 in Email Sender templates and wherever a template subject can be customised, ideally with a configurable maximum and a remaining-characters counter.
needs.why: ACI Asia-Pacific's event name is about 80 characters and cannot be shortened without losing meaning, so their subject lines cannot convey the email's purpose.
needs.outcome: Organisers write subject lines that include the full event name and the email's purpose.

needs.name: Event-dates-only check-in report
needs.what: Add an "Event dates" tab to the upgraded check-in report that covers only the event's configured dates, next to the "All dates" tab.
needs.why: Rapid News Group: many people check in before the event starts, so check-ins during the event are not flagged as unique, and uniqueness matters to the client.
needs.outcome: Organisers measure unique check-ins within the event dates.
needs.bo: Partially built (EP-20384): unique-per-event and unique-per-day report versions exist; an event-dates-only view is the extension [MASTER Onsite & Kiosks §5 User Stories Mapping :3785] via EP-20033; Related (EP-14043): the upgraded custom check-in report this builds on [MASTER Onsite & Kiosks §5 User Stories Mapping :3773] via EP-20033

needs.name: Exhibitor manual submission version history
needs.what: Keep a version history of Exhibitor Manual form submissions that highlights what changed between submissions, with timestamps and submitter.
needs.why: A resubmission overwrites the previous data, so FESPA (FESPA Middle East 2027) re-reviews whole forms and risks missing changes.
needs.outcome: Organisers review only what an exhibitor changed in a resubmitted form.

needs.name: Exhibitor profile custom fields in manual exports
needs.what: Include Exhibitor Profile custom fields (e.g. booth number, company name format, booth type, allocation) in Exhibitor Manual form submission exports.
needs.why: Exports contain only form data, so FESPA merges them with Salesforce or profile data in spreadsheets each review cycle.
needs.outcome: Organisers get form submissions and the exhibitor's key profile data in one export.
needs.bo: Related: Exhibitor Manual export reworked (SQS); profile fields not included (EP-1094, via FIS-1957986323) [MASTER Exhibitor Portal §5 User Stories Mapping :11224]

needs.name: Filter sessions by location
needs.what: Add session location as a filter option under Event setup → Display filters → Sessions, shown on the sessions page on web and app and using each session's saved location.
needs.why: HINTE (INTERGEO 2025) already uses tags, types and streams for other purposes, so it cannot use the workaround of putting locations in those fields to filter by room.
needs.outcome: Attendees filter sessions by room or venue on web and app.
needs.bo: Related (EP-43909, EP-12365): additional session filter fields exist; location is not among them [MASTER Sessions & Speakers §5 User Stories Mapping :8685]

needs.name: Forced password change for exhibitors
needs.what: Add the forced password change on first login for exhibitors, as already exists for visitors.
needs.why: ADS Group wants exhibitors to set their own password at first login instead of looking up a system password in their email. Asked by ADS Group (T2).
needs.outcome: Exhibitors create their own password on first login.

needs.name: Genesis World integration phase 2
needs.what: Phase 2 of the Genesis World integration; the solution is still to be defined and the customer wants more functions.
needs.why: Not stated in the request.
needs.outcome: Not stated in the request.
needs.bo: Partially built (EP-41867): phase 1 Genesis World integration is delivered; phase 2 scope is undefined [MASTER Admin / Platform Core §5 User Stories Mapping :1376]

needs.name: Groups block on website
needs.what: Add a Groups system block to the new website builder so community groups can be placed on the home page and other custom pages, like the blocks for other system modules.
needs.why: Mercator Media wants its community groups more visible on its homepage; today groups are reached only from the dashboard or the navigation bar, and the iframe workaround did not meet their needs.
needs.outcome: Organisers can drop a Groups block onto any website page and visitors see the groups there.
needs.bo: Related: EP-38051 group single page exists on the website; no Groups block for pages [MASTER Event Website §5 User Stories Mapping :5986]

needs.name: Hidden tickets unlocked by code
needs.what: Add a "Hidden ticket" setting with a required code: hidden tickets are left out of the frontend ticket list, an admin filter shows them, and a "Hidden Tickets" action in registration and the profile Ticketing section reveals the ticket for a valid code at the top of the list, highlighted and preselected.
needs.why: Not stated in the request.
needs.outcome: Only users with the code can see and buy a hidden ticket.
needs.bo: Related (EP-26629): ticket create/edit exists [MASTER Online Registration §5 User Stories Mapping :5306]

needs.name: Hide an exhibitor with its products and brands
needs.what: Add a native way to hide an exhibitor together with its products, brands and team members on web and app.
needs.why: Mercator Media hides unpaid exhibitors with a "Hidden" invisible category, but hidden products leak into recommendations and brands, it does not work in the app, and brands cannot be hidden.
needs.outcome: Hidden exhibitors and everything linked to them disappear from the frontend on web and app.

needs.name: High-resolution exhibitor logo for print
needs.what: Add a "Logos for print" event setting (gated in Module Management per comments) that makes the existing company logo field accept JPEG or PDF at 300 dpi, validate format and resolution, keep the print file, and generate a compressed web version automatically, with the print file available through the API.
needs.why: Web logos are compressed, so HINTE organisers add a second custom field for print logos and exhibitors upload twice, which leads to missing files and wrong formats.
needs.outcome: Exhibitors upload one logo and organisers get a print-ready file while the platform shows a web version.

needs.name: Imported exhibitor images cropped to standard size
needs.what: When exhibitors are imported with a header image URL, pass the image through the same cropper used in the backend and frontend.
needs.why: Mercator Media (T2) wants imported header images to match the specification; import bypasses the cropper.
needs.outcome: Imported exhibitor header images appear at the correct dimensions.

needs.name: Interactive image block
needs.what: Add an Interactive block to the new website builder, as in the old builder, with a background image and multiple hyperlinks and videos inside one block.
needs.why: Mercator Media uses the Interactive block today; the new builder only has the Intro block, which allows just two buttons and no hyperlinks.
needs.outcome: Organisers can build one block that links visitors to several pages and videos from a single image in the new builder.
needs.bo: Related: EP-21888 banner blocks carried over from the old website; not the Interactive block [MASTER Event Website §5 User Stories Mapping :5945]

needs.name: Item ordering in exhibitor manual sections
needs.what: Let organisers set the display order of items in exhibitor manual sections (documents, equipment, marketing packages), e.g. by drag and drop, and show the same order on the frontend.
needs.why: HINTE finds items appear in no recognisable order, and even where an order exists in the backend (Important information documents) the frontend does not follow it.
needs.outcome: Exhibitors see manual items in the order the organiser intended.

needs.name: Kiosk inactivity reset
needs.what: Return the kiosk from the search results screen to its home screen after about 30 seconds of inactivity.
needs.why: When an attendee searches but does not finish check-in and printing, the kiosk stays on their search results, which is a poor experience for the next attendee.
needs.outcome: Each attendee arrives at the kiosk home screen, and abandoned searches are cleared automatically.

needs.name: Kiosk scanner active only after check-in
needs.what: Disable the kiosk scanner's default read mode so that it only becomes active after the attendee has completed check-in in kiosk mode, then lets them print their badge.
needs.why: On-site kiosk scanners read QR codes and barcodes automatically without the user going through the kiosk check-in, so attendees skip the check-in process (Mercator Media).
needs.outcome: Attendees complete check-in on the kiosk before scanning and printing their badge.

needs.name: Kiosk search by full name and company
needs.what: Add full name and company name as search criteria on the kiosk, alongside last name and email.
needs.why: Kiosk search works only by last name or email, and shared last names or identical names make it hard for attendees to find their own record.
needs.outcome: Attendees find their exact record on the kiosk by full name, filtered by company where names repeat.
needs.bo: Related (EP-14045): more than 5 kiosk search results and better many-match search; no full name or company criteria [MASTER Onsite & Kiosks §5 User Stories Mapping :3774] via EP-31290

needs.name: Lead download for visitors
needs.what: Allow visitors, not only exhibitors and team members, to download their leads, including from the mobile app, configurable per visitor category.
needs.why: A3 has no exhibitors and must create a dummy exhibitor and add all visitors as team members so they can download leads; K5 and SNAC want the same for visitors.
needs.outcome: Visitors in chosen categories download their own leads on web and app without workarounds.
needs.bo: Partially built (EP-13663): Download Leads toggle exists per exhibitor category and individual exhibitor; visitor categories are the ask [MASTER Lead Intelligence §5 User Stories Mapping :12735] via EP-44455; Related (EP-8982): visitors can already download their Scanned Me list on web [MASTER Mobile App §5 User Stories Mapping :10639] via EP-44455

needs.name: Longer badge-printing message on kiosk
needs.what: Show the kiosk's 'badge being printed' message for at least 5 seconds after a QR code is scanned, instead of half a second.
needs.why: The message flashes for half a second, so attendees do not realise their badge is printing and keep scanning their code again.
needs.outcome: Attendees see that their badge is printing and wait instead of rescanning.

needs.name: Manual news article picker for newsletters
needs.what: Add a manual article picker to the newsletter/email template builder so organisers search and select any number of news articles from the full pool, each rendered as a thumbnail (image and title) linking to the article, with the layout adapting to the count.
needs.why: News can be added to templates only through recommendations, so Mercator Media sends curated newsletters outside the platform and the TAM team builds custom HTML for each send.
needs.outcome: Organisers send curated newsletters with hand-picked articles from inside EP.
needs.bo: Related (KB feature: Email Variables (Campaigns)): Recommended News variable is resolved by the matchmaking algorithm; no manual selection [MASTER User Engagement §4 Feature Inventory :9834] via EP-56151

needs.name: Multi-language new builder and German app
needs.what: Enable multiple languages in the new website builder, as in the old builder, and make the mobile app available in German.
needs.why: ANWR can only go live once the new builder is multilingual, and more German clients need a German app; many users will not use an English-only website or app.
needs.outcome: Multilingual clients publish their website in several languages and German users use the app in German.
needs.bo: Partially built: EP-18901 multi-language with sync/desync delivered in the new website builder; a German app language is not documented [MASTER Event Website §5 User Stories Mapping :5938]

needs.name: Not Editable fields only after registration
needs.what: Change the Not Editable field property so it blocks editing only after a participant has registered, and leaves the field fillable for new registrants during registration.
needs.why: ADS Security & Policing wants submitted data kept unchanged, but today Not Editable also blocks the field during registration, and they register people right up to the event day; they want it for their 2026 event. Asked by ADS Group (T2).
needs.outcome: New registrants can fill in the field, and once registered they can no longer change it in their profile.
needs.bo: Partially built: Not Editable already sets the field read-only on the registration form and Edit Profile; the ask separates the two (KB feature) [MASTER Online Registration §4 Feature Inventory :5063]

needs.name: Offline Check-in App
needs.what: Give the Check-in App an offline mode: check in and scan attendees without internet, store check-ins locally, upload them automatically (or manually) once a connection returns while handling duplicates and conflicts, and connect printers over the local network without internet.
needs.why: Many Fairtrade on-site locations have unreliable internet, and the Check-in App's dependence on a stable connection disrupts or blocks on-site check-in and registration.
needs.outcome: Staff keep checking in attendees during connectivity outages with no lost data, and the server holds the complete check-in record after sync.
needs.bo: Related (EP-8616): distinguishes 'not found' from 'no internet' errors; no offline check-in or sync [MASTER Onsite & Kiosks §5 User Stories Mapping :3759] via EP-30375

needs.name: One form submission per email
needs.what: Add an option to limit a custom form to one submission per email address, returning an organiser-customisable error such as "You have already answered this form".
needs.why: Afreximbank uses custom forms to register interest in side events, and repeat submissions by the same person confuse their data and analysis.
needs.outcome: Each person can submit a given custom form only once, and repeat attempts see the organiser's message.
needs.bo: Partially built: EP-24373 custom form blocks exist; a unique-email restriction is the ask [MASTER Event Website §5 User Stories Mapping :5957]

needs.name: Organiser-pinned exhibitors at the top of the marketplace
needs.what: Add an admin setting to rename the "New" sash on exhibitors and turn it into a custom list that is switched on automatically, so the flagged exhibitors are kept at the top of the marketplace.
needs.why: Rapid News Group organisers can decide which sponsors appear at the top but cannot do the same for exhibitors.
needs.outcome: Organisers promote a chosen set of exhibitors to the top of the marketplace under a label they name.
needs.bo: Related: custom listing (table view) for the marketplace; not a pinned custom list (EP-12725, via EP-26138) [MASTER Exhibitor Marketplace §5 User Stories Mapping :12034]

needs.name: Participant category shown on scan
needs.what: Show the scanned user's participant category when a badge or QR code is scanned in the Check-in App, and at the end of the kiosk pipeline before the badge prints.
needs.why: After Sharjah Investment Forum, Sharooq reported that whoever scans a badge in the Check-in App or at the kiosk sees no information about the person, so staff cannot identify the user type on site.
needs.outcome: On-site staff see each attendee's category at scan and before printing, and can direct them accordingly.

needs.name: Per-location check-in for multiple zones
needs.what: Track check-in and check-out per location correctly when several check-in apps run for different zones, so a scan in one zone does not flip the status of another; a confirm/cancel screen after a scan was suggested.
needs.why: Mercator Media: scanning the same badge in two rooms records one as "in" and the other as "out", and data is corrupted if users forget to check out.
needs.outcome: Attendance per location is recorded correctly across zones.

needs.name: Pinned news articles
needs.what: Let organisers pin one or more news articles to the top of the news list, with a visible pin marker on pinned items.
needs.why: Mercator Media has over 1,300 news articles sorted only by published date and wants to choose which appear first, and to monetise the top positions.
needs.outcome: Pinned articles appear first in the news list with a pin indicator, ahead of the date-sorted articles.
needs.bo: Related: news block with category/tag filtering; no pinning (EP-21631, via EP-21923) [MASTER Event Website §5 User Stories Mapping :5943]

needs.name: Preserve exhibitor brands in the global database
needs.what: Keep the brands exhibitors create attached to their profiles in the global database, as for products, so they carry over to recurring events.
needs.why: Recurring events lose exhibitor brands; a quick win for ANWR (T2), especially brand-led industries such as fashion.
needs.outcome: Exhibitors' brands are available again at each recurring event.

needs.name: Printed badges filter
needs.what: Add a "Printed" badge filter next to the existing "Unprinted" filter under Management > Participants.
needs.why: Rapid News Group can only filter unprinted badges, so it cannot easily count printed badges.
needs.outcome: Organisers filter participants by printed and unprinted badges and see a count of each.

needs.name: RSS news feed in and out
needs.what: Display an external RSS feed on the event website like the news block (image, title, lead, date), and publish an RSS feed of the event website's news for other sites.
needs.why: Mercator Media (Seawork) wants external news from its other sites shown seamlessly on the event website, as on Maritime Contracts Journal.
needs.outcome: Visitors see external news on the event site, and partner sites can consume the event's news feed.
needs.bo: Related: EP-21631 news dynamic block shows internal news only [MASTER Event Website §5 User Stories Mapping :5943]

needs.name: Real-time automatic content translation
needs.what: Automatically translate content entered in English into the event's other languages, with organiser review and edit in the backend.
needs.why: Mercator Media (T2) runs events in 2-3 languages and adds content in each by hand.
needs.outcome: Organisers write content once and publish it in every event language.

needs.name: Repeatable rows and multi-file upload in manual forms
needs.what: Let exhibitors add rows to table sections themselves and upload several files to one File field in the Exhibitor Manual.
needs.why: Row counts are fixed by the organiser and File accepts one file, so FESPA exhibitors with more entries or documents send them by email.
needs.outcome: Exhibitors submit all their entries and documents through the manual.

needs.name: Respect field visibility in app profile
needs.what: Hide 'About Me' in the app profile when 'Show in visitor card' is off.
needs.why: About Me shows regardless of the setting, exposing sensitive vetting data (ADS Group, T2).
needs.outcome: Sensitive fields stay hidden in the app.

needs.name: SAP-format export of exhibitor manual purchases
needs.what: Provide a custom export of exhibitor manual purchases in ANWR's SAP template, with fields pre-filled from event data (e.g. VKORG from the event tag, event name, contact email and phone per event), or alternatively an integration with SAP S/4HANA.
needs.why: ANWR needs to track exhibitor purchase orders from the manual in SAP, and the current export does not provide this data or format, so importing takes extra work.
needs.outcome: ANWR loads manual purchase orders into SAP directly from the platform output.

needs.name: Save users without all required fields in admin
needs.what: Let admins save a user, including a category change and the Hosted Buyer profile, when required fields are empty, keeping validation for end users.
needs.why: ADS Group (T2) admins often change categories with different required fields, and saving is blocked.
needs.outcome: Admins change a user's category or details in one save.

needs.name: Separate limits for admin and regular team members
needs.what: Separate the team member limits for admin and regular team members, so exhibitors can add unlimited contractors (stand builders) who only get a badge, alongside limited staff, all visible on the exhibitor's team member page.
needs.why: ADS Group's contractors register through a link only to print badges and must not appear online; with one shared limit, exhibitors cannot see or manage them next to their capped staff.
needs.outcome: Exhibitors manage badge-only contractors and staff in one place with different limits and access.

needs.name: Sessions block list view
needs.what: Add a list view as a display option of the Sessions dynamic block in the website builder, similar to the minimal list the old website builder had.
needs.why: End users want a quick glance at the session schedule without scrolling through graphics; the new builder only offers four image-focused session views.
needs.outcome: Organisers can choose a list view for the Sessions block, and visitors see a concise session list where clicking a session name opens its session page.
needs.bo: Partially built: EP-22334 Sessions dynamic block exists with 4 graphic variants; a list variant is the ask [MASTER Event Website §5 User Stories Mapping :5949]

needs.name: Splash video preview in App Builder
needs.what: Add a preview button for the splash video in the App Builder, as for the splash image, across phone and iPad screen sizes.
needs.why: Organisers see the splash video only after an app update, and must re-upload and wait for another update when it is out of frame (Rapid News Group, T2).
needs.outcome: Organisers check the splash video framing before the app is updated.
needs.bo: Related: configurable loading screen in App Builder; no splash video preview (EP-36) [MASTER Mobile App §5 User Stories Mapping :10634] [EP-32884]

needs.name: Subtitle and divider styling
needs.what: In the new website builder, let organisers add subtitles in a different colour, apply text styles, and add colour to the divider line.
needs.why: Rapid News finds adding titles harder in the new builder: subtitles cannot take another colour and styles cannot be applied, a loss of functionality compared with the old builder.
needs.outcome: Organisers can style titles, subtitles and dividers in the new builder as they could in the old one.
needs.bo: Partially built: EP-23990 Title/Subtitle block exists; separate subtitle colour, styles and divider colour are not covered [MASTER Event Website §5 User Stories Mapping :5954]

needs.name: Switch-category email per category
needs.what: Allow a different email template per participant category for the "Switch to Category" notification, instead of one template for all categories.
needs.why: ADS Group sends the same email whether a participant moves to Silver, Gold or Basic, which is generic and can confuse recipients. Asked by ADS Group (T2).
needs.outcome: Participants moved to a category receive the email written for that category.
needs.bo: Related: badge variables added to the single Switch Category template (EP-11106) [MASTER Onsite & Kiosks §5 User Stories Mapping :3769]

needs.name: Unpaid submissions in the exhibitor manual export
needs.what: Include all submitted exhibitor manual sections and fields in the exhibitor manual export whether paid or not, with a payment status column or a toggle for unpaid submissions.

needs.outcome: Organisers who collect payment offline export every submitted manual item and see which ones are paid.
needs.bo: Related: Exhibitor Manual is an existing export report; unpaid submissions are not covered (KB feature: Data Export, via EP-45714) [MASTER Admin / Platform Core §4 Feature Inventory :1313]

needs.name: Emoji reactions in session chat
needs.what: Add emojis and message reactions (thumbs up, applause, laughter) to session and online room chats, visible to all in real time, with admin options to enable, disable or limit reactions by role.
needs.why: The session chat is text-only; Lexis Nexis (T3) attendees with cameras off find it hard to express themselves and want reactions like Google Meet.
needs.outcome: Attendees react and express themselves in session chat, raising engagement.

needs.name: Team-level duplicate meeting request warning
needs.what: Stop exhibitor team members sending duplicate meeting requests to the same attendee: warn a team member when a colleague already has a pending or confirmed request or meeting with that person or company, add team-level 'requested by / to members of my team' filters, or optionally allow only one request per exhibitor company.
needs.why: Team members cannot see each other's requests, so VIP attendees receive dozens of invites from one company and visitors get many requests from different members of the same exhibitor; exhibitor admins police duplicates by hand. Raised by CloserStill Media (TechShow London) and Emerald.
needs.outcome: Attendees receive coordinated outreach from each exhibitor and team members avoid duplicate requests.
needs.bo: Partially built. Partially built: EP-27888: 'Existing Meeting Initiator' and 'Existing Meeting Status' filters delivered; team-level options and warnings not [MASTER Exhibitor Marketplace §5 User Stories Mapping :12045]

needs.name: Custom URL button on sessions
needs.what: Add an optional URL field to sessions (admin and import) that shows an action button on the session card and page, including letting the Register Now button point to an external registration and payment URL.

needs.outcome: Organisers send attendees from a session to any external page, including paid registration.

needs.name: New arrivals discovery page

needs.why: Not stated beyond the design brief; a comment links a similar ask from SaladPlate (Informa Asia) for filtered landing pages.
needs.outcome: Users see a page of recently added content as the organiser configures it.

needs.name: Session poll results export
needs.what: Let moderators export poll results from within a session and administrators export poll data from the admin panel, with session title and date, question, and each user's name, company, email and answer.
needs.why: Moderators and administrators cannot export poll results today and need them for analysis and reporting; raised by Lexis Nexis (T3).
needs.outcome: Poll results can be exported per session for reporting.
needs.bo: Related (EP-92, EP-1706): polls exist for hybrid sessions; no poll-answer export documented [MASTER Sessions & Speakers §5 User Stories Mapping :8680]

needs.name: Session slides with private attendee notes
needs.what: Let organisers attach a presentation to a session and let attendees view it slide by slide on web and app, add private auto-saved notes per slide, revisit them and export them with the slides.

needs.outcome: Attendees follow and annotate session slides inside the platform.
needs.bo: Related (FIS-1622376449, EP-23843): private notes exist for meetings, not for session slides [MASTER Mobile App §5 User Stories Mapping :10648]; Related (EP-50240, EP-23843): private notes exist for meetings in the app, not for session slides [MASTER Mobile App §5 User Stories Mapping :10648]

needs.name: Surcharge-free invoices for offline payment
needs.what: Exclude the card surcharge or tax from invoices when a delegate chooses offline or invoice payment, controlled by an event setting, or let the admin edit or zero it on that invoice.

needs.outcome: With the setting on, invoice-payment orders produce invoices with no surcharge and a net total; card payments are unchanged.

needs.name: Atlas global create-only sync mode
needs.what: Extend the Atlas API "create only" mode from exhibitors to all Atlas content (visitors, speakers, conferences) as one global toggle.

needs.outcome: Atlas syncs create new records without overwriting data already imported.

needs.name: Auto-link speakers to sessions at registration

needs.outcome: Speakers end up linked to their sessions without manual backend mapping.

needs.name: Dynamic block item limit
needs.what: Raise the limit of 24 items in the website builder's dynamic content blocks (Brands, Exhibitors, News, Products, Sessions, Speakers, Sponsors) so one block can show more than 24 sponsors or exhibitors.
needs.why: Organisers must pick items by hand or split them into categories and blocks; sponsors pay for visibility and some events have 30 to 40 or more sponsors.
needs.outcome: All sponsors or exhibitors appear in one block in alphabetical order without manual selection.
needs.bo: Partially built: EP-22333 Sponsors block exists; the item limit is the extension [MASTER Event Website §5 User Stories Mapping :5948]; Partially built: EP-21629 Exhibitors block exists; the item limit is the extension [MASTER Event Website §5 User Stories Mapping :5941]

needs.name: Exhibitor package subscriptions and self-service upgrades
needs.what: Let exhibitors buy an initial package or a package upgrade on the platform as a subscription for a defined period that auto-renews or lapses, with advance lapse emails, organiser-defined periods per event or exhibitor, package pricing and promo codes.
needs.why: Clarion and Planning Portal want exhibitors to purchase listings and upgrades directly; Planning Portal is up for renewal and has asked for it.
needs.outcome: Exhibitors buy and renew their packages themselves, and organisers manage subscriptions on the platform.

needs.name: Independent stand numbers for products
needs.what: Let organisers give products their own stand number, independent of the exhibitor's stand, shown in the product view and linking to the floor plan for navigation.
needs.why: Potential clients Farnborough Air Show and Informa Boat show have large exhibits located away from the exhibitor's main stand.
needs.outcome: Visitors locate a large exhibit on the floor plan directly from its product page.

needs.name: LinkedIn link field format
needs.what: Change the default LinkedIn link prefix so it no longer forces "linkedin.com/in/", allowing showcase and other LinkedIn pages, and make the field behave and validate the same on the registration page, frontend exhibitor profile and backend.
needs.why: Reed Italy (MCE 2022) cannot enter showcase-page links; the backend cannot change the prefix, and the frontend accepts invalid URLs that then do not show on the profile.
needs.outcome: Exhibitors enter any valid LinkedIn page and it displays correctly everywhere.

needs.name: Maximum selections on multi-choice fields
needs.what: Add a setting on multi-choice custom fields to cap the number of options a user can select, graying out the remaining options once the limit is reached and showing how many selections remain.
needs.why: Users can select options without any restriction; where a limited number of choices is wanted (e.g. Texworld's 'Primary area of interests'), the Design team has to build it as a workaround. Asked by Messe Frankfurt GmbH USA (T3).
needs.outcome: Admins set a maximum on a custom field and registrants cannot select more than that number, with clear feedback while choosing.

needs.name: Meeting entitlement quota for team members
needs.what: Add a limit 'Allowed number of Team members with meetings' at exhibitor category and exhibitor level, and let the admin and the exhibitor team-member admin mark which team members can have meetings within that quota.
needs.why: Informa sells packages with a set number of team members with meetings (for example 10 team members, 5 with meetings); today meeting access can only be limited by the organiser through participant categories and the permission matrix. Comments say Informa will use a workaround in Visit and the item is paused until reprioritised.
needs.outcome: Exhibitor admins decide which of their team members take meetings, up to the quota their category allows.
needs.bo: Related: per-category option to disallow team members, not meeting entitlement (EP-8363, via EP-6776) [MASTER Exhibitor Portal §5 User Stories Mapping :11245]; Related: default for category limit fields (EP-8247, via EP-6776) [MASTER Exhibitor Portal §5 User Stories Mapping :11244]

needs.name: Organiser alert on category registration
needs.what: Email the organiser when someone registers as a speaker or under chosen categories, with the triggering categories and recipients configurable in the admin.

needs.outcome: Organisers are emailed as soon as a speaker or a registrant in a watched category signs up.
needs.bo: Partially built: an individual registration report emails after each new visitor; no filter by speaker or category (KB feature: Organiser Registration Reports) [MASTER Online Registration §4 Feature Inventory :5268]

needs.name: Payment columns in the registration report
needs.what: Add paid amount and payment status columns to the existing registration report export, alongside all registration form questions, so organisers can filter to completed payments after download.
needs.why: The registrant report mixes unpaid and paid registrants, so ACI Asia-Pacific & Middle East cannot rely on it for payment reconciliation.
needs.outcome: Organisers export one registration report and see who has paid and how much.

needs.name: Pending-approval page for offline payments
needs.what: Show a distinct, organiser-editable "payment pending approval" page after registration when the registrant chose offline/invoice payment, instead of the shared "Thank you for registering" page.
needs.why: Offline payers at ACI Asia-Pacific & Middle East see the same confirmation as card payers and think they are fully confirmed while payment still awaits approval; the confirmation page has four fixed variants that ignore payment method. Asked by Airports Council International - ACI Asia-Pacific (T3).
needs.outcome: Offline and invoice payers see that their registration awaits payment approval.
needs.bo: Related: organiser confirms or cancels pending invoice payments; no registrant-facing pending page (KB feature: Payments by Invoice (Exhibitors)) [MASTER Transactions & Purchasing §4 Feature Inventory :4407]

needs.name: Product comparison
needs.what: Let logged-in marketplace users pick several products and compare their custom fields side by side, with the organiser choosing which fields appear.
needs.why: RX Thailand and other customers ask for it; an RX study rated it the top value-add for marketplace users to find and compare suppliers, and it is seen as a chance to retain RX business.
needs.outcome: Users compare shortlisted products in one table and move on to contact the supplier.

needs.name: Registered status for agent-link buyers
needs.what: Give hosted buyers who register through an agent link the 'Registered' status in Management > Participants instead of 'Active' by default.
needs.why: FOCUS (T3) uses hosted buyers as an approval process and wants to email non-active buyers from Campaigns and Email Sender, but agent-link buyers all count as Active.
needs.outcome: Organisers can filter and remind buyers who are not yet active.
cus: FOCUS - The Meeting Place for International Production

needs.name: Registration builder panel scrolling

needs.outcome: Admins scroll within the setup panel and keep their position on the page while configuring registration items.

needs.name: Team member category on badges

needs.outcome: Team members always get badges showing their exhibitor role, whatever their past attendance.

needs.name: Team member exhibitor shown in participant admin

needs.why: Organisers cannot tell which exhibiting company a team member belongs to, because the 'Company Name' field is editable by the team member and can differ from the exhibitor they participate under; raised for FOCUS.
needs.outcome: Organisers see each team member's exhibitor name and ID directly in the participants list and profile.
cus: FOCUS - The Meeting Place for International Production

needs.outcome: Team members who resend their activation email receive the team member template with the exhibitor name.

needs.name: Calendar view of the sessions programme

needs.outcome: Organisers see grouped analytics across a portfolio of events.
